Create VIEW [acc].[vwAcnt]
AS
	select	AH.*
	, AD.LanguageID,AD.TableauText,AD.SensiblePoint,AD.PlaceOldName,AD.CustomerFamous,AD.ParticularDateText1
	,AD.ParticularDateText2,AD.ParticularDateText3,AD.ParticularDateText4,AD.ManagerView,AD.VisitorView
	,AD.AcntName, AD.AcntComment, AD.FirstName, AD.LastName, AD.AsnafID,
			(AD.FirstName + ' ' + AD.LastName) AS PersonName, AD.Address1, 
			AD.Address2, (AD.Address1 + ' ' + AD.Address2) AS Address, AD.GradDesc, 
			AD.DistributionPoint, LC.LocationName, CustomerKindName, AD.OrganzationName, 
			VP1.VisitPathName as VisitPathName1,
			VP2.VisitPathName as VisitPathName2,
			VP3.VisitPathName as VisitPathName3,
			VP4.VisitPathName as VisitPathName4
	from	acc.tblAcnt AH
				inner join acc.tblAcntDtl AD on AD.AcntCode = AH.AcntCode and AD.PartNumber = AH.PartNumber and AD.LanguageID = 1
				left  join pub.tblLocationsDtl LC on LC.LocationID = AH.LocationID and LC.LanguageID = 1
				left  join sal.tblCustomerKindsDtl CK on CK.CustomerKindID = AH.CustomerKindID and CK.LanguageID = 1
				left  join acc.tblVisitPathDtl VP1 on VP1.VisitPathID = AH.VisitPathID1 and VP1.PartNumber = 1
				left  join acc.tblVisitPathDtl VP2 on VP2.VisitPathID = AH.VisitPathID2 and VP2.PartNumber = 2
				left  join acc.tblVisitPathDtl VP3 on VP3.VisitPathID = AH.VisitPathID3 and VP3.PartNumber = 3
				left  join acc.tblVisitPathDtl VP4 on VP4.VisitPathID = AH.VisitPathID4 and VP4.PartNumber = 4
	where (AH.AcntCode <> '')

views.name: vwAcntParts
views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 1390/07/21
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
CREATE VIEW [acc].[vwAcntParts]
AS
	select sum(0) + 1 as Part1Start, 
	(   	
		select  Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9
		from    pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where	(PartNumber in (1)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part1Len,
   (
	select	sum(Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 + 1) + 1
	from    pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where	(PartNumber in (1)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part2Start,
   (
	select	Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9
	from    pub.tblCodeLayer
	where	(PartNumber in (2)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part2Len,
   (
	select	sum(Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 + 1) + 1
	from    pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where	(PartNumber in (1,2)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part3Start,
   (
	select	Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9
	from    pub.tblCodeLayer
	where	(PartNumber in (3)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part3Len,
   (
	select	sum(Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 + 1) + 1
	from    pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where	(PartNumber in (1,2,3)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part4Start,
   (
	select	Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9
	from    pub.tblCodeLayer
	where	(PartNumber in (4)) AND (TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt')
	) as Part4Len

views.definition:

-- ==============================================
Create VIEW [acc].[vwAllCustomers]
AS
	select	A.*,ISNULL(S.LastSaleDate,'') LastSaleDate,ISNULL(S.Amount,0) Amount,ISNULL(S.Price,0) Price, isnull((Select SUM(Debit-Credit)  from acc.tblVoucherDtl  v
	 where  SUBSTRING(v.AcntCode,1,(select Layer1	from pub.tblCodeLayer where TableName='acc.tblAcnt' and PartNumber=1)) not  in 
	 (select SUBSTRING(AcntCode,1,(select Layer1	from pub.tblCodeLayer where TableName='acc.tblAcnt' and PartNumber=1)) from acc.tblAcnt 
			where PartNumber= 1 and AcntType  IN (91,92) )
			 and substring(v.AcntCode,
				(select CONVERT(int,SettingValue ) from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey like 'StartLayerIndex'),
				(select CONVERT(int,SettingValue ) from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey like 'LayerLen')) =A.AcntCode ),0) AcntRemainAccount
	from	acc.vwAcnt A
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT AcntCode,LastSaleDate ,Amount,Price
		FROM (
			select ROW_NUMBER()over(partition by substring(AcntCode,
														   (select CONVERT(int,SettingValue ) from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey like 'StartLayerIndex'),
														   (select CONVERT(int,SettingValue ) from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey like 'LayerLen')) 
									order by DocDate desc) R, 
					substring(AcntCode,(select CONVERT(int,SettingValue ) from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey like 'StartLayerIndex'),(select CONVERT(int,SettingValue ) from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey like 'LayerLen') ) AcntCode,
					DocDate LastSaleDate,Amount,Price
			from inv.tblStorageDocsHdr D
			where VchNo>0 AND  ProcessID IN (90) 
		) a
		WHERE R=1 
		) S
		on A.AcntCode=S.AcntCode

CREATE VIEW [acc].[vwVoucherDtl]

			pub.GetCodeName(D.AcntCode, 1) as AcntName, IsNull(CD.CurrencyTypeName,'') As CurrencyTypeName
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl D

views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1391/09/10
-- Description	 : مبالغ ارزی
-- ==============================================
Create VIEW [acc].[vwVoucherDtl2]
AS
	-- dont change DD to D
	SELECT	DD.SerialNo, DD.RowNo, DD.SourceProcessID, DD.SourceProcessNo, DD.SourceFiscalYear, DD.SourceSerialNo, DD.DocDate, DD.AcntCode
			,CASE WHEN Debit > 0 and CurrencyAmount>0 THEN ABS(CurrencyAmount) ELSE CASE WHEN Credit> 0 and CurrencyAmount<0 THEN ABS(CurrencyAmount) ELSE 0 END END AS Debit
			,CASE WHEN Credit> 0 and CurrencyAmount>0 THEN ABS(CurrencyAmount) ELSE CASE WHEN Debit > 0 and CurrencyAmount<0 THEN ABS(CurrencyAmount) ELSE 0 END END AS Credit
			,DD.RecDesc, DD.RecDesc2, DD.IsAutoDoc, DD.SessionNo, DD.VchKind, DD.DocRowNo
			,DD.SourceDocType, DD.IsShowDetail, HH.OldSerialNo
			,DD.CurrencyAmount, DD.Emphasize, DD.CurrencyTypeID, DD.Debit as MainDebit, DD.Credit as MainCredit
			,DD.Emphasize2, DD.Emphasize3, IsNull(CTD.CurrencyTypeName,'') As CurrencyTypeName
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl DD
		INNER JOIN acc.tblVoucherHdr HH ON HH.SerialNo = DD.SerialNo
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblCurrencyTypesDtl CTD ON CTD.CurrencyTypeID = DD.CurrencyTypeID

views.name: vwVoucherDtl_PayRecSum
views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author        : TakroSystem\Modir
-- Create date   : 1389/12/23
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : 
-- Description   : جدول اسناد با تجمیع دریافت و پرداخت
-- =============================================
CREATE VIEW [acc].[vwVoucherDtl_PayRecSum] 
AS
	SELECT SerialNo, RowNo, SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, SourceFiscalYear, SourceSerialNo, DocDate, AcntCode, Debit, Credit, RecDesc, RecDesc2, IsAutoDoc, SessionNo, VchKind, DocRowNo, SourceDocType, IsShowDetail, CurrencyAmount, Emphasize, Emphasize2, Emphasize3, CurrencyTypeID
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl
	WHERE SourceProcessID NOT IN (1, 2)
	UNION all 
	SELECT v.SerialNo, 
		0 AS RowNo, 
		v.SourceProcessID,
		v.SourceProcessNo,
		v.SourceFiscalYear,
		v.SourceSerialNo,
		v.DocDate,
		v.AcntCode,
		SUM(Debit) AS Debit,
		SUM(Credit) AS Credit,
		case when (SourceProcessID=1) then 'دريافت وجه شماره' else 'پرداخت وجه شماره' end + ' ' + LTRIM(STR(v.SourceSerialNo)) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(SourceFiscalYear)) + '-' + Ltrim(ISNULL(p.DescHdr,'')) AS RecDesc,
		'' AS RecDesc2,
		cast(1 as bit) AS IsAutoDoc,
		0 AS SessionNo,
		VchKind,
		0 AS DocRowNoR,
		0 AS SourceDocType,
		cast(0 as bit) AS IsShowDetail,
		SUM(CurrencyAmount) AS CurrencyAmount,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize2,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize3,
		v.CurrencyTypeID
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl v
	left join trs.tblPayHdr p
	on v.SourceProcessID=p.ProcessID 
	AND v.SourceProcessNo=p.ProcessNo
	AND v.SourceProcessNo=p.ProcessNo
	AND v.SourceFiscalYear=p.FiscalYear
	AND v.SourceSerialNo=p.SerialNo
	WHERE SourceProcessID IN (1, 2)
	GROUP BY 
		v.SerialNo,
		v.SourceProcessID,
		v.SourceProcessNo,
		v.SourceFiscalYear,
		v.SourceSerialNo,
		v.DocDate,
		v.AcntCode,
		v.VchKind, 
		v.CurrencyTypeID,
		p.DescHdr

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================

Create VIEW [acc].[vwVoucherDtl_PayRecSum2]
AS
	SELECT SerialNo, RowNo, SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, SourceFiscalYear, SourceSerialNo, DocDate, AcntCode, 
		case when Debit > 0 then CurrencyAmount else 0 end Debit, 
		case when Credit > 0 then CurrencyAmount else 0 end Credit, 
		Debit  AS MainDebit,		Credit AS MainCredit,
		RecDesc, RecDesc2, IsAutoDoc, SessionNo, VchKind, DocRowNo, SourceDocType, IsShowDetail, CurrencyAmount, Emphasize, Emphasize2, Emphasize3, CurrencyTypeID
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl
	WHERE SourceProcessID NOT IN (1, 2)
	UNION all 
	SELECT SerialNo, 
		0 AS RowNo, 
		SourceProcessID,
		SourceProcessNo,
		SourceFiscalYear,
		SourceSerialNo,
		DocDate,
		AcntCode,
		SUM(case when Debit > 0 then CurrencyAmount else 0 end) AS Debit,
		SUM(case when Credit > 0 then CurrencyAmount else 0 end) AS Credit,
		SUM(Debit ) AS MainDebit,		SUM(Credit ) AS MainCredit,
		case when (SourceProcessID=1) then 'دريافت وجه شماره' else 'پرداخت وجه شماره' end + ' ' + LTRIM(STR(SourceSerialNo)) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(SourceFiscalYear)) AS RecDesc,
		'' AS RecDesc2,
		cast(1 as bit) AS IsAutoDoc,
		0 AS SessionNo,
		VchKind,
		0 AS DocRowNoR,
		0 AS SourceDocType,
		cast(0 as bit) AS IsShowDetail,
		SUM(CurrencyAmount) AS CurrencyAmount,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize2,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize3, CurrencyTypeID
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl
	WHERE SourceProcessID IN (1, 2)
	GROUP BY 
		SerialNo,
		SourceProcessID,
		SourceProcessNo,
		SourceFiscalYear,
		SourceSerialNo,
		DocDate,
		AcntCode,
		VchKind, CurrencyTypeID

CREATE VIEW [acc].[vwVoucherDtl_ProcessSum] 
AS
	SELECT SerialNo, RowNo, SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, SourceFiscalYear, SourceSerialNo, DocDate, AcntCode, Debit, Credit, RecDesc, RecDesc2, IsAutoDoc, SessionNo, VchKind, DocRowNo, SourceDocType, IsShowDetail, CurrencyAmount, Emphasize, Emphasize2, Emphasize3
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl
	WHERE (SourceProcessID=0)
	UNION all 
	SELECT 0 as SerialNo,
		0 AS RowNo,
		SourceProcessID,
		SourceProcessNo,
		0 as SourceFiscalYear,
		0 as SourceSerialNo,
		'----/--/--' as DocDate,
		'' as AcntCode,
		SUM(Debit) AS Debit,
		SUM(Credit) AS Credit,
		P.ProcessName AS RecDesc,
		'' AS RecDesc2,
		cast(1 as bit) AS IsAutoDoc,
		0 AS SessionNo,
		0 as VchKind,
		0 AS DocRowNoR,
		0 AS SourceDocType,
		cast(1 as bit) AS IsShowDetail,
		SUM(CurrencyAmount) AS CurrencyAmount,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize2,
		cast(0 as bit) AS Emphasize3
	FROM acc.tblVoucherDtl D2
			left join pub.tblProcess P on P.ProcessID = D2.SourceProcessID and P.ProcessNo = D2.SourceProcessNo
	WHERE SourceProcessID <> 0
	GROUP BY SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, ProcessName

views.name: vwVoucherHD
views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 1390/07/19
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1390/07/20
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
CREATE VIEW [acc].[vwVoucherHD]
AS
	select	H.SerialNo, H.DocDate, H.DocDesc, H.DocDesc2, H.DocRegisterState, 
			D.DocRowNo, D.SourceProcessID, D.SourceProcessNo, D.SourceFiscalYear, D.SourceSerialNo, 
			D.AcntCode, D.Debit, D.Credit, D.RecDesc, D.RecDesc2, 
			D.IsAutoDoc, D.VchKind, D.CurrencyAmount, D.Emphasize,
			cast(Substring(H.DocDate, 6, 2) as int) as MonthCode,
			T1.TypeText as VchKindName,	
			T2.TypeText as MonthName, 
			T3.TypeText as DocRegisterStateName,
			P1.ProcessName as SourceProcessName, 
			pub.GetCodeName(D.AcntCode, 1) AcntName,
			acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 1) as AcntName1,
			acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 2) as AcntName2,
			acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 3) as AcntName3,
			acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 4) as AcntName4,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part1Start], L.[Part1Len]) AcntCode1,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part2Start], L.[Part2Len]) AcntCode2,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part3Start], L.[Part3Len]) AcntCode3,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part4Start], L.[Part4Len]) AcntCode4,
			case when (Debit <> 0) then Debit else Credit end as Amount,
			case when (Debit <> 0) then Debit else 0-Credit end as Amount2,
			D.AcntCode + '('+pub.GetCodeName(D.AcntCode, 1) +')' AcntCodeWithName,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part1Start], L.[Part1Len])	 + '('+		acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 1)+')' as AcntCodeWithName1,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part2Start], L.[Part2Len])	 + '('+		acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 2)+')' as AcntCodeWithName2,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part3Start], L.[Part3Len])	 + '('+		acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 3)+')' as AcntCodeWithName3,
			substring(D.AcntCode, L.[Part4Start], L.[Part4Len])	 + '('+		acc.funPartAcntName(D.AcntCode, 4)+')' as AcntCodeWithName4
	from acc.tblVoucherHdr H
		inner join acc.tblVoucherDtl D on H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
		left join pub.tblProcess P1 on P1.ProcessID = D.SourceProcessID and P1.ProcessNo = D.SourceProcessNo
		left join pub.tblTypeValues T1 on T1.TypeID = 1  and T1.TypeValue = D.VchKind
		left join pub.tblTypeValues T2 on T2.TypeID = 10 and T2.TypeValue = cast(Substring(H.DocDate, 6, 2) as int)
		left join pub.tblTypeValues T3 on T3.TypeID = 17 and T3.TypeValue = H.DocRegisterState
		cross join [acc].[vwAcntParts] L

storedProcedures.name: SpVch_CreateDoc_Finishing
storedProcedures.definition:
--
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Ahmadnejad
-- Create date   : 1386/05/07
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1392/02/15
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\ZiA
-- Description	 : < ثبت سند اختتامیه >
-- =============================================
-- [acc].[SpVch_CreateDoc_Finishing] '1395/12/29','','',0
Create PROCEDURE [acc].[SpVch_CreateDoc_Finishing]
	@DocDate	Char(10) = null,	-- تاریخ ثبت
	@DocDesc	NVarChar(500) = '',	-- شرح
	@AcntCode	varchar(20) = '',
	@SessionNo	Int = 0
--WITH ENCRYPTION
AS
DECLARE @RecID			bigint;
DECLARE @SerialNo		Int;
DECLARE @OldSerialNo	Int;
DECLARE @OldAcntCode	varchar(20);
DECLARE @ErrAcntCode	varchar(20);
DECLARE @ErrorMsg		nvarchar(2000);
DECLARE @StrTemp		nvarChar(1000);
DECLARE @IntTemp		bigint;
DECLARE @ExistingCount	bigint;
DECLARE @CurrencyTypeID	varchar(20);
DECLARE @CurrencyTypeName	nvarchar(50);
declare @useCurr		bit;
declare @useExchange	bit;
DECLARE @NotClosedAcntTypeInExchange Bit
DECLARE @FinishingDocWithProcessNo Bit
DECLARE @Acc_VisitorCodeInVoucher Bit
DECLARE @Sal_HasPayment Bit

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- Init -----------------------------------
	If (@DocDesc Is Null) SET @DocDesc = ''
	If (@DocDate Is Null) SET @DocDate = RIGHT(db_name(), 4) + '/12/30'

	SET @useCurr = 1
	SET @useExchange = 0
	SET @NotClosedAcntTypeInExchange = 'False'
	
	SELECT @useCurr = SettingValue
	FROM pub.tblSettings
	WHERE SettingKey = 'Acc_UseCurrencyInFinishDoc'

	SELECT @useExchange = SettingValue
	FROM pub.tblSettings
	WHERE SettingKey = 'Acc_CheckExchangeDoc'
	
	SET @OldAcntCode = ''
	
	SELECT @OldAcntCode = SettingValue
	FROM pub.tblSettings
	WHERE SettingKey = 'ProfitAndDetrimentAcntCode'
	

	SELECT @NotClosedAcntTypeInExchange = SettingValue
	FROM pub.tblSettings
	WHERE SettingKey = 'NotClosedAcntTypeInExchange'

	SELECT @FinishingDocWithProcessNo = SettingValue
	FROM pub.tblSettings
	WHERE SettingKey = 'FinishingDocWithProcessNo'
	
	if (@AcntCode = '') set @AcntCode = @OldAcntCode

	-- Check Not to Exist Any Similar Doc --
	SELECT	@IntTemp = COUNT(*)
	FROM	acc.tblVoucherDtl
	WHERE	VchKind = 3
	
	If (@IntTemp > 0)
	Begin
		--RaisError ('این نوع سند قبلاً ثبت شده است', 5, 16)
		Return -1;
	End

	-- Check another user not to be connected to database --
	DECLARE @ParmDefinition NVarChar(100)
	SET @StrTemp = '
		SELECT	@CountOUT = Count(*)
		FROM	[' + pub.funGetBranchDBName() + '].[usr].[tblActiveUsers]
		WHERE	DateDiff(mi, GetDate(), RefreshDateTime) < 6'

	SET @ParmDefinition = N'@CountOUT Int OUTPUT';

	Execute sp_executesql @StrTemp, @ParmDefinition, @CountOUT = @IntTemp OUTPUT;

	If (@IntTemp > 1)
	Begin
		--RaisError  ('کاربر دیگری در سیستم مشغول است', 5, 16)
		Return -4;
	End

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Start to Save ---------------------------------------------------

	create table #tbl_Temp
	(
		AcntCode varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as,
		SourceProcessNo tinyint,
		CurrencyTypeID varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as,
		AcntSort bigint,
		NativeRemain Float,
		CurrencyRemain float,
		VisitorAcntCode varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as 
	);

	BEGIN TRANSACTION;	
	
	BEGIN TRY
		update acc.tblVoucherDtl
		set CurrencyTypeID=''
		where CurrencyTypeID='0'

	-------------------------------------------------
		CREATE TABLE #tmp(Id bigint)
	
		insert into	#tmp
		exec [hst].[funGetUniqueId]

		select @RecID = Id from #tmp

		select	@SerialNo = IsNull(Max(SerialNo), 0) + 1,
				@OldSerialNo = IsNull(Max(OldSerialNo), 0) + 1
		from	acc.tblVoucherHdr
		
		set @ExistingCount = 0;

		-- Set Header Section --
		INSERT INTO	acc.tblVoucherHdr(SerialNo, DocDate, DocRegisterState, DocDesc, DocDesc2, VchKind, RecID, SessionNo, OldSerialNo, CurrencyTypeID, CurrencyRate, RowNo)
		VALUES (@SerialNo, @DocDate, 1, @DocDesc, '', 3, @RecID, @SessionNo, @OldSerialNo, '', 0, 0)
		
	
	if object_id ('tempdb.dbo.#tbl_Voucher') is not null
			drop table  #tbl_Voucher

		select	* into #tbl_Voucher	from	acc.tblVoucherDtl D  
		where	(D.VchKind <> 0) 

		IF @FinishingDocWithProcessNo='False'
			update #tbl_Voucher	set SourceProcessNo=0

		DECLARE @SumLayer1 INT
		Declare @Start as int
		Declare @Len as int	
		Set @Start=acc.funGetAcntLayerStartandLen(1,1)
		Set @Len=acc.funGetAcntLayerStartandLen(1,2)
		SELECT @Sal_HasPayment = SettingValue	FROM pub.tblSettings	WHERE SettingKey = 'Sal_HasPayment'
		SELECT @Acc_VisitorCodeInVoucher = SettingValue	FROM pub.tblSettings	WHERE SettingKey = 'Acc_VisitorCodeInVoucher'
	
		SELECT @SumLayer1  = (Layer1+ Layer2+ Layer3+ Layer4+ Layer5+Layer6+ Layer7+ Layer8+ Layer9) from pub.tblCodeLayer					where TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt' AND PartNumber = 1

	if (@useCurr = 1 OR @useCurr = 'True') and (select COUNT(*) from acc.tblAccState )>0 and @Sal_HasPayment='True'
		Begin

				update #tbl_Voucher	
					set CurrencyTypeID = ''	,CurrencyAmount=0	
					WHERE SourceProcessID<>420 and (CurrencyTypeID='' OR CurrencyAmount=0)

				IF @NotClosedAcntTypeInExchange = 'True'
					update #tbl_Voucher		
					set CurrencyTypeID = ''	,CurrencyAmount=0	
					from #tbl_Voucher a		
					inner join acc.tblAcnt b on SUBSTRING(a.AcntCode,1,@SumLayer1)=b.AcntCode  
					where  b.AcntType IN(41, 51, 61, 62,81)
			if (select Count(*) from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)<=0
				begin
					insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode,VisitorAcntCode,SourceProcessNo,CurrencyTypeID, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain)
					select	D.AcntCode,D.VisitorAcntCode,ISNULL(D.SourceProcessNo,0),D.CurrencyTypeID, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode,D.VisitorAcntCode),
							isnull(ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4), 0) AS NativeRemain,
							ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),0),4) as CurrencyRemain
					from	#tbl_Voucher D 
					group by D.AcntCode,D.VisitorAcntCode,D.SourceProcessNo,D.CurrencyTypeID
					having ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4) <> 0 OR ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),4) <>0
				END
				else
				begin
					insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode,VisitorAcntCode,SourceProcessNo,CurrencyTypeID, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain)
					select	D.AcntCode,D.VisitorAcntCode,ISNULL(D.SourceProcessNo,0),D.CurrencyTypeID, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode,D.VisitorAcntCode),
							isnull(ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4), 0) AS NativeRemain,
							ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),0),4) as CurrencyRemain
					from	#tbl_Voucher D 
					where SubString(AcntCode,@Start,@Len) in (select AcntCode from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)
					group by D.AcntCode,D.VisitorAcntCode,D.SourceProcessNo,D.CurrencyTypeID
					having ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4) <> 0 OR ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),4) <>0

					insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode,SourceProcessNo,CurrencyTypeID, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain)
					select	D.AcntCode,ISNULL(D.SourceProcessNo,0),D.CurrencyTypeID, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode),
							isnull(ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4), 0) AS NativeRemain,
							ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),0),4) as CurrencyRemain
					from	#tbl_Voucher D 
					where SubString(AcntCode,@Start,@Len) not in (select AcntCode from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)
					group by D.AcntCode,D.SourceProcessNo,D.CurrencyTypeID
					having ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4) <> 0 OR ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),4) <>0

				END

				--select * from #tbl_Temp
				--where AcntCode='111302 707052'
				--  برای حذف حسابهایی که از نظر ریالی محموع صفر و ارزی مانده صفر دارند
				delete from #tbl_Temp 				--select a.* 
				from #tbl_Temp a
				inner join 
				(select Sum(NativeRemain) NativeRemain,AcntCode from #tbl_Temp
					where CurrencyRemain=0
					group by AcntCode
					having  Sum(NativeRemain)=0) b 
				on a.AcntCode=b.AcntCode
				
				
				if (@useExchange = 1  )
				Begin
					set @ErrAcntCode = '';
					
					select top 1 @ErrAcntCode = AcntCode
					from #tbl_Temp
					where CurrencyTypeID <> '' and (CurrencyRemain <> 0) and SIGN(NativeRemain) <> SIGN(CurrencyRemain)
				
					if (@ErrAcntCode is not null) and (@ErrAcntCode <> '')
						RaisError ('مبلغ ارزی برای کد <%s> تسعیر نشده است', 16, 16, @ErrAcntCode);
				end

	delete from #tbl_Temp 
	from #tbl_Temp T
	inner join acc.tblAcnt b on SUBSTRING(T.AcntCode,1,@SumLayer1)=b.AcntCode  
	where  b.AcntType IN(41, 51, 61, 62,81)	

				insert into	acc.tblVoucherDtl(
				SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, AcntCode,VisitorAcntCode, CurrencyTypeID, CurrencyAmount, 
				Debit, Credit, SessionNo, RecDesc, RecDesc2, IsAutoDoc, VchKind, IsShowDetail,
				SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, SourceFiscalYear, SourceSerialNo, SourceDocType,
				SourceCodeFieldValue, Emphasize, Emphasize2, Emphasize3)
		select	@SerialNo, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY AcntCode) AcntSort, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY AcntCode) AcntSort
				, @DocDate , T.AcntCode,isnull(T.VisitorAcntCode,''),CurrencyTypeID 
				, case when T.NativeRemain <0  and  CurrencyRemain >0 then   -1*CurrencyRemain 
					   when T.NativeRemain <0  and  CurrencyRemain <0 then   -1*CurrencyRemain 
					   when T.NativeRemain >0  and  CurrencyRemain >0 then   CurrencyRemain 
					   when T.NativeRemain >0  and  CurrencyRemain <0 then   CurrencyRemain  
					   else CurrencyRemain end 
				CurrencyAmount,
				CASE WHEN (T.NativeRemain < 0) THEN (-T.NativeRemain) ELSE 0 END AS Debit,
				CASE WHEN (T.NativeRemain > 0) THEN (+T.NativeRemain) ELSE 0 END AS Credit,
				@SessionNo, @DocDesc + ISNULL((SELECT '(' + CurrencyTypeName + ')' from pub.tblCurrencyTypesDtl a WHERE T.CurrencyTypeID<>'' AND  a.CurrencyTypeID=T.CurrencyTypeID),'')  RecDesc,'' RecDesc2, 
				1 as IsAutoDoc, 3 as VchKind, 0 as IsShowDetail, 
				0 as SourceProcessID, ISNULL(SourceProcessNo,0), 0 as SourceFiscalYear, 0 as SourceSerialNo, 
				0 as SourceDocType, 0 as SourceCodeFieldValue, 0 as Emphasize, 0 as Emphasize2, 0 as Emphasize3
		from #tbl_Temp T

		End
		else if (@useCurr = 1 OR @useCurr = 'True')
		Begin
			
				update #tbl_Voucher	
					set CurrencyTypeID = ''	,CurrencyAmount=0	
					WHERE SourceProcessID<>420 and (CurrencyTypeID='' OR CurrencyAmount=0)

				IF @NotClosedAcntTypeInExchange = 'True'
					update #tbl_Voucher		
					set CurrencyTypeID = ''	,CurrencyAmount=0	
					from #tbl_Voucher a		
					inner join acc.tblAcnt b on SUBSTRING(a.AcntCode,1,@SumLayer1)=b.AcntCode  
					where  b.AcntType IN(41, 51, 61, 62,81)

				insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode,SourceProcessNo,CurrencyTypeID, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain)
				select	D.AcntCode,ISNULL(D.SourceProcessNo,0),D.CurrencyTypeID, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode),
						isnull(ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4), 0) AS NativeRemain,
						ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),0),4) as CurrencyRemain
				from	#tbl_Voucher D 
				group by D.AcntCode,D.SourceProcessNo,D.CurrencyTypeID
				having ROUND(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit),4) <> 0 OR ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (Debit > 0) THEN (CurrencyAmount) ELSE (-CurrencyAmount) END ),4) <>0
				--  برای حذف حسابهایی که از نظر ریالی محموع صفر و ارزی مانده صفر دارند
				delete from #tbl_Temp 				--select a.* 
				from #tbl_Temp a
				inner join 
				(select Sum(NativeRemain) NativeRemain,AcntCode from #tbl_Temp
					where CurrencyRemain=0
					group by AcntCode
					having  Sum(NativeRemain)=0) b 
				on a.AcntCode=b.AcntCode
				
				
				if (@useExchange = 1  )
				Begin
					set @ErrAcntCode = '';
					
					select top 1 @ErrAcntCode = AcntCode
					from #tbl_Temp
					where CurrencyTypeID <> '' and (CurrencyRemain <> 0) and SIGN(NativeRemain) <> SIGN(CurrencyRemain)
				
					if (@ErrAcntCode is not null) and (@ErrAcntCode <> '')
						RaisError ('مبلغ ارزی برای کد <%s> تسعیر نشده است', 16, 16, @ErrAcntCode);
				end
	
	delete from #tbl_Temp 
	from #tbl_Temp T
	inner join acc.tblAcnt b on SUBSTRING(T.AcntCode,1,@SumLayer1)=b.AcntCode  
	where  b.AcntType IN(41, 51, 61, 62,81)	

				insert into	acc.tblVoucherDtl(
				SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, AcntCode, CurrencyTypeID, CurrencyAmount, 
				Debit, Credit, SessionNo, RecDesc, RecDesc2, IsAutoDoc, VchKind, IsShowDetail,
				SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, SourceFiscalYear, SourceSerialNo, SourceDocType,
				SourceCodeFieldValue, Emphasize, Emphasize2, Emphasize3)
		select	@SerialNo, T.AcntSort, T.AcntSort, @DocDate, T.AcntCode,
				CurrencyTypeID 
				, case when T.NativeRemain <0  and  CurrencyRemain >0 then   -1*CurrencyRemain 
					   when T.NativeRemain <0  and  CurrencyRemain <0 then   -1*CurrencyRemain 
					   when T.NativeRemain >0  and  CurrencyRemain >0 then   CurrencyRemain 
					   when T.NativeRemain >0  and  CurrencyRemain <0 then   CurrencyRemain  
					   else CurrencyRemain end 
				CurrencyAmount,
				CASE WHEN (T.NativeRemain < 0) THEN (-T.NativeRemain) ELSE 0 END AS Debit,
				CASE WHEN (T.NativeRemain > 0) THEN (+T.NativeRemain) ELSE 0 END AS Credit,
				@SessionNo, @DocDesc + ISNULL((SELECT '(' + CurrencyTypeName + ')' from pub.tblCurrencyTypesDtl a WHERE T.CurrencyTypeID<>'' AND  a.CurrencyTypeID=T.CurrencyTypeID),'')  RecDesc,'' RecDesc2, 
				1 as IsAutoDoc, 3 as VchKind, 0 as IsShowDetail, 
				0 as SourceProcessID, ISNULL(SourceProcessNo,0), 0 as SourceFiscalYear, 0 as SourceSerialNo, 
				0 as SourceDocType, 0 as SourceCodeFieldValue, 0 as Emphasize, 0 as Emphasize2, 0 as Emphasize3
		from #tbl_Temp T

		End
		Else
		Begin
			
			IF (select COUNT(*) from acc.tblAccState )>0 and @Sal_HasPayment='True'
			BEGIN
			
				CREATE TABLE #tmpAccDC
							(
								AcntCode Varchar(20)  collate arabic_cs_as,
								Debit Float ,
								Credit Float,
								VisitorAcntCode varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as 
							)
								
				if (select Count(*) from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)<=0
				begin
					insert into 	#tmpAccDC	(AcntCode,Debit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
					select AcntCode,Sum(Debit), VisitorAcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl
					group by AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode
					having Sum(Debit)<> Sum(Credit) and Sum(Debit)<>0 
					and AcntCode not in (select AcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl group by AcntCode having Sum(Debit)= Sum(Credit))				
					order   by AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode

					--EXEC acc.SpAcc_AccState '',1,0,0,0,0,'True'

					insert into 	#tmpAccDC	(AcntCode,Credit,VisitorAcntCode) 
						select AcntCode,Sum(Credit),  VisitorAcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl
					group by AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode
					having Sum(Debit)<> Sum(Credit) and Sum(Credit)<>0
					and AcntCode not in (select AcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl group by AcntCode having Sum(Debit)= Sum(Credit))				
					order   by AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode
					--	EXEC acc.SpAcc_AccState '',2,0,0,0,0,'True'

				end
				else
				begin
					
					insert into 	#tmpAccDC	(AcntCode,Debit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
					select  AcntCode,Sum(Debit), VisitorAcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl
					group by AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode
					having Sum(Debit)<> Sum(Credit) and Sum(Debit)<>0 
					and AcntCode not in (select AcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl group by AcntCode having Sum(Debit)= Sum(Credit))				
					and SubString(AcntCode,@Start,@Len) in (select AcntCode from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)
 
					insert into 	#tmpAccDC	(AcntCode,Credit,VisitorAcntCode) 
					select AcntCode,Sum(Credit),  VisitorAcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl
					group by AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode
					having Sum(Debit)<> Sum(Credit) and Sum(Credit)<>0
					and AcntCode not in (select AcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl group by AcntCode having Sum(Debit)= Sum(Credit))				
					and SubString(AcntCode,@Start,@Len) in (select AcntCode from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)

					insert into 	#tmpAccDC	(AcntCode,Debit,Credit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
					select  AcntCode,case when  Sum(Debit)>Sum(Credit) then Sum(Debit)-Sum(Credit) else 0 end 
					,case when  Sum(Credit)>Sum(Debit) then Sum(Credit)-Sum(Debit) else 0 end , '' from acc.tblVoucherDtl
					group by AcntCode
					having Sum(Debit)<> Sum(Credit) 			
					and SubString(AcntCode,@Start,@Len)not  in (select AcntCode from acc.tblAcnt where HasAccState=1)
 
				end
			 
				
				update #tmpAccDC
				set Debit=ISNULL(Debit,0),Credit=ISNULL(Credit,0)

				insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain, VisitorAcntCode)
				Select D.AcntCode, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode),
						ROUND(isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0),4) AS NativeRemain, 0 as CurrencyRemain, VisitorAcntCode
				from #tmpAccDC D
				Group by AcntCode,	VisitorAcntCode
				Having isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0)<>0

			END			
			else if @Acc_VisitorCodeInVoucher='True'
			BEGIN
			
				CREATE TABLE #tmpAccDC2
							(
								AcntCode Varchar(20)  collate arabic_cs_as,
								Debit Float ,
								Credit Float,
								VisitorAcntCode varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as 
							)	
				
				insert into #tmpAccDC2(AcntCode,Debit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
				select AcntCode,Sum(Debit),VisitorAcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl Group by AcntCode,VisitorAcntCode
				
				insert into #tmpAccDC2(AcntCode,Credit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
				select AcntCode,Sum(Credit),VisitorAcntCode from acc.tblVoucherDtl Group by AcntCode,VisitorAcntCode
			
				update #tmpAccDC2
				set Debit=ISNULL(Debit,0),Credit=ISNULL(Credit,0)

				delete from #tmpAccDC2
				where AcntCode not in (
				 select Distinct  AcntCode
				 from #tmpAccDC2
				 where	  --AcntCode='211208 01 1 15012080'  and 
				 VisitorAcntCode<>''
				)
				
				insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain, VisitorAcntCode)
				Select D.AcntCode, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode),
						ROUND(isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0),4) AS NativeRemain, 0 as CurrencyRemain, VisitorAcntCode
				from #tmpAccDC2 D
				Group by AcntCode,	VisitorAcntCode
				Having isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0)<>0
								
				insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain)
				select	D.AcntCode, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode),
						ROUND(isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0),4) AS NativeRemain, 0 as CurrencyRemain
				from	acc.tblVoucherDtl D 
				where	(D.VchKind <> 0) and 
				AcntCode not in (
				 select Distinct  AcntCode
				 from #tmpAccDC2				 
				)
				group by D.AcntCode,D.SourceProcessNo
				having sum(D.Debit - D.Credit) <> 0

			select *  into #tbl_Temp1 from #tbl_Temp
			
			delete from #tbl_Temp

			insert into #tbl_Temp 
			select AcntCode	,SourceProcessNo	,CurrencyTypeID	, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY AcntCode)	,Sum(NativeRemain),	CurrencyRemain	,VisitorAcntCode
			from #tbl_Temp1
			group by AcntCode	,SourceProcessNo	,CurrencyTypeID	,	CurrencyRemain	,VisitorAcntCode
			having Sum(NativeRemain)<>0
					   
			END 
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				if object_id ('tempdb.dbo.#tbl_Voucher1') is not null
					drop table  #tbl_Voucher1

				select	* into #tbl_Voucher1	from	acc.tblVoucherDtl D 
				where	(D.VchKind <> 0) 

				IF @FinishingDocWithProcessNo='False'
					update #tbl_Voucher1	set SourceProcessNo=0

				insert into #tbl_Temp(AcntCode,SourceProcessNo, AcntSort, NativeRemain, CurrencyRemain)
				select	D.AcntCode,ISNULL(D.SourceProcessNo,0), Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY D.AcntCode),
						ROUND(isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0),4) AS NativeRemain, 0 as CurrencyRemain
				from	#tbl_Voucher1 D 
				where	(D.VchKind <> 0) 
				group by D.AcntCode,D.SourceProcessNo
				having sum(D.Debit - D.Credit) <> 0
			END

	delete from #tbl_Temp 
	from #tbl_Temp T
	inner join acc.tblAcnt b on SUBSTRING(T.AcntCode,1,@SumLayer1)=b.AcntCode  
	where  b.AcntType IN(41, 51, 61, 62,81)	

			insert into	acc.tblVoucherDtl(
					SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, AcntCode, CurrencyTypeID, CurrencyAmount, 
					Debit, Credit, SessionNo, RecDesc, RecDesc2, IsAutoDoc, VchKind, IsShowDetail,
					SourceProcessID, SourceProcessNo, SourceFiscalYear, SourceSerialNo, SourceDocType,
					SourceCodeFieldValue, Emphasize, Emphasize2, Emphasize3, VisitorAcntCode)
			select	@SerialNo, Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY AcntCode,AcntSort), Row_Number() Over (ORDER BY AcntCode,AcntSort), @DocDate, T.AcntCode,
					'' CurrencyTypeID, 0 CurrencyAmount,
					CASE WHEN (T.NativeRemain < 0) THEN (-T.NativeRemain) ELSE 0 END AS Debit,
					CASE WHEN (T.NativeRemain > 0) THEN (+T.NativeRemain) ELSE 0 END AS Credit,
					@SessionNo, @DocDesc, '' as RecDesc2, 1 as IsAutoDoc, 3 as VchKind, 0 as IsShowDetail, 
					0 as SourceProcessID, ISNULL(SourceProcessNo,0), 0 as SourceFiscalYear, 0 as SourceSerialNo, 
					0 as SourceDocType, 0 as SourceCodeFieldValue, 0 as Emphasize, 0 as Emphasize2, 0 as Emphasize3,isnull( VisitorAcntCode, '')
			from #tbl_Temp T
			order by AcntCode
		
			Delete acc.tblVoucherDtl
		where Debit =0 and Credit=0
		
		End		
		-------حذف نشود---------------------------------------------------
		DECLARE @DecTemp		Float;
		Select @DecTemp=Sum(Cast( Debit as Decimal(30,10)))-Sum(Cast( Credit as Decimal(30,10))) From 	acc.tblVoucherDtl
		where SerialNo=	@SerialNo
		if abs(@DecTemp)<10 and abs(@DecTemp)>=0.0001
		begin
			if @DecTemp>0  
			begin
				insert into acc.tblVoucherDtl(SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, AcntCode,Credit,VchKind)
				Select @SerialNo,max(RowNo)+1,max(DocRowNo)+1, @DocDate,@AcntCode,Sum(Cast( Debit as Decimal(30,10)))-Sum(Cast( Credit as Decimal(30,10))) ,3 From 	acc.tblVoucherDtl
				where SerialNo=	@SerialNo
			end
			else
			begin
				insert into acc.tblVoucherDtl(SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, AcntCode,Debit,VchKind)
				Select @SerialNo,max(RowNo)+1,max(DocRowNo)+1, @DocDate,@AcntCode,Sum(Cast( Credit as Decimal(30,10)))-Sum(Cast( Debit as Decimal(30,10))) ,3 From 	acc.tblVoucherDtl
				where SerialNo=	@SerialNo
			end
		end
		----------------------------------------------------------------
		
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		RETURN @SerialNo
	
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0)
	        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

		begin try
			CLOSE curCurrencies;
			DEALLOCATE curCurrencies;
		end try
		begin catch
		end catch

		select @ErrorMsg = ERROR_MESSAGE()
		raiserror(@ErrorMsg, 16, 1)
		--PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE()
		RETURN 0

	END CATCH

END

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================

CREATE PROCEDURE [acc].[SpAcc_PartInfo]
	@PartNo		Int = 1,
	@PartStart	Int out,
	@PartLen	Int out
AS 
DECLARE @Part1Start	Int;
DECLARE @Part2Start	Int;
DECLARE @Part3Start	Int;
DECLARE @Part4Start	Int;
DECLARE @Part1Len	Int;
DECLARE @Part2Len	Int;
DECLARE @Part3Len	Int;
DECLARE @Part4Len	Int;
Begin

	SET		@Part1Start = 1;
	SELECT	@Part1Len = Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 
	FROM	pub.tblCodeLayer 
	WHERE	(TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber = 1)

	SELECT	@Part2Start = @Part1Start + @Part1Len + 1;
	SELECT	@Part2Len = Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 
	FROM	pub.tblCodeLayer 
	WHERE	(TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber = 2)

	SELECT	@Part3Start = @Part2Start + @Part2Len + 1;
	SELECT	@Part3Len = Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 
	FROM	pub.tblCodeLayer 
	WHERE	(TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber = 3)

	SELECT	@Part4Start = @Part3Start + @Part3Len + 1;
	SELECT	@Part4Len = Layer1 + Layer2 + Layer3 + Layer4 + Layer5 + Layer6 + Layer7 + Layer8 + Layer9 
	FROM	pub.tblCodeLayer 
	WHERE	(TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber = 4)
	
	IF (@PartNo = 1)
	begin
		set @PartStart = @Part1Start
		set @PartLen = @Part1Len
	end

	IF (@PartNo = 2)
	begin
		set @PartStart = @Part2Start
		set @PartLen = @Part2Len
	end

	IF (@PartNo = 3)
	begin
		set @PartStart = @Part3Start
		set @PartLen = @Part3Len
	end

	IF (@PartNo = 4)
	begin
		set @PartStart = @Part4Start
		set @PartLen = @Part4Len
	end	
End

Create PROCEDURE acc.SpVch_FinishingDoc_AccState 	
AS
BEGIN
IF (select COUNT(*) from acc.tblAccState )>1
			BEGIN

---  برای اسناد حسابداری حقوق دستمزد 
		update acc.tblVoucherDtl
		set SourceSerialNo= cast( Substring(DocDate,6,2)  as int)
		--select  cast( Substring(DocDate,6,2)  as int)  from acc.tblVoucherDtl
		where SourceProcessID in (315,320,325)
		and SourceSerialNo=0


				 exec acc.UpdateAlltblVoucher2AccState
					CREATE TABLE #tmpAcc
								(
									AcntCode Varchar(20)  collate arabic_cs_as,
									Debit Float ,
									Credit Float,
									VisitorAcntCode varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as 
								)
								
								
				insert into 	#tmpAcc	(AcntCode,Debit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
				EXEC acc.SpAcc_AccState '',1,0,0,0,0,'True'

				insert into 	#tmpAcc	(AcntCode,Credit,VisitorAcntCode) 		 
				EXEC acc.SpAcc_AccState '',2,0,0,0,0,'True'
				
				update #tmpAcc
				set Debit=ISNULL(Debit,0),Credit=ISNULL(Credit,0)

				delete from #tmpAcc
				where AcntCode not in (
				 select Distinct  AcntCode
				 from #tmpAcc
				 where	  --AcntCode='211208 01 1 15012080'  and 
				 VisitorAcntCode<>''
				)

				select b.AcntCode from  
				(
					select AcntCode,Sum(Debit)-Sum(Credit) Debit--,Sum(Credit) Credit
					from #tmpAcc
					Group by AcntCode
				) a inner join 
				(
					select	D.AcntCode,isnull(sum(D.Debit - D.Credit), 0) AS NativeRemain
					from	acc.tblVoucherDtl D 
					where	(D.VchKind <> 0) 
					group by D.AcntCode
					having sum(D.Debit - D.Credit) <> 0
				) b on a.AcntCode=b.AcntCode
				where a.Debit<>b.NativeRemain

	end 	
	end

CREATE FUNCTION acc.funGetBeforeLayerLen
(
	@Code varchar(30),
	@partNumber as tinyint
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @Result as int
	DECLARE @l1 as int
	DECLARE @l2 as int
	DECLARE @l3 as int
	DECLARE @l4 as int
	DECLARE @l5 as int
	DECLARE @l6 as int
	DECLARE @l7 as int
	DECLARE @l8 as int
	DECLARE @l9 as int

	SELECT 
		@l1 = sum(Layer1) ,
		@l2 = sum(Layer1+Layer2) ,
		@l3 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3) ,
		@l4 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4) ,
		@l5 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5) ,
		@l6 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6) ,
		@l7 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7) ,
		@l8 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7+Layer8),
		@l9 = sum(Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7+Layer8+Layer9) 
	FROM pub.tblCodeLayer where PartNumber = @partNumber AND TableName = 'acc.tblAcnt'

	IF LEN(@Code) = @l9
		SET @Result = @l8
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l8
		SET @Result = @l7
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l7
		SET @Result = @l6
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l6
		SET @Result = @l5
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l5
		SET @Result = @l4
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l4
		SET @Result = @l3
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l3
		SET @Result = @l2
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l2
		SET @Result = @l1
	IF LEN(@Code) = @l1
		SET @Result = 0
		
	RETURN @Result

END

CREATE FUNCTION [acc].[funGetServiceName](@StrCode VarChar(20), @LanguageID AS TinyInt) 
		RETURNS  NVarChar(50) 
		--WITH ENCRYPTION
		AS 
           BEGIN 
              
				Declare @ReturnValue AS NVarChar(50) 
				Declare @intLen	AS Int 
				
				Set @intLen = Len(@StrCode) 
				SET @ReturnValue = ''
			
				IF @intLen <= 20 
				  BEGIN 
					Select @ReturnValue = ServiceName 
					From acc.tblServiceCodingDtl 
					Where PartNumber = 1 AND ServiceID = Substring(@StrCode, 1, 20) AND LanguageID = @LanguageID 
				  END
				  
				ELSE IF @intLen <= 21 
				  BEGIN 
					Select @ReturnValue = ServiceName 
					From acc.tblServiceCodingDtl
					Where PartNumber = 2 AND ServiceID = Substring(@StrCode, 22, 0) AND LanguageID = @LanguageID 
				  END 
				  
				ELSE IF @intLen <= 22 
				  BEGIN 
					Select	@ReturnValue = ServiceName 
					From acc.tblServiceCodingDtl
					Where PartNumber = 3 AND ServiceID = Substring(@StrCode, 23, 0) AND LanguageID = @LanguageID 
				  END
				   
				ELSE -- Part 4
				  BEGIN 
					Select	@ReturnValue = ServiceName 
					From acc.tblServiceCodingDtl 
					Where	PartNumber = 4 AND ServiceID = Substring(@StrCode, 24, 0) AND LanguageID = @LanguageID 
				End 

   			Return @ReturnValue; 
           End

-- =============================================
-- Author		: TakroSystem\ Ahmadnejad
-- Create date	: 1387-04-30 
-- Description	: Full Acnt Name
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [acc].[funPartAcntFullName]
(
	@AcntCode	VarChar(20),
	@PartNumber int
) 
RETURNS NVarChar(300)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @StrTempName NVarChar(50)
DECLARE @StrFullName NVarChar(300)
DECLARE @LayerLan int

	declare @tblLayers table
	(
		ID		int,
		Layer	int
	);
	
	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 1, Layer1
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer1<>0)
	
	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 2, Layer1+Layer2
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer2<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 3, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer3<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 4, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer4<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 5, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer5<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 6, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer6<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 7, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer7<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 8, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7+Layer8
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer8<>0)

	insert into @tblLayers(ID, Layer)
	select 9, Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7+Layer8+Layer9
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where (TableName='acc.tblAcnt') AND (PartNumber=@PartNumber) and (Layer9<>0)

	set @StrFullName = ''

	DECLARE csr_codes CURSOR FOR
		SELECT Layer
		FROM @tblLayers
		order by ID
	
	OPEN csr_codes

	FETCH NEXT FROM csr_codes INTO @LayerLan

	WHILE (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
	BEGIN

		select @StrTempName = AcntName 
        from acc.tblAcntDtl 
        where AcntCode = substring(@AcntCode, 1, @LayerLan) AND (PartNumber = @PartNumber)
        
        if (@StrTempName is null) or (@StrTempName = '')
          break;
	
        if (@StrFullName <> '')
			set @StrFullName = @StrFullName + ' > '

		set @StrFullName = @StrFullName + @StrTempName

		FETCH NEXT FROM csr_codes INTO @LayerLan
	END

	CLOSE		csr_codes
	DEALLOCATE	csr_codes

	RETURN @StrFullName
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_Sale_Order_Analysis
     @FiscalYear   Int           = 0,
     @SerialNo     Int           = 0,
     @DocDate_From Char(10)      = '',
     @DocDate_To   Char(10)      = '',
     @AcntCode     VarChar(20)   = '',
     @GoodsID      VarChar(20)   = '',
     @All_Orders   Bit           = 0
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect_1 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_3 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_1  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_2  NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = ''
	SET @StrSelect_2 = ''
	SET @StrSelect_3 = ''
	SET @StrWhere_1    = '1 = 1'
	SET @StrWhere_2    = '1 = 1'

	-- ===================================================================================
	DECLARE @Current_FiscalYear Int;
	DECLARE @StrTakroDB         NVarchar(200);


	Select @Current_FiscalYear = FiscalYear From TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_0000.pub.tblFiscalYears Where IsDefault = 1

	SET @StrTakroDB = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Current_FiscalYear))) + '.'

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @FiscalYear Is Not Null And @FiscalYear > 0
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '
      And SH.FiscalYear IN(' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + ')'

	IF @SerialNo Is Not Null And @SerialNo > 0
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '
      And SH.SerialNo   IN(' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNo))) + ')'

	IF @DocDate_From <> '' And @DocDate_From Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
      And SH.DocDate    >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDate_From)) + ''''

	IF @DocDate_To <> '' And @DocDate_To Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
      And SH.DocDate    <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDate_To)) + ''''

	IF @AcntCode <> '' And @AcntCode Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
      And SubString(SD.AcntCode, 7, 20) IN(''' + LTrim(RTrim(@AcntCode)) + ''')'

	IF @GoodsID <> '' And @GoodsID Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
      And SD.GoodsID    IN(''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID)) + ''')'

	IF @All_Orders = 0 OR @All_Orders Is Null
		SET @StrWhere_2 = @StrWhere_2 + '  
      And Order_Qty - Cancel_Qty - Sale_Qty > 0'

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = '
	-- =================================================================================== Pakat_List
	IF OBJECT_ID(''#tbl_Pakat_List'') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbl_Pakat_List;

	-- ==========================================
	Select GoodsID--, *, (Select Count(GoodsID) From inv.tblGoods Where GoodsID Like G.GoodsID + ''%'' And Len(GoodsID) > Len(G.GoodsID))
	INTO   #tbl_Pakat_List
	From ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.tblGoodsDtl G
	Where GoodsName Like N''پاکت%'' And SubString(GoodsID, 1, 2) IN(''22'', ''24'')
	  And (Select Count(GoodsID) From ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.tblGoods Where GoodsID Like G.GoodsID + ''%'' And Len(GoodsID) > Len(G.GoodsID)) = 0

	-- =================================================================================== SELECT
	SELECT  
           SerialNo, GoodsID, GoodsName, GoodsGroupID, Goods_Grp_Name, Order_Date, CustomerCode, CustomerName, CountryCode, CountryName, Order_Qty, Cancel_Qty,
           Sale_Qty, Sale_Order_Remain, Product_Remain, Formula_Selphon_Qty, Round(Cast(Selphon_Remain AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) Selphon_Remain, Formula_Carton_Qty, 
           Round(Cast(Carton_Remain AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) Carton_Remain, Formula_Jaabeh_Qty, Round(Cast(Jaabeh_Remain AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) Jaabeh_Remain, 
           Formula_Pakat_Qty, Round(Cast(Pakat_Remain AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) Pakat_Remain, Round(Cast(Prd_Order_Remain AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) Prd_Order_Remain,
           Product_Remain - Sale_Order_Remain Product_Shortage, 
           Round(Cast(Selphon_Remain / Case When Formula_Selphon_Qty > 0 Then Formula_Selphon_Qty Else 1 End AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Selphon_Sufficient, 
           Round(Cast(Carton_Remain / Case When Formula_Carton_Qty > 0 Then Formula_Carton_Qty Else 1 End  AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Carton_Sufficient, 
           Round(Cast(Jaabeh_Remain / Case When Formula_Jaabeh_Qty > 0 Then Formula_Jaabeh_Qty Else 1 End AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Jaabeh_Sufficient, 
           Round(Cast(Pakat_Remain / Case When Formula_Pakat_Qty > 0 Then Formula_Pakat_Qty Else 1 End AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Pakat_Sufficient
	FROM
	(
     Select SH.SerialNo, SD.GoodsID, G1.GoodsName, SubString(SubString(SD.GoodsID, 1, 4), 3, 4) GoodsGroupID, G2.GoodsName Goods_Grp_Name, SH.DocDate Order_Date, 
			SubString(SH.AcntCode, 7, 20) CustomerCode, CU.AcntName CustomerName, SubString(SH.AcntCode, 7, 2) CountryCode, AD.AcntName CountryName,
			Round(Cast(Sum(SD.GoodsQuantity) AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Order_Qty, 
			Round(Cast(Sum(IsNull(CS.GoodsQuantity, 0)) AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Cancel_Qty, 
			Round(Cast(Sum(IsNull(S.GoodsQuantity, 0)) AS Decimal(18, 0)), 0) AS Sale_Qty, 
			Sum(SD.GoodsQuantity) - Sum(S.GoodsQuantity) - Sum(CS.GoodsQuantity) Sale_Order_Remain, 
            ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, SD.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, SD.GoodsID, Null, ''1407/12/29'', 0) AS Product_Remain,
			Sum(IsNull(F1.SubUnitQuantity, 0)) + Sum(IsNull(F2.SubUnitQuantity, 0)) Formula_Selphon_Qty,
            ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, SD.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, F1.GoodsID, Null, ''1407/12/29'', 0) +
            ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, SD.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, F2.GoodsID, Null, ''1407/12/29'', 0) AS Selphon_Remain,
			Sum(IsNull(F3.SubUnitQuantity, 0)) Formula_Carton_Qty,
            ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, SD.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, F3.GoodsID, Null, ''1407/12/29'', 0) AS Carton_Remain,'
     SET @StrSelect_2 = '
			Sum(IsNull(F4.SubUnitQuantity, 0)) Formula_Jaabeh_Qty,
            ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, SD.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, F4.GoodsID, Null, ''1407/12/29'', 0) AS Jaabeh_Remain,
			Sum(IsNull(F5.SubUnitQuantity, 0)) Formula_Pakat_Qty,
            ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, SD.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, F5.GoodsID, Null, ''1407/12/29'', 0) AS Pakat_Remain,
            IsNull(Prd_OrderCount, 0) Prd_Order_Remain
     From       ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'sal.tblSaleOrderHdr  SH
     Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'sal.tblSaleOrderDtl  SD ON SH.ProcessID = SD.ProcessID And SH.ProcessNo = SD.ProcessNo And SH.FiscalYear = SD.FiscalYear And SH.SerialNo = SD.SerialNo
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'sal.tblSaleOrderDtl  CS ON CS.BaseProcessID = SD.ProcessID And CS.BaseProcessNo = SD.ProcessNo And
                                                                            CS.BaseFiscalYear = SD.FiscalYear And CS.BaseSerialNo = SD.SerialNo And CS.BaseDocRowNo = SD.DocRowNo
     Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.tblGoodsDtl      G1 ON G1.GoodsID = SD.GoodsID
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.tblGoodsDtl      G2 ON G2.GoodsID = SubString(SD.GoodsID, 1, 4)
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S ON S.BaseProcessID = SD.ProcessID And S.BaseProcessNo = SD.ProcessNo And S.BaseFiscalYear = SD.FiscalYear And S.BaseSerialNo = SD.SerialNo And S.BaseDocRowNo = SD.DocRowNo
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'prd.tblFormulasHdr   FH ON FH.ProductID = SD.GoodsID And FH.IsDefault = 1
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'prd.tblFormulasDtl   F1 ON F1.SerialNo = FH.SerialNo And F1.ProductID = FH.ProductID And SubString(F1.GoodsID, 1, 2) = ''22'' And F1.GoodsID Not IN(Select * From #tbl_Pakat_List)
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'prd.tblFormulasDtl   F2 ON F2.SerialNo = FH.SerialNo And F2.ProductID = FH.ProductID And SubString(F2.GoodsID, 1, 2) = ''24'' And F2.GoodsID Not IN(Select * From #tbl_Pakat_List)
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'prd.tblFormulasDtl   F3 ON F3.SerialNo = FH.SerialNo And F3.ProductID = FH.ProductID And SubString(F3.GoodsID, 1, 2) = ''23''
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'prd.tblFormulasDtl   F4 ON F4.SerialNo = FH.SerialNo And F4.ProductID = FH.ProductID And SubString(F4.GoodsID, 1, 4) = ''2103''
     Left  Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'prd.tblFormulasDtl   F5 ON F5.SerialNo = FH.SerialNo And F5.ProductID = FH.ProductID And F5.GoodsID IN(Select * From #tbl_Pakat_List)
     Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'acc.tblAcntDtl       AD ON AD.AcntCode = SubString(SH.AcntCode, 7, 2) And AD.PartNumber = 2
     Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'acc.tblAcntDtl       CU ON CU.AcntCode = SubString(SH.AcntCode, 7, 20) And CU.PartNumber = 2'
     SET @StrSelect_3 = '
     Left  Join
     (
      Select H.ProductID, Sum(H.OrderCount) Prd_OrderCount
      From       ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'pln.tblTaskOrderHdr H
      Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrTakroDB)) + 'pln.tblProduceOrderDtl P ON P.ProcessID = H.BaseProcessID And P.ProcessNo = H.BaseProcessNo And 
                                                                              P.FiscalYear = H.BaseFiscalYear And P.SerialNo = H.BaseSerialNo And P.DocRowNo = H.BaseDocRowNo
      Where 1 = 1
        And H.ProcessID  = 610
        And H.ProcessNo  = 1
        And H.FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + '
        And H.TaskStateID < 4
        --And H.ProductID  = SD.GoodsID
        --And H.SerialNo   IN(12149, 13149)
        Group By H.ProductID
      ) Pln ON Pln.ProductID = SD.GoodsID
      Where ' + @StrWhere_1 + '
      Group By SD.FiscalYear, SH.SerialNo, SD.DocRowNo, SD.GoodsID, G1.GoodsName, SubString(SubString(SD.GoodsID, 1, 11), 3, 11), SH.AcntCode, AD.AcntName, CU.AcntName,
               G2.GoodsName, SH.DocDate, F1.GoodsID, F2.GoodsID, F3.GoodsID, F4.GoodsID, F5.GoodsID, Prd_OrderCount
	) A
	Where ' + @StrWhere_2 + '
	Order By A.Order_Date, A.SerialNo
	'

	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect_1
	PRINT @StrSelect_2
	PRINT @StrSelect_3

	SET   @StrSelect_1 = @StrSelect_1 + @StrSelect_2 + @StrSelect_3;
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams
	AS
	BEGIN

		CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams
		(
			name sysname NOT NULL,
			principal_id int NOT NULL,	-- we may change it to varbinary(85)
			diagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY,
			version int,
	
			definition varbinary(max)

			(

			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties

				[principal_id],
				[version],
				[definition]
			)
			select	 
				convert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]),
				DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),			-- will change to the sid of sa
				0,							-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version],
				dgdef.[lvalue]
			from dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]	
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]
				
			where dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_' 
			return 2;
		end
		return 1;
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagrams
	(
		@diagramname sysname = NULL,
		@owner_id int = NULL
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @user sysname
		DECLARE @dboLogin bit
		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
			SET @user = USER_NAME();
			SET @dboLogin = CONVERT(bit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner'));
		REVERT;
		SELECT
			[Database] = DB_NAME(),
			[Name] = name,
			[ID] = diagram_id,
			[Owner] = USER_NAME(principal_id),
			[OwnerID] = principal_id
		FROM
			sysdiagrams
		WHERE
			(@dboLogin = 1 OR USER_NAME(principal_id) = @user) AND
			(@diagramname IS NULL OR name = @diagramname) AND
			(@owner_id IS NULL OR principal_id = @owner_id)
		ORDER BY
			4, 5, 1
	END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_Sale_Baling
     @FiscalYear   Int           = 0,
     @SerialNo     Int           = 0,
     @DocDate_From Char(10)      = '',
     @DocDate_To   Char(10)      = '',
     @GoodsID      VarChar(20)   = '',
     @GoodsName    NVarChar(Max) = '',
     @DriverName   NVarChar(Max) = '',
     @DST_Country  VarChar(20)   = ''
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect_1  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere    NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1  = ''
	SET @StrSelect_2  = ''
	SET @StrWhere     = '1 = 1'

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @FiscalYear Is Not Null And @FiscalYear > 0
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '
		  And H.FiscalYear IN(' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + ')'

	IF @SerialNo Is Not Null And @SerialNo > 0
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '
		  And H.SerialNo   IN(' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNo))) + ')'

	IF @DocDate_From <> '' And @DocDate_From Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
		  And H.DocDate    >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDate_From)) + ''''

	IF @DocDate_To <> '' And @DocDate_To Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
		  And H.DocDate    <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDate_To)) + ''''

	IF @GoodsID <> '' And @GoodsID Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
		  And D.GoodsID    IN(''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID)) + ''')'

	IF @GoodsName <> '' And @GoodsName Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
		  And D.GoodsName  Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsName)) + '%'''

	IF @DriverName <> '' And @DriverName Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
		  And H.DriverName Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@DriverName)) + '%'''

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = '
		Select H.FiscalYear, H.SerialNo, H.DocDate, H.Takro_SN_1, H.Takro_SN_2, H.DriverName, H.Driver_NID, H.CarNo, H.DriverMobile, 
			   A.AcntName DST_Country, H.BorderTerminal, D.RowNo, D.GoodsID, D.GoodsName, D.Prd_License, D.Produce_Date, D.Expire_Date, D.CartonQty, 
			   D.QtyPerCarton, Cast(D.RowGrossWeight As Decimal(18, 2)) RowGrossWeight, D.CurrencyUnitValue, 
			   Cast((D.RowGrossWeight * 0.95) As Decimal(18, 2)) Total_NetWeight,
			   Cast((D.RowGrossWeight * 0.95) * D.CurrencyUnitValue As Decimal(18, 2)) Total_Currency_Amount,
			   Cast((((D.RowGrossWeight / D.CartonQty) / D.QtyPerCarton) * 1000) As Decimal(18, 2)) Unit_Weight,
			   Case When SubString(D.GoodsID, 3, 2) IN(''01'', ''02'', ''03'', ''05'') Then ''01'' Else SubString(D.GoodsID, 3, 2) End Goods_Group
		From       dbo.Oth_Sale_Baling_Hdr H
		Inner Join dbo.Oth_Sale_Baling_Dtl D ON H.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear And H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
		Left  Join (Select *
		            From TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_1404.acc.tblAcntDtl
					Where PartNumber = 2 And SubString(AcntCode, 1, 1) = ''3'' And Len(AcntCode) = 2) A 
					                     ON A.PartNumber = 2 And SubString(A.AcntCode, 1, 2) = H.DST_Country COLLATE Arabic_CS_AS
		Where ' + @StrWhere + '
        ORDER BY H.FiscalYear, H.SerialNo, H.DocDate
		'
	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect_1
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Product_Goods_Report_Karton_Jaabe_Selfon
	@GoodsID	  VarChar(20) = '',
	@DocDateFr    Char(10)    = '',
	@DocDateTo    Char(10)    = '',
	@Status       Int         = 0,
	@Test         Bit         = 0
	
	-- ===== @Status 0 = All
	-- ===== @Status 1 = Only Produced
	-- ===== @Status 2 = Only Not_Produced	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Drop Temp Tables
	-- ==========================================================================
	Begin Try
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_1
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_2
	End Try
	Begin Catch
	End Catch

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_Prds_List
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
	(
		GoodsID	    VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodsName	NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		UnitName	NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Remain		Decimal(28,9),
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_Prds_List (GoodsID, GoodsName, UnitName, Remain)
	Select G.GoodsID, GD.GoodsName, UD.UnitName,
		   [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/01/01', 0) Remain
	From inv.tblGoods G
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl GD ON G.GoodsID   = GD.GoodsID
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl UD ON G.UnitID = UD.UnitID
	Where 1 = 1
		And Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then G.GoodsID Else '' End = Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then @GoodsID Else '' End
		And SUBSTRING(G.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('21', '22', '23', '24', '25', '26')
		And Len(G.GoodsID) >= 6
		And G.CodeClosed    = 0
		And (Select Count(GoodsID) 
			 From inv.tblGoods 
			 Where 1 = 1
				And SubString(GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('21', '22', '23', '24', '25', '26') 
				And SubString(GoodsID, 1, Len(G.GoodsID)) = G.GoodsID 
				And GoodsID <> G.GoodsID
			) = 0
	Order By G.GoodsID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_1
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_1
	(
		GoodsID	      VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		BuySerialNo	  Int,
		BuyDocDate	  Char(10),
		GoodsQuantity Decimal(28,9),
		UnitName	  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_1 (GoodsID, BuySerialNo, BuyDocDate, GoodsQuantity, UnitName)
	Select S.GoodsID, S.SerialNo BuySerialNo, S.DocDate BuyDocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UD.UnitName
	From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl     UD ON S.SubUnitID = UD.UnitID
	Where 1 = 1
		And ProcessID    IN (55)
		--And SerialNo IN (1347)
		And Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then S.GoodsID Else '' End IN (Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then @GoodsID Else '' End)
		And Case When @DocDateFr <> '' Then S.DocDate Else '' End >= Case When @DocDateFr <> '' Then @DocDateFr Else '' End
		And Case When @DocDateTo <> '' Then S.DocDate Else '' End <= Case When @DocDateTo <> '' Then @DocDateTo Else '' End	
		And S.DocDate = (
						 Select Max(DocDate) 
						 From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
						 Where 1 = 1
							 And ProcessID IN (55) 
							 And GoodsID = S.GoodsID
						)
		And SUBSTRING(S.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('21', '22', '23', '24', '25', '26')
	Group By S.GoodsID, S.SerialNo, S.DocDate, UD.UnitName
	Order By S.GoodsID, DocDate

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_2
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_2
	(
		GoodsID	      VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		PrdSerialNo	  Int,
		PrdDocDate	  Char(10),
		GoodsQuantity Decimal(28,9),
		UnitName	  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_2 (GoodsID, PrdSerialNo, PrdDocDate, GoodsQuantity, UnitName)
	Select S.GoodsID, S.BaseSerialNo, S.DocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UD.UnitName
	From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl UD ON S.SubUnitID = UD.UnitID
	Where 1 = 1
		And ProcessID    IN (82)
		And BaseProcessID = 610
		--And BaseSerialNo IN (1347)
		--And Case When @GoodsID   <> '' Then S.GoodsID Else '' End IN (Case When @GoodsID   <> '' Then @GoodsID   Else '' End)
		And Case When @DocDateFr <> '' Then S.DocDate Else '' End >=  Case When @DocDateFr <> '' Then @DocDateFr Else '' End
		And Case When @DocDateTo <> '' Then S.DocDate Else '' End <=  Case When @DocDateTo <> '' Then @DocDateTo Else '' End	
		And S.DocDate = (
						 Select Max(DocDate) 
						 From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
						 Where 1 = 1
							 And ProcessID IN (82) 
							 And BaseProcessID = 610
							 And GoodsID = S.GoodsID
						)
		And SUBSTRING(S.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('21', '22', '23', '24', '25', '26')
	Group By S.GoodsID, S.BaseSerialNo, S.DocDate, UD.UnitName
	Order By S.GoodsID, DocDate

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Last SELECT
	-- ==========================================================================
	IF @Test = 0
	Begin
		Select P.GoodsID, P.GoodsName, 
			   Case When SubString(P.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN('21', '26') Then
						'جعبه'
					When SubString(P.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN('22', '24') Then
						'سلفون'
					When SubString(P.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN('23', '25') Then
						'کارتن'
				End Category,
			   LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.BuyDocDate, '0000/00/00'))) Last_Buy_Date,
			   LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (T1.BuyDocDate), '0000/00/00'))) Last_Buy_Date_Grg,
			   IsNull(T1.GoodsQuantity, 0) Last_Buy_Qty,
			   LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T2.PrdDocDate, '0000/00/00'))) Last_Prd_Date,
			   LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (T2.PrdDocDate), '0000/00/00'))) Last_Prd_Date_Grg,
			   IsNull(T2.GoodsQuantity, 0) Last_Prd_Qty, IsNull(P.Remain, 0) Remain--, P.UnitName
		From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List P
		Left Join 
			(
			 Select GoodsID, BuyDocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UnitName
			 From ##Temp_Table_1
			 Group By GoodsID, BuyDocDate, UnitName
			) T1 ON T1.GoodsID = P.GoodsID

		Left Join 
			(
			 Select GoodsID, PrdDocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UnitName
			 From ##Temp_Table_2
			 Group By GoodsID, PrdDocDate, UnitName
			) T2 ON T2.GoodsID = P.GoodsID

		Where 1 = 1
			And SUBSTRING(P.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('21', '22', '23', '24', '25', '26')
	
			And 
				Case When @Status = 0 Then 
						'' 
					 When @Status = 2 Then 
						LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.BuyDocDate, ''))) 
					 Else 
						'' 
				End = ''

			And Case When @Status = 0 Then 
						'' 
					 When @Status = 2 Then 
						LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T2.PrdDocDate, ''))) 
					 Else 
						'' 
				End = ''

			And 
				(
					Case When @Status = 1 Then 
							LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.BuyDocDate, ''))) 
						 When @Status <> 0 And @Status <> 2 Then 
							'1' 
						 Else 
							'1' 
					End <> ''
					OR 
					Case When @Status = 1 Then 
							LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T2.PrdDocDate, ''))) 
						 When @Status <> 0 And @Status <> 2 Then 
							'1' 
						 Else 
							'1' 
					End <> ''
				)
			And P.Remain > 0

		Order By P.GoodsID
	End

	-- ================================ Select Products Whith Last Prd_Info
	--Select T1.ProductID, T1.ProductName, T1.DocDate Last_Prd_Date, T1.GoodsQuantity Last_Prd_Qty, 
	--	   T1.UnitName, T1.Remain ProductRemain, 
	--	   IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') Selfon_ID, IsNull(T2.GoodsName, '') Selfon_Name, IsNull(T2.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain,
	--	   IsNull(T3.GoodsID, '') Karton_ID, IsNull(T3.GoodsName, '') Karton_Name, IsNull(T3.Remain, 0) Karton_Remain,
	--	   IsNull(T4.GoodsID, '') Jaabe_ID,  IsNull(T4.GoodsName, '') Jaabe_Name,  IsNull(T4.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain
	--From  ##Temp_Table_1 T1
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_2 T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_3 T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_4 T4 ON T1.ProductID = T4.ProductID

	-- ================================ Test
	IF @Test = 1
	Begin
		Select * From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List

		--Select GoodsID, BuyDocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UnitName
		--From ##Temp_Table_1
		--Group By GoodsID, BuyDocDate, UnitName

		--Select GoodsID, PrdDocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UnitName
		--From ##Temp_Table_2
		--Group By GoodsID, PrdDocDate, UnitName

		Select * From ##Temp_Table_1
		Select * From ##Temp_Table_2

	End
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Produce_Report_With_Formula_Goods_3 -- ======= برای کلیه کالاها
	@ProductID	  VarChar(20) = '',
	@DocDateFr    Char(10)    = '',
	@DocDateTo    Char(10)    = '',
	@Status       Int         = 0,
	@Test         Bit         = 0
	
	-- ===== @Status 0 = All
	-- ===== @Status 1 = Only Produced
	-- ===== @Status 2 = Only Not_Produced	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Drop Temp Tables
	-- ==========================================================================
	Begin Try
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_1
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_2
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_3
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_4
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_5
	End Try
	Begin Catch
	End Catch

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_Prds_List
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
	(
		ProductID	VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ProductName	NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		UnitName	NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Remain		Decimal(28,9),
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_Prds_List (ProductID, ProductName, UnitName, Remain)
	Select G.GoodsID, GD.GoodsName, UD.UnitName,
		   [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/01/01', 0) Remain
	From inv.tblGoods G
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl GD ON G.GoodsID   = GD.GoodsID
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl UD ON G.UnitID = UD.UnitID
	Where 1 = 1
		And Case When @ProductID <> '' Then G.GoodsID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> '' Then @ProductID Else '' End)
		And SubString(G.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
		And Len(G.GoodsID) = 14
		And G.CodeClosed   = 0
	Order By G.GoodsID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_1
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_1
	(
		ProductID	  VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		FormulaNo	  Int,
		DocDate		  Char(10),
		GoodsQuantity Decimal(28,9),
		UnitName	  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_1 (ProductID, FormulaNo, DocDate, GoodsQuantity, UnitName)
	Select S.GoodsID, FH.SerialNo FormulaNo, S.DocDate, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UD.UnitName
	From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl     UD ON S.SubUnitID = UD.UnitID
	Inner Join prd.tblFormulasHdr FH ON S.GoodsID   = FH.ProductID And FH.IsDefault = 1
	Where 1 = 1
		And ProcessID    IN (72, 82)
		And BaseProcessID = 610
		--And BaseSerialNo IN (1347)
		And Case When @ProductID <> '' Then ProductID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> '' Then @ProductID Else '' End)
		And Case When @DocDateFr <> '' Then S.DocDate Else '' End >=  Case When @DocDateFr <> '' Then @DocDateFr Else '' End
		And Case When @DocDateTo <> '' Then S.DocDate Else '' End <=  Case When @DocDateTo <> '' Then @DocDateTo Else '' End	
		And S.DocDate	   = (
							  Select Max(DocDate) 
							  From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
							  Where 1 = 1
								  And ProcessID IN (72) 
								  And BaseProcessID = 610
								  And GoodsID = S.GoodsID
							 )
		And SubString(S.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
	Group By S.GoodsID, FH.SerialNo, S.DocDate, UD.UnitName
	Order By S.GoodsID, DocDate

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_2
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_2
	(
		ProductID		VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		FormulaNo		Int,
		GoodsID			VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodsName		NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodsQuantity	Decimal(28,9),
		UnitName		NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Remain			Decimal(28,9),
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_2 (ProductID, FormulaNo, GoodsID, GoodsName, GoodsQuantity, UnitName, Remain)
	Select FD.ProductID, FH.SerialNo FormulaNo, FD.GoodsID, GD2.GoodsName, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UD.UnitName,
		   [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, FD.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/01/01', 0) Remain
	From prd.tblFormulasDtl    FD
	Inner Join prd.tblFormulasHdr FH  ON FH.ProductID = FD.ProductID And FH.SerialNo = FD.SerialNo And FH.IsDefault = 1
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl    GD2 ON FD.GoodsID   = GD2.GoodsID
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl    UD  ON FD.UnitID    = UD.UnitID
	Where 1 = 1
		And Case When @ProductID <> '' Then FD.ProductID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> '' Then @ProductID Else '' End)
		And SubString(FD.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
		And SubString(FD.GoodsID, 1, 2)   IN ('22', '24')
	Group By FD.ProductID, UD.UnitName, FH.SerialNo, FD.GoodsID, GD2.GoodsName
	Order By FD.ProductID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_3
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_3
	(
		ProductID		VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		FormulaNo		Int,
		GoodsID			VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodsName		NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodsQuantity	Decimal(28,9),
		UnitName		NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Remain			Decimal(28,9),
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_3 (ProductID, FormulaNo, GoodsID, GoodsName, GoodsQuantity, UnitName, Remain)
	Select FD.ProductID, FH.SerialNo FormulaNo, FD.GoodsID, GD2.GoodsName, Sum(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity, UD.UnitName,
		   [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, FD.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/01/01', 0) Remain
	From prd.tblFormulasDtl    FD
	Inner Join prd.tblFormulasHdr FH  ON FH.ProductID = FD.ProductID And FH.SerialNo = FD.SerialNo And FH.IsDefault = 1
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl    GD2 ON FD.GoodsID   = GD2.GoodsID
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl    UD  ON FD.UnitID    = UD.UnitID
	Where 1 = 1
		And Case When @ProductID <> '' Then FD.ProductID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> '' Then @ProductID Else '' End)
		And SubString(FD.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
		And SubString(FD.GoodsID, 1, 2)   IN ('23', '25')
	Group By FD.ProductID, UD.UnitName, FH.SerialNo, FD.GoodsID, GD2.GoodsName
	Order By FD.ProductID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_4

			And IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') Is Not Null And IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') <> ''
