	Group By FD.ProductID, UD.UnitName, FH.SerialNo, FD.GoodsID, GD2.GoodsName
	Order By FD.ProductID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Last SELECT
	-- ==========================================================================
	IF @Test = 0
	Begin
		Select P.ProductID, P.ProductName, 
			   LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.DocDate, '0000/00/00'))) Last_Prd_Date,
			   LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (T1.DocDate), '0000/00/00'))) Last_Prd_Date_Grg,
			   IsNull(T1.GoodsQuantity, 0) Last_Prd_Qty,
			   IsNull(P.UnitName, '') UnitName, P.Remain ProductRemain, 
			   IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') Selfon_ID, IsNull(T2.GoodsName, '') Selfon_Name, IsNull(T2.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain,
			   IsNull(T3.GoodsID, '') Karton_ID, IsNull(T3.GoodsName, '') Karton_Name, IsNull(T3.Remain, 0) Karton_Remain,
			   IsNull(T4.GoodsID, '') Jaabe_ID,  IsNull(T4.GoodsName, '') Jaabe_Name,  IsNull(T4.Remain, 0) Jaabe_Remain
		From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List P
		Left Join ##Temp_Table_1 T1 ON T1.ProductID = P.ProductID
		Left Join ##Temp_Table_2 T2 ON T2.ProductID = P.ProductID
		Left Join ##Temp_Table_3 T3 ON T3.ProductID = P.ProductID
		Left Join ##Temp_Table_4 T4 ON T4.ProductID = P.ProductID
		Where 1 = 1
			And SubString(P.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
	
			And Case When @Status = 0 Then 
						'' 
					 When @Status = 2 Then 
						LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.DocDate, ''))) 
					 Else 
						''
				End = ''

			And Case When @Status = 1 Then 
						LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.DocDate, ''))) 
					 When @Status <> 0 And @Status <> 2 Then 
						'1' 
					 Else 
						'1' 
				End <> ''

		Order By P.ProductID
	End

	-- ================================ Select Products Whith Last Prd_Info
	--Select T1.ProductID, T1.ProductName, T1.DocDate Last_Prd_Date, T1.GoodsQuantity Last_Prd_Qty, 
	--	   T1.UnitName, T1.Remain ProductRemain, 
	--	   IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') Selfon_ID, IsNull(T2.GoodsName, '') Selfon_Name, IsNull(T2.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain,
	--	   IsNull(T3.GoodsID, '') Karton_ID, IsNull(T3.GoodsName, '') Karton_Name, IsNull(T3.Remain, 0) Karton_Remain,
	--	   IsNull(T4.GoodsID, '') Jaabe_ID,  IsNull(T4.GoodsName, '') Jaabe_Name,  IsNull(T4.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain
	--From  ##Temp_Table_1 T1
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_2 T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_3 T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_4 T4 ON T1.ProductID = T4.ProductID

	-- ================================ Test
	IF @Test = 1
	Begin
		Select * From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
		--Select * From ##Temp_Table_1
		--Select * From ##Temp_Table_2
		--Select * From ##Temp_Table_3
		--Select * From ##Temp_Table_4
	End
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.SP_Update_StoreTransfer
	@FiscalYear   Int	   = 0,
	@SerialNoFr   Int	   = 0,	
	@SerialNoTo   Int	   = 0,	
	@DocDateFr    Char(10) = '',
	@DocDateTo    Char(10) = '',
	@DocStep      Int      = 0,
	@OP_TYPE      Int      = 0
	
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 0 = Select
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 1 = Update
AS

DECLARE @StrSelect_1 NVarchar(Max) = '';
DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max) = '';
DECLARE @StrWhere    NVarchar(Max) = '';

DECLARE @Current_FY	 Int;
DECLARE @Takro_DB    NVarchar(Max) = '';

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ====================================================
	Select @Current_FY = FiscalYear
	From  TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_0000.pub.tblFiscalYears
	Where IsDefault = 1

	-- ====================================================
    SET @Takro_DB = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear)))

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrWhere = '1 = 1
	     And ProcessID  IN(120, 125)
		 And ProcessNo  IN(2)'

    IF @FiscalYear <> 0 And @FiscalYear Is Not Null
       SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
	     And FiscalYear  = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear)))			
	
    IF @SerialNoFr <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
       SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		 And SerialNo   >= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoFr)))
			
    IF @SerialNoTo <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
       SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		 And SerialNo   <= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoTo)))
			
    IF @DocDateFr <> '' And @DocDateFr Is Not Null
       SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		 And DocDate    >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateFr)) + ''''
			
    IF @DocDateTo <> '' And @DocDateTo Is Not Null
       SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		 And DocDate    <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateTo)) + ''''

    IF @DocStep <> 0 And @DocStep Is Not Null
       SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		 And DocStep     = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@DocStep)))

    SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
	     And (
			   StoreID  IN(''0203'', ''0207'', ''0301'', ''0303'', ''0306'', ''0307'', ''0308'', ''0309'', ''0310'', ''0311'')
			   OR
			   StoreID2 IN(''0203'', ''0207'', ''0301'', ''0303'', ''0306'', ''0307'', ''0308'', ''0309'', ''0310'', ''0311'')
		     )
         '
	-- =============================================================================================================================
	-- ============================================================================================================================= UPDATE Store_Transfer 2
	-- =============================================================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = '    -- =========================================================== Hdr '
	SET @StrSelect_2 = '    -- =========================================================== Dtl '

	IF @OP_TYPE = 0 
	Begin
	   SET @StrSelect_1 = @StrSelect_1 + '
	   Select ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocStep, DocDate, StoreID, StoreID2, AcntCode, DocDate2, DocDate3, DocDate4, VchDate, 
              SessionNo, SessionNo2, SessionNo3, SessionNo4, SessionNo5, SgnSN1, SgnSN2, SgnSN3, SgnSN4, SgnSN5, TransferSerialNo, DocTime
	   From ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsHdr 
	   Where ' + @StrWhere

	   SET @StrSelect_2 = @StrSelect_2 + '
	   Select ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, VolumeRowNo, DocStep, DocDate, StoreID, PhysicallyEffected, EnterKind, 
	   	      StoreID2, AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode, OrderAcntCode, GoodsID, SubUnitID, SubUnitQuantity, GoodsQuantity, QtyRemain, GoodsAmount
	   From ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
	   Where ' + @StrWhere

	End
	ELSE
	Begin
	   SET @StrSelect_1 = @StrSelect_1 + '
	   UPDATE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsHdr SET DocStep =  DocStep + 1, SessionNo2 = SessionNo
	   Where ' + @StrWhere

	   SET @StrSelect_2 = @StrSelect_2 + '
	   UPDATE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl SET DocStep =  DocStep + 1 
	   Where ' + @StrWhere
	End

	-- ================================================ EXEC
    PRINT @StrSelect_1
    PRINT @StrSelect_2
	SET   @StrSelect_1 = @StrSelect_1 + @StrSelect_2

	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

END

CREATE PROC dbo.SP_ReNew_Goods_Group_List
	@GoodsGroup VarChar(20) = '0401',
	@GoodsID    VarChar(20) = '41010201101007',
	@OP_TYPE    Int		    = 0
	
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 1 = Select
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 2 = Delete
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 3 = Update
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 4 = Select Before Insert
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect    NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_Hdr NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_Dtl NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_2   NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrWhere_Hdr = '1 = 1'
	SET @StrWhere_Dtl = ''
	
	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @GoodsGroup <> ''
		SET @StrWhere_Hdr = @StrWhere_Hdr + ' AND GoodsGroupID = ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsGroup)) + ''''

	IF @GoodsID <> ''
		SET @StrWhere_Dtl = @StrWhere_Dtl + ' AND GoodsID = ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID)) + ''''

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @OP_TYPE = 1
	Begin
		SET @StrSelect = '
		-- ====================================== SELECT Hdr
		   --SELECT * 
		   --FROM  inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListHdr 
		   --WHERE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Hdr)) +	
		'

		-- ====================================== SELECT Dtl
		   SELECT * 
		   FROM  inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListDtl 
		   WHERE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Hdr)) + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Dtl)) + '
		   ORDER BY GoodsID
		'

		Print @StrSelect
		Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect
	End

	IF @OP_TYPE = 2 OR @OP_TYPE = 3
	Begin
		SET @StrSelect = '
		-- =================================================================================== DELETE Hdr
		   DELETE
		   FROM  inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListHdr 
		   WHERE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Hdr)) + 
		'
		-- =================================================================================== DELETE Dtl
		   DELETE
		   FROM  inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListDtl 
		   WHERE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Hdr)) + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Dtl))

		Print @StrSelect
		Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect
	End

	IF @OP_TYPE = 3 OR @OP_TYPE = 4
	Begin
		-- ============================== Where 
		IF @GoodsGroup = '0401' -- 0401 => آردی
           SET @StrWhere_2 = ' 
			 And SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN(
                                                ''4001'', ''4002'', ''4003'', ''4004'', ''4005'', ''4006'', 
                                                ''4201'', ''4202'', ''4203'', ''4204'', ''4205'', ''4206'',
                                                ''4201'', ''4202'', ''4203'', ''4204'', ''4205'', ''4206'',
                                                ''4301'', ''4302'', ''4303'', ''4304'', ''4305'', ''4306'',
                                                ''4001'', ''4002'', ''4003'', ''4004'', ''4005'', ''4006'', 
                                                ''4101'', ''4102'', ''4103'', ''4104'', ''4105'', ''4106'', 
                                                ''4201'', ''4202'', ''4203'', ''4204'', ''4205'', ''4206'', 
                                                ''4301'', ''4302'', ''4303'', ''4304'', ''4305'', ''4306''
                                               )'

		IF @GoodsGroup = '0402' -- 0402 => سوئیت
           SET @StrWhere_2 = ' 
			 And SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN(''4008'', ''4010'', ''4011'', ''4108'', ''4110'', ''4111'', ''4208'', ''4210'', ''4211'', ''4308'', ''4310'', ''4311'')'

		IF @GoodsGroup = '0403' -- 0403 => پشمک
           SET @StrWhere_2 = ' 
			 And SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN(''4007'', ''4107'', ''4207'', ''4307'')'

		IF @GoodsGroup = '0404' -- 0404 => ویژه گزارش تولید
           SET @StrWhere_2 = ' 
			 And (
                  SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN(''40'', ''41'', ''42'', ''43'')
				  And
                    (
                     GH.GoodsID Not IN
                     (
					  Select G.GoodsID
					  From inv.tblGoods G
					  Inner Join
					  (
                        Select Distinct H.ProductID GoodsID
                        From prd.tblFormulasDtl       D
                        Inner Join prd.tblFormulasHdr H ON H.ProductID = D.ProductID And H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
                        Where 1 = 1
	                        And SubString(D.ProductID, 1, 2)   IN(''41'', ''42'')
	                        And SubString(D.GoodsID, 1, 2)     IN(''40'', ''43'')
	                        And Len(H.ProductID) = 14
	                        --And H.ProductID     IN(''41020402004012'', ''42040201004904'', ''41020501204195'', ''42040201006904'')
	                        And H.IsDefault = 1
					  ) A ON A.GoodsID = G.GoodsID
					  --Where SubString(G.GoodsID, 1, 2)  IN(''40'', ''41'')
                     )
				    )
			     )
                '

         IF @GoodsGroup = '0405' -- 0404 => ویژه گزارش کارانه تولید
            SET @StrWhere_2 = '
             And 
             (
              SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN(''3211'') And Len(GH.GoodsID) = 8
             )
             OR
             (
               (
                 SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN(''40'', ''41'', ''42'', ''43'')
                 And
                   (
                    GH.GoodsID Not IN
                    (
                      Select GoodsCID From inv.tblGoods Where GoodsCID <> ''''
                    )
                   )
                 And Len(GH.GoodsID) = 14
               )
             )
            '

         --IF @GoodsGroup = '0405' -- 0404 => ویژه گزارش کارانه تولید
         --   SET @StrWhere_2 = '
         --    And 
         --    (
         --     SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN(''3211'') And Len(GH.GoodsID) = 8
         --    )
         --    OR
         --    (
         --      (
         --        SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN(''40'', ''41'', ''42'', ''43'')
         --        And
         --          (
         --           GH.GoodsID Not IN
         --           (
         --             Select G.GoodsID
         --             From inv.tblGoods G
         --             Inner Join
         --             (
         --               Select Distinct H.ProductID GoodsID
         --               From prd.tblFormulasDtl       D
         --               Inner Join prd.tblFormulasHdr H ON H.ProductID = D.ProductID And H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
         --               Where 1 = 1
         --                 And SubString(D.ProductID, 1, 2)   IN(''41'', ''42'')
         --                 And SubString(D.GoodsID, 1, 2)     IN(''40'', ''43'')
         --                 And Len(H.ProductID) = 14
         --                 --And H.ProductID     IN(''41020402004012'', ''42040201004904'', ''41020501204195'', ''42040201006904'')
         --                 And H.IsDefault = 1
         --             ) A ON A.GoodsID = G.GoodsID
         --             --Where SubString(G.GoodsID, 1, 2)  IN(''40'', ''41'')
         --           )
         --          )
         --        And Len(GH.GoodsID) = 14
         --      )
         --    )
         --   '

		IF @GoodsGroup = '0201' -- 0201 => غیر صادراتی
			SET @StrWhere_2 = ' 
			And GoodsName Not Like N''%صادر%'''

		IF @GoodsGroup = '0202' -- 0202 => صادراتی
			SET @StrWhere_2 = ' 
			And GoodsName Like N''%صادر%'''

		-- ============================== Insert
		IF @OP_TYPE <> 4
		Begin
			SET @StrSelect = '
        -- =================================================================================== INSERT Hdr
		   INSERT INTO inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListHdr (GoodsGroupID) VALUES(''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsGroup)) + ''')'

			Print @StrSelect
			Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect
		End

		SET @StrSelect = '
        -- =================================================================================== INSERT Dtl ' +
        Case When @OP_TYPE <> 4 Then '
		   INSERT INTO inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListDtl (GoodsGroupID, GoodsID, RowNo, DocRowNo) '
		Else 
		   ''
		End + '
           Select ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsGroup)) + ''' GoodsGroupID, GH.GoodsID, 
		          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY GH.GoodsID DESC) + 0 RowNo, 
			      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY GH.GoodsID DESC) + 0 DocRowNo
           From       inv.tblGoodsDtl    GD
           Inner Join inv.tblGoods       GH ON GH.GoodsID = GD.GoodsID
		   --Inner Join prd.tblFormulasHdr FH ON GH.GoodsID = FH.ProductID And FH.IsDefault = 1
		   Where 1 = 1
             And GH.CodeClosed = 0
             And GH.GoodsID   <> '''' 
             And GH.GoodsID Is Not Null ' + 
        Case When @GoodsGroup <> '0405' Then '
             And SubString(GH.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN(''40'', ''41'', ''42'', ''43'') 
             And Len(GH.GoodsID) = 14 '
        Else '' End + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_2)) + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Dtl))

		Print @StrSelect
		Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect

		IF @OP_TYPE <> 4
		Begin
			SET @StrSelect = '
		-- =================================================================================== SELECT Inserted
			SELECT * 
			FROM  inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListDtl 
			WHERE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Hdr)) + LTrim(RTrim(@StrWhere_Dtl)) + '
			ORDER BY GoodsID		
		'

			Print @StrSelect
			Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect
		End
	End
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_Store_Cart_To_Cart
     @FiscalYear Int 		 = 1403,
     @SerialNoFr Int 		 = 691,
     @SerialNoTo Int 		 = 691,
     @DocDateFr  Char(10)    = '1402/03/01',
     @DocDateTo  Char(10)    = '1402/03/31',
     @GoodsID    VarChar(20) = ''
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect_1  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere    NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1  = ''
	SET @StrSelect_2  = ''
	SET @StrWhere     = '1 = 1'
	
	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And D1.ProcessID IN(260)
		      And D1.ProcessNo IN(1)'

	IF @FiscalYear <> 0 And @FiscalYear Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And D1.FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear)))

	IF @SerialNoFr <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And D1.SerialNo  >= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoFr)))

	IF @SerialNoTo <> 0 And @SerialNoTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And D1.SerialNo  <= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoTo)))

	IF @DocDateFr <> '' And @DocDateFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And D1.DocDate   >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateFr)) + ''''

	IF @DocDateTo <> '' And @DocDateTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And D1.DocDate   <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateTo)) + ''''

	IF @GoodsID <> '' And @GoodsID Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
              And D1.GoodsID Like ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID)) + '%'''

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = '
		-- =================================================================================== SELECT
        SELECT D1.FiscalYear, D1.SerialNo, D1.DocDate, D1.StoreID From_Store, pub.GetStoreName(D1.StoreID, 1) From_Store_Name, D1.StoreID2 To_Store,
               pub.GetStoreName(D1.StoreID2, 1) To_Store_Name, D1.GoodsID From_Goods, pub.GetGoodsName(D1.GoodsID, 1) From_GoodsName, 
               Cast(D1.SubUnitQuantity As Decimal(28, 2)) Quantity, D2.GoodsID To_Goods, pub.GetGoodsName(D2.GoodsID, 1) To_GoodsName
        FROM       inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D1
        Inner Join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D2 ON D2.ProcessID = 265 And D1.ProcessNo = D2.ProcessNo And D1.FiscalYear = D2.FiscalYear And
                                       D1.SerialNo = D2.SerialNo
        WHERE ' + @StrWhere + '
        ORDER BY D1.DocDate, D1.SerialNo, D1.GoodsID
		'
	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect_1
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.SP_VrNgr_To_Takro_Last_Step
	@FiscalYear	  Int	   = 0,
	@DocDateFr    Char(10) = '',
	@DocDateTo    Char(10) = '',	
	@OP_TYPE      Int      = 0
	
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 0 = Select
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 1 = Create
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 2 = Delete	
AS 
BEGIN 
	-- ===================================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================================== Create/Update Vouchers
	-- ===================================================================================================
	IF @OP_TYPE = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT S.SerialNo, S.DocDate, S.AcntCode, S.GoodsID, S.GoodsQuantity, 
			   S.GoodsQuantity / A.SubUnitValue GoodsQuantity, 
			   S.SubUnitQuantity, S.SubUnitID, A.SubUnitValue, A.UnitID
		FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S 
		INNER JOIN 
		(
			Select ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, S.GoodsID, GoodsQuantity, SubUnitQuantity, SubUnitID, G.UnitID,
				   IsNull(
						  (
							   Select UnitValue 
							   From inv.tblSubUnitsDtl 
							   Where GoodsID = S.GoodsID And ShowInInvoice = 1
							   ), 1
						  ) SubUnitValue 
			From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S 
			Inner Join inv.tblGoods G ON S.GoodsID = G.GoodsID
			Where ProcessID IN(100, 90) And BaseProcessID IN (9998, 9999) And ProcessNo = 1 And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear 
				  And DocDate >= @DocDateFr And DocDate <= @DocDateTo  
				  --And S.GoodsID IN ('41040221014000', '41040221032000', '41040221033022', '41040221034000')
				  And (
					   SubString(S.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN ('4207', '4208', '4307', '4308') OR
					   S.GoodsID IN ('41040221014000', '41040221032000', '41040221033022', '41040221034000')
					  )
				  --And SubString(AcntCode, 1, 5) = '11404'
				  And S.SubUnitID <> G.UnitID And GoodsQuantity = SubUnitQuantity 
		) A ON A.ProcessID = S.ProcessID And A.ProcessNo = S.ProcessNo And 
			   A.FiscalYear = S.FiscalYear And A.SerialNo = S.SerialNo And 
			   A.DocRowNo = S.DocRowNo And A.GoodsID = S.GoodsID 		
	END
	ELSE	
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @VchNo		   Int 
		DECLARE @DocStep	   Int  
		DECLARE @VchDate       Varchar(10)  
		DECLARE @ProcessID     Smallint  
		DECLARE @ProcessNo     Tinyint  
		DECLARE @FiscalYear1   Smallint  
		DECLARE @SerialNo	   Int  
		DECLARE @DocDate       Varchar(10)  
		DECLARE @AcntCode      Varchar(20)  
		DECLARE @GoodsID	   Varchar(20)  
		DECLARE @GoodsQuantity Float
		DECLARE @GoodsPrice    Float
		DECLARE @UnitID   	   Varchar(20)  
		DECLARE @SubUnitValue  Float

		-- ======================================== START CURSOR
		DECLARE Cursor_09 CURSOR FOR   

			SELECT S.ProcessID, S.ProcessNo, S.FiscalYear, S.SerialNo, S.DocDate, S.AcntCode, 
				   S.GoodsID, S.GoodsQuantity, A.SubUnitValue, A.UnitID, S.GoodsPrice
			FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S 
			INNER JOIN 
			(
				Select ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, S.AcntCode, 
					   S.GoodsID, GoodsQuantity, SubUnitQuantity, SubUnitID, G.UnitID,
					   IsNull(
							  (Select UnitValue 
							   From inv.tblSubUnitsDtl 
							   Where GoodsID = S.GoodsID And ShowInInvoice = 1 ), 1
							  ) SubUnitValue 
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S 
				Inner Join inv.tblGoods G ON S.GoodsID = G.GoodsID
				Where ProcessID IN(100, 90) And BaseProcessID IN (9998, 9999) And ProcessNo = 1 And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear 
					  And DocDate >= @DocDateFr And DocDate <= @DocDateTo  
					  --And S.GoodsID IN ('41040221014000', '41040221032000', '41040221033022', '41040221034000')
					  And (
						   SubString(S.GoodsID, 1, 4) IN ('4207', '4208', '4307', '4308') OR
						   S.GoodsID IN ('41040221014000', '41040221032000', '41040221033022', '41040221034000')
						  )
					  --And SubString(AcntCode, 1, 5) = '11404'
					  And S.SubUnitID <> G.UnitID And GoodsQuantity = SubUnitQuantity 
			) A ON A.ProcessID = S.ProcessID And A.ProcessNo = S.ProcessNo And 
				   A.FiscalYear = S.FiscalYear And A.SerialNo = S.SerialNo And 
				   A.DocRowNo = S.DocRowNo And A.GoodsID = S.GoodsID 		   

		OPEN Cursor_09  
		  
		FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_09 INTO @ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @DocDate, @AcntCode, 
									   @GoodsID, @GoodsQuantity, @SubUnitValue, @UnitID, @GoodsPrice
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
		BEGIN  
			-- =================================== Update Qty And Price
			UPDATE inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
				SET SubUnitID = '01', GoodsQuantity = @GoodsQuantity / @SubUnitValue, GoodsPrice = @GoodsPrice * @SubUnitValue
			WHERE ProcessID = @ProcessID And ProcessNo = @ProcessNo And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear And SerialNo = @SerialNo And
				  AcntCode = @AcntCode And GoodsID = @GoodsID And GoodsQuantity = @GoodsQuantity And GoodsPrice = @GoodsPrice
			
			-- =================================== Vouchers Creation
			IF object_id ('dbo.tbl_Temp') Is Not Null DROP TABLE dbo.tbl_Temp

			-- =====
			EXEC dbo.SP_Voucher_Create_Update
				@TableName	  = 'inv.tblStorageDocsHdr',
				@ProcessID_N  = @ProcessID, 
				@ProcessNo_N  = @ProcessNo,
				@FiscalYearFr = @FiscalYear,
				@FiscalYearTo = @FiscalYear,
				@SerialNoFr   = @SerialNo,	
				@SerialNoTo   = @SerialNo,	
				@DocDateFr    = '',
				@DocDateTo    = '',	
				@Price		  = 1,
				@OP_TYPE      = 1			
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_09 INTO @ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @DocDate, @AcntCode, 
										   @GoodsID, @GoodsQuantity, @SubUnitValue, @UnitID, @GoodsPrice
		-- ======================================== END CURSOR
		END   
		  
		CLOSE Cursor_09  
		DEALLOCATE Cursor_09
	END
		
	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== DELETE Temp_Table
	-- ===================================================================================
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_BuyRequests_Status_1
     @FiscalYear Int 		 = 1402,
     @SerialNoFr Int 		 = 691,
     @SerialNoTo Int 		 = 691,
     @DocDateFr  Char(10)    = '1402/03/01',
     @DocDateTo  Char(10)    = '1402/03/31',
     @GoodsID    VarChar(20) = ''
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect_1  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere    NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1  = ''
	SET @StrSelect_2  = ''
	SET @StrWhere     = '1 = 1'
	
	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @FiscalYear <> 0 And @FiscalYear Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And Cmr.FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear)))

	IF @SerialNoFr <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And Cmr.SerialNo  >= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoFr)))

	IF @SerialNoTo <> 0 And @SerialNoTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And Cmr.SerialNo  <= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoTo)))

	IF @DocDateFr <> '' And @DocDateFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And Cmr.DocDate   >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateFr)) + ''''

	IF @DocDateTo <> '' And @DocDateTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		      And Cmr.DocDate   <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateTo)) + ''''

	IF @GoodsID <> '' And @GoodsID Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
              And Cmr.GoodsID Like ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID)) + '%'''

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = '
		-- =================================================================================== SELECT
        --SELECT *
        SELECT GoodsID [کد کالا], GoodsName [نام کالا], Cmr_Date [تاریخ درخواست], Cast(Cmr_SerialNo As Varchar(5)) [ش.درخواست], Ord_Date [تاریخ سفارش], 
               Cast(Ord_SerialNo As Varchar(5)) [ش.سفارش], Tmp_Date [تاریخ رسید], Cast(Tmp_SerialNo As Varchar(5)) [ش.رسید], Buy_Date [تاریخ خرید], 
               Cast(Buy_SerialNo As Varchar(5)) [ش.خرید], Buy_ProcessNo [ش.مرحله خرید]
        FROM
        (
	        Select Cmr.GoodsID, GD.GoodsName, Cmr.SerialNo Cmr_SerialNo, Cmr.DocDate Cmr_Date, BuyOrd.SerialNo Ord_SerialNo, BuyOrd.DocDate Ord_Date,
		           TmpRcp.SerialNo Tmp_SerialNo, TmpRcp.DocDate Tmp_Date, Buy.SerialNo Buy_SerialNo, Buy.DocDate Buy_Date, Buy.ProcessNo Buy_ProcessNo
        
	        From cmr.tblCMRDtl Cmr
	        Left  Join cmr.tblCMRDtl            CmrRet ON CmrRet.BaseProcessID = Cmr.ProcessID And CmrRet.BaseProcessNo = Cmr.ProcessNo And -- CmrRets
									                      CmrRet.BaseFiscalYear = Cmr.FiscalYear And CmrRet.BaseSerialNo = Cmr.SerialNo And
									                      CmrRet.BaseDocRowNo = Cmr.DocRowNo And CmrRet.GoodsID = Cmr.GoodsID
        									  
	        Left  Join cmr.tblOrderDtl          BuyOrd ON BuyOrd.BaseProcessID = Cmr.ProcessID And BuyOrd.BaseProcessNo = Cmr.ProcessNo And -- BuyOrder
										                  BuyOrd.BaseFiscalYear = Cmr.FiscalYear And BuyOrd.BaseSerialNo = Cmr.SerialNo And
										                  BuyOrd.BaseDocRowNo = Cmr.DocRowNo And BuyOrd.GoodsID = Cmr.GoodsID
        									  							  
	        Left  Join inv.tblInvTempReceiptDtl TmpRcp ON TmpRcp.BaseProcessID = BuyOrd.ProcessID And TmpRcp.BaseProcessNo = BuyOrd.ProcessNo And -- TmpReceipt
												          TmpRcp.BaseFiscalYear = BuyOrd.FiscalYear And TmpRcp.BaseSerialNo = BuyOrd.SerialNo And
												          TmpRcp.BaseDocRowNo = BuyOrd.DocRowNo And TmpRcp.GoodsID = BuyOrd.GoodsID
        
	        Left  Join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl       Buy  ON Buy.BaseProcessID = TmpRcp.ProcessID And Buy.BaseProcessNo = TmpRcp.ProcessNo And -- Buy
											               Buy.BaseFiscalYear = TmpRcp.FiscalYear And Buy.BaseSerialNo = TmpRcp.SerialNo And
											               Buy.BaseDocRowNo = TmpRcp.DocRowNo And Buy.GoodsID = TmpRcp.GoodsID
        
            Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl              GD  ON GD.GoodsID = Cmr.GoodsID
        																											  							  
	        WHERE ' + @StrWhere + '
              --And SubString(Cmr.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN(''40'', ''41'', ''42'', ''43'')
	        Group By Cmr.SerialNo, Cmr.DocDate, BuyOrd.SerialNo, BuyOrd.DocDate, TmpRcp.SerialNo,
	                 TmpRcp.DocDate, Cmr.GoodsID, GD.GoodsName, Buy.SerialNo, Buy.DocDate, Buy.ProcessNo
        ) A
        --Where Remain > 0
        Order By Cmr_Date, Cmr_SerialNo, GoodsID
		'
	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect_1
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_Personnel_Traffic_Report
     @FiscalYear    Int 	      = 1402,
     @Emp_No        Int           = 2905,
     @Prs_Name      NVarChar(100) = N'حمید',
     @Prs_Family    NVarChar(100) = N'سلطان',	
     @Prs_Full_Name NVarChar(100) = N'',
     @DocDateFr     Char(10)      = '1402/03/23',
     @DocDateTo     Char(10)      = '1402/03/23',
     @Day_Ago       Int           = 5,
     @Manual_Regist Int           = 1,
     @Device_Name   NVarChar(100) = N'کارتزنی مگان',
     @Section_Name  NVarChar(200) = N'بازاریابی و فروش',
	 @Traffic_Type  Int           = 0,
	 @InsertType    Int           = 0,
     @Order_By      NVarChar(Max) = 'DocDate, PersonnelID, Traffic_No'

-- ===== Traffic_Type           1 = ورود
-- ===== Traffic_Type           2 = خروج

-- ===== InsertType             1 = اتوماتیک
-- ===== InsertType             2 = دستی

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @StrSelect   NVarchar(Max) = ''
	DECLARE @StrWhere    NVarchar(Max) = '1 = 1'
	DECLARE @StrWhere2   NVarchar(Max) = '1 = 1'

	-- ==================================================== Init Takro_DB_Info
    DECLARE @Takro_DB	 VarChar(Max);
    DECLARE @Takro_DB_FY Int;

	-- ====================================================
	Select @Takro_DB_FY = FiscalYear
	From  TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_0000.pub.tblFiscalYears
	Where IsDefault = 1

	---- ====================================================
    SET @Takro_DB = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Takro_DB_FY)))

	Print 'Takro_DB_Name : ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB))

	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	-- ================================================================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	IF @FiscalYear <> 0 And @FiscalYear Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) IN(' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + ')'

	IF @Emp_No <> 0 And @Emp_No Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And DF.Emp_No      = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Emp_No)))

	IF @Prs_Name <> '' And @Prs_Name Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And EM.Name       Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Prs_Name)) + '%'''

	IF @Prs_Family <> '' And @Prs_Family Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And EM.Family     Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Prs_Family)) + '%'''

	IF @Prs_Full_Name <> '' And @Prs_Full_Name Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And Prs_Full_Name Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Prs_Full_Name)) + '%'''

	IF @DocDateFr <> '' And @DocDateFr Is Not Null And @Day_Ago Is Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateFr)) + ''''

	IF @DocDateTo <> '' And @DocDateTo Is Not Null And @Day_Ago Is Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateTo)) + ''''

	IF @Device_Name <> '' And @Device_Name Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere2 = @StrWhere2 + '  
          And DeviceName   Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Device_Name)) + '%'''

	IF @Section_Name <> '' And @Section_Name Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere2 = @StrWhere2 + '  
          And Section_Name Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Section_Name)) + '%'''
		  
	IF @Traffic_Type <> 0 And @Traffic_Type Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And Traffic_No     = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Traffic_Type)))

	IF @InsertType <> 0 And @InsertType Is Not Null
	   IF @InsertType = 1
          SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And (DeviceIP     <> '''' And DeviceIP Is Not Null And DeviceIP <> N''ثبت دستي'')'
	   IF @InsertType = 2
          SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And (DeviceIP      = '''' OR DeviceIP Is Null OR DeviceIP = N''ثبت دستي'')'

	IF @Day_Ago Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) >= pub.funChangeDate_GergorianToPersian(DATEADD(day, -' + + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Day_Ago))) + ', CONVERT (date, SYSDATETIME())))'

    IF @Manual_Regist <> 0 And @Manual_Regist Is Not Null
	Begin
	   IF @Manual_Regist = 1
	      SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And IsNull(D.Title, '''')  = '''''
	   Else IF @Manual_Regist = 2
	      SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
                   And IsNull(D.Title, '''') <> '''''
	End
	   
	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	-- ================================================================================================================================== SELECT
	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect = '
	-- ============================================ SELECT
	SELECT
          Traffic_ID, Traffic_No, PersonnelCode, PersonnelID, Gender_Name + '' '' + PrsFullName PrsFullName, Section_Name, DocDate, DocTime, 
          Case When Traffic_No % 2 > 0 Then ''ورود'' Else ''خروج'' End Traffic_Type, PrsMobile,
		  DeviceName, DeviceIP, OP_Status Status --, *
    FROM
		  (
	        SELECT
		          TrafficID Traffic_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Personnel_Code, Doc_Date ORDER BY Doc_Date, TrafficID ASC) Traffic_No, 
		          Personnel_Code PersonnelCode, Personnel_ID PersonnelID, Prs_Full_Name PrsFullName,
				  Case When Gender = 1 Then ''آقای'' Else ''خانم'' End Gender_Name, Prs_Mobile_2 PrsMobile, Doc_Date DocDate, 
				  Doc_Time DocTime, IsNull(Device_Name, ''Manual'') DeviceName, IsNull(Device_Ip, ''Manual'') DeviceIP, Status_M OP_Status, *
        	FROM
        	(
		         Select DF.Id TrafficID, DF.Emp_No Personnel_Code, P.PersonnelID Personnel_ID, EM.Name + '' '' + EM.Family Prs_Full_Name, EM.Name Prs_Name, 
				        EM.Family Prs_Family, P.Gender, Date Main_Date, Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), Time), 4) Main_Time,
				        SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) FiscalYear, SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) [Month], SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) [Day],
				        SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) Doc_Date,
				        SubString(Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), Time), 4), 1, 2) + '':'' + SubString(Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), Time), 4), 3, 2) Doc_Time, 
				        D.Title Device_Name, D.DeviceIp Device_Ip, Status Status_M, P.Mobile Prs_Mobile, P.EmployeeNumber Prs_Mobile_2, EM.Sec_No Section_No, 
						Cast(Kara.dbo.Fun_Get_Section_Parent_3(EM.Sec_No, ''3, 4, 6, 15, 17, 22, 25, 99, 250, 251'') As NVarchar(Max)) Collate Arabic_CS_AS AS Section_Name, DF.*
		         From  Kara.dbo.DataFile         DF
		         Inner Join Kara.dbo.Employee    EM ON EM.Emp_No      = DF.Emp_No
		         Left  Join Kara.dbo.Devices      D ON D.DeviceNumber = DF.DeviceNumber
                 Inner Join Kara.dbo.Sections     S ON EM.Sec_No      = S.Sec_No
		         Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB)) + '.prs.tblPersonnels     P ON P.CardNumber  = DF.Emp_No
		         Inner Join ' + LTrim(RTrim(@Takro_DB)) + '.prs.tblPersonnelsDtl PD ON P.PersonnelID = PD.PersonnelID
	             Where ' + @StrWhere + '
	        ) B
		  ) A
	WHERE ' + @StrWhere2 + '
          --And (Select IsNull(Max(Traffic_ID), 0) From Kara.dbo.tbl_SHV_Temp)' +
	Case When @Order_By <> '' Then '
	ORDER BY ' +  @Order_By 
	Else '' End

	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect

END

storedProcedures.definition:
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_Personnels_Info_1
	@PersonnelID Varchar(20) = ''
	--@QuitJobDateFr Char(10)    = '',
	--@QuitJobDateTo Char(10)    = ''
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Last SELECT
	-- ==========================================================================
	SELECT P.PersonnelID [کد پرسنل], P.CardNumber [شماره پرسنلی], PD.FirstName [نام], PD.LastName [نام خانوادگی], PD.FatherName [نام پدر], 
		   P.BirthDate [تاریخ تولد], LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (P.BirthDate), ''))) [تاریخ تولد],
		   P.BirthPlace [محل تولد], P.NationalIDNumber [کد ملی], S.StudyName [مدرک تحصیلی], SF.FieldName [رشته تحصیلی], 
		   Case When P.MaritalStatus = 1 Then 'مجرد' When P.MaritalStatus = 2 Then 'معیل' When P.MaritalStatus = 3 Then 'متاهل' End [وضعیت تاهل],
		   P.InsuranceID [ش.بیمه], P.HireDate [تاریخ استخدام], LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (P.HireDate), ''))) [تاریخ استخدام], 
		   IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 1, 4), '') [سال استخدام],
		   Case When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '01' Then 'فروردین'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '02' Then 'اردیبهشت'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '03' Then 'خرداد'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '04' Then 'تیر'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '05' Then 'مرداد'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '06' Then 'شهریور'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '07' Then 'مهر'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '08' Then 'آبان'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '09' Then 'آذر'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '10' Then 'دی'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '11' Then 'بهمن'
				When IsNull(SubString(P.HireDate, 6, 2), '') = '12' Then 'اسفند'
			Else
				''
			End [ماه استخدام],
			P.QuitJobDate [تاریخ ترک کار], IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 1, 4), '') [سال ترک کار],
			Case When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '01' Then 'فروردین'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '02' Then 'اردیبهشت'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '03' Then 'خرداد'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '04' Then 'تیر'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '05' Then 'مرداد'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '06' Then 'شهریور'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '07' Then 'مهر'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '08' Then 'آبان'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '09' Then 'آذر'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '10' Then 'دی'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '11' Then 'بهمن'
				 When IsNull(SubString(P.QuitJobDate, 6, 2), '') = '12' Then 'اسفند'
			 Else
				 ''
			 End [ماه ترک کار],
			 W.WorkShopName [محل خدمت], D.DepartmentName [واحد سازمانی], Case When CodeClosed = 0 Then 'True' Else 'False' End Active
	FROM prs.tblPersonnels P
	LEFT JOIN prs.tblPersonnelsDtl   PD ON P.PersonnelID = PD.PersonnelID
	LEFT JOIN prs.tblDecreeHdr		 DC ON DC.PersonnelID = PD.PersonnelID
	LEFT JOIN prs.tblWorkShopsDtl	 W  ON W.WorkShopID = DC.WorkShopID
	LEFT JOIN prs.tblDepartmentsDtl  D  ON D.DepartmentID = DC.DepartmentID
	LEFT JOIN prs.tblStudiesDtl		 S  ON S.StudyID = P.StudyID
	LEFT JOIN prs.tblStudyFieldsDtl SF  ON SF.FieldID = P.FieldID
	WHERE 1 = 1
		And P.CodeClosed = 0
		--And CardNumber IN (Select GoodsID From acc.tblAAATmp)
		And Case When @PersonnelID <> '' Then P.PersonnelID Else '' End = Case When @PersonnelID <> '' Then @PersonnelID Else '' End 
		And DC.SerialNo = (
							Select MAX(SerialNo) 
							From prs.tblDecreeHdr 
							Where PersonnelID = Case When @PersonnelID <> '' Then @PersonnelID Else P.PersonnelID End
							)
		--And Case When @QuitJobDateFr <> '' Then P.QuitJobDate Else '' End >=  Case When @QuitJobDateFr <> '' Then @QuitJobDateFr Else '' End
		--And Case When @QuitJobDateTo <> '' Then P.QuitJobDate Else '' End <=  Case When @QuitJobDateTo <> '' Then @QuitJobDateTo Else '' End
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.SP_Bsckup_Restore_DB
     @Backup_OR_Restore Int           = 1, -- 1 => Backup And Restore | 2 => Backup | 3 => Restore
     @Backup_Date       Char(15)      = '', -- 14031201_1219
     @From_DB           NVarChar(Max) = N'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_1404',
     @To_DB             NVarChar(Max) = N'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_2_1404',
     @Path_Backup_File  NVarChar(Max) = N'D:\TakroSystem\.0.Backups\',
     @Path_Restore_DB   NVarChar(Max) = N'D:\TakroSystem\TS-Databases\'

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @Str_Query         NVarChar(Max) = ''

	-- =============================================================================== Init
	Select @Backup_Date = Case When @Backup_Date <> '' Then 
							   @Backup_Date 
						  Else Replace(pub.funChangeDate_GergorianToPersian(Cast(GetDate() AS Date)), '/', '') + '_' +
							   Replace(SubString(Cast(Cast(GetDate() AS Time) As VarChar(30)), 1, 5), ':', '')
						  End

	-- =============================================================================== CREATE Backup
	IF @Backup_OR_Restore = 1 OR @Backup_OR_Restore = 2
	Begin
		SET @Str_Query = '
		-- =============================================================================== CREATE Backup
		BACKUP DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + ' 
			   TO DISK = N''' + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Backup_File)) + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_'  + LTrim(RTrim(@Backup_Date)) + ''' WITH NOFORMAT, NOINIT,  
			   NAME    = N''' + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_'  + LTrim(RTrim(@Backup_Date)) + '-Full Database Backup'', SKIP, NOREWIND, NOUNLOAD, STATS = 5
			   '
	End

	-- =============================================================================== RESTORE Backup
	IF @Backup_OR_Restore = 1 OR @Backup_OR_Restore = 3
	Begin
		SET @Str_Query += '
		-- =============================================================================== RESTORE Backup
		USE [master]
		ALTER   DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB))   + ' SET  SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE
		RESTORE DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB))   + ' FROM DISK = N''' + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Backup_File)) + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_' + LTrim(RTrim(@Backup_Date)) + ''' WITH FILE = 1,  
				MOVE N'''  + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_dat'' TO N'''    + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Restore_DB)) + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB)) + '.mdf'',  
				MOVE N'''  + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_log'' TO N'''    + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Restore_DB)) + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB)) + '.ldf'',  
				NOUNLOAD,  STATS = 5
		ALTER DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB)) + ' SET MULTI_USER'
	End

	-- ====================================
	PRINT @Str_Query;
	EXEC sp_executesql @Str_Query;

END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC dbo.Rpt_Personnel_Statistics_Report
     @Emp_No        Int           = 2905,
     @Prs_Name      NVarChar(100) = N'حمید',
     @Prs_Family    NVarChar(100) = N'سلطان',	
     @DocDateFr     Char(10)      = '1402/03/23',
     @DocDateTo     Char(10)      = '1402/03/23',
     @Section_No    Int           = 5,
     @Section_Name  NVarChar(100) = N'اداری',
     @Detailed_Rpt  Int           = 1

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @StrSelect     NVarchar(Max) = ''
	DECLARE @StrWhere      NVarchar(Max) = '1 = 1'
	DECLARE @StrWhere2     NVarchar(Max) = '1 = 1'

	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	-- ================================================================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	IF @Emp_No <> 0 And @Emp_No Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
      And D.Emp_No      = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Emp_No)))

	IF @Prs_Name <> '' And @Prs_Name Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
      And E.Name       Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Prs_Name)) + '%'''

	IF @Prs_Family <> '' And @Prs_Family Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
      And E.Family     Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Prs_Family)) + '%'''

	IF @DocDateFr <> '' And @DocDateFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
      And SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateFr)) + ''''

	IF @DocDateTo <> '' And @DocDateTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
      And SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateTo)) + ''''

	IF @Section_No <> 0 And @Section_No Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
      And E.Sec_No      = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@Section_No)))

	IF @Section_Name <> '' And @Section_Name Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere2 = @StrWhere2 + '  
            And T1.Section Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@Section_Name)) + '%'''
				   
	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	-- ================================================================================================================================== SELECT
	-- ==================================================================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect = '
	-- ========================================================================== Init Temp_Table
	IF object_id (''Kara.dbo.TmpTable_5'') Is Not Null DROP TABLE Kara.dbo.TmpTable_5

	Select E.Sec_No Section_No, dbo.Fun_Get_Section_Parent_3(E.Sec_No, ''3, 4, 6, 15, 17, 22, 25, 99, 250, 251'') Section, D.Emp_No, Date, Time, 
		   ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY D.Emp_No, Date ORDER BY Date, Id ASC) Traffic_No
	INTO Kara.dbo.TmpTable_5
	From       Kara.dbo.DataFile D
	Inner Join Kara.dbo.Employee E ON E.Emp_No = D.Emp_No
    Inner Join Kara.dbo.Sections S ON E.Sec_No = S.Sec_No
	Where ' + @StrWhere + '
	Group By Id, Date, Time, D.Emp_No, E.Sec_No
	Order By D.Emp_No, Date

	-- ========================================================================== SELECT
	SELECT 
		 SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 1, 4) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 5, 2) + ''/'' + SubString(LTrim(RTrim(Str(Date))), 7, 2) Doc_Date,
		 Count(Emp_No) Emp_Count, Section,
		 LTrim(RTrim(Str(SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, CAST(Total_Time AS time(0)))) / 60))) + '':'' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, CAST(Total_Time AS time(0)))) % 60))) Total_Time
	FROM
	(
		SELECT Emp_No, Date, Enter_Time, Exit_Time, CONVERT(TIME, DATEADD(MS, DATEDIFF(SS, Enter_Time, Exit_Time ) * 1000, 0), 114) Total_Time, Section_No, Section
		FROM
		(
		  Select T1.Emp_No, T1.Date,
				 SubString(Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), T1.Time), 4), 1, 2) + '':'' + SubString(Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), T1.Time), 4), 3, 2) Enter_Time,
				 SubString(Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), T2.Time), 4), 1, 2) + '':'' + SubString(Right(''0000'' + Convert(Varchar(4), T2.Time), 4), 3, 2) Exit_Time,
				 T1.Section_No, T1.Section
		  From       (Select * From Kara.dbo.TmpTable_5 Where Traffic_No = 1) T1
		  Inner Join (Select * From Kara.dbo.TmpTable_5 Where Traffic_No = 2) T2 ON T1.Emp_No = T2.Emp_No And T1.Date = T2.Date
		  Where ' + @StrWhere2 + '
			And T1.Section <> '''' And T1.Section Is Not Null
		) A
	) B
	GROUP BY Date, Section
	ORDER BY Date
	'

	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect

END

Create PROCEDURE dbo.ItemForSynchView
	@StartDate as datetime
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT  GUID_GoodsID ItemID,GoodsName Name,D.GoodsID ExternalID,BarCode Barcode,MAX(CreateTime) InvoiceDate
	FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H
	INNER JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
	ON H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
	INNER JOIN (SELECT * 
	            FROM inv.tblGoods 
				WHERE BarCode in (
								SELECT BarCode 
								FROM inv.tblGoods 
								WHERE LTRIM(BarCode)<>''
								group by BarCode
								HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
								) G
	ON D.GoodsID=G.GoodsID 
	INNER JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl GD
	ON D.GoodsID=GD.GoodsID AND LanguageID = 1
	WHERE H.ProcessID in (90,100) AND D.StoreID in ('04008') AND CreateTime>=@StartDate 
	GROUP BY GUID_GoodsID,GoodsName,D.GoodsID,BarCode
	order by InvoiceDate
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SaleInvoiceForSynchView
	@StartDate as datetime
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @PartNo int  
	DECLARE @Start int
	DECLARE @LEN int
	
	SELECT @PartNo = [acc].[FunGetAcntInfoForRemain](1)
	SELECT @Start = [acc].[FunGetAcntInfoForRemain](2)
	SELECT @LEN = [acc].[FunGetAcntInfoForRemain](3)

	 
	SELECT GUID_SerialNo  InvoiceID ,LTRIM(STR(H.FiscalYear)) + '-' + LTRIM(STR(H.ProcessNo)) + '-' + LTRIM(STR(H.SerialNo)) InvoiceNumber,CreateTime InvoiceDate,
		   GUID_AcntCode CustomerID , CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , TotalQuantity) TotalQuantity,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , TotalAmount) TotalAmount,
		   CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , TotalDiscount) TotalDiscount,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , TotalTax) TotalTax,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , TotalNetAmount) TotalNetAmount,
		   CASE WHEN H.ProcessID=100 THEN LTRIM(STR(H.BaseFiscalYear)) + '-' + LTRIM(STR(H.BaseProcessNo)) + '-' + LTRIM(STR(H.BaseSerialNo)) ELSE '' END ReferInvoiceNumber,
		  CASE WHEN H.ProcessID=100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END StatusID
	FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H
	INNER JOIN (SELECT ProcessID,ProcessNo,FiscalYear,SerialNo,GoodsID,
	            SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * GoodsQuantity) TotalQuantity ,SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * GoodsQuantity*GoodsPrice) TotalAmount , SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * DiscountDtl) TotalDiscount ,
				SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * (TaxOverWorthCostDtl+TollOverWorthCostDtl)) TotalTax , SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * ((GoodsQuantity*GoodsPrice)-DiscountDtl+TaxOverWorthCostDtl+TollOverWorthCostDtl))TotalNetAmount
	            FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
				where StoreID in ('04008') 
				GROUP BY ProcessID,ProcessNo,FiscalYear,SerialNo,GoodsID)D
	ON H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
	INNER JOIN (SELECT * 
	            FROM inv.tblGoods 
				WHERE BarCode in (
								SELECT BarCode 
								FROM inv.tblGoods 
								WHERE LTRIM(BarCode)<>''
								group by BarCode
								HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
								) G
	ON D.GoodsID=G.GoodsID AND G.PartNumber=1
	INNER JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl GD
	ON D.GoodsID=GD.GoodsID AND LanguageID = 1
	INNER JOIN acc.tblAcnt A on A.PartNumber = @PartNo AND A.AcntCode=SUBSTRING(H.AcntCode,@Start,@LEN)
	WHERE H.ProcessID in (90,100) AND CreateTime>=@StartDate 
	order by InvoiceDate
END

Create PROCEDURE dbo.SaleInvoiceLineItemForSynchView
	@StartDate as datetime
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @PartNo int  
	DECLARE @Start int
	DECLARE @LEN int
	
	SELECT @PartNo = [acc].[FunGetAcntInfoForRemain](1)
	SELECT @Start = [acc].[FunGetAcntInfoForRemain](2)
	SELECT @LEN = [acc].[FunGetAcntInfoForRemain](3)
	 
	SELECT GUID_SerialNo  InvoiceID ,LTRIM(STR(H.FiscalYear)) + '-' + LTRIM(STR(H.ProcessNo)) + '-' + LTRIM(STR(H.SerialNo)) InvoiceNumber,CreateTime InvoiceDate,
		  D.DocRowNo LineItemID,G.BarCode Barcode,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , D.GoodsQuantity) Quantity,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) ,D.GoodsPrice) Price,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , case when TotalAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (D.GoodsQuantity*D.GoodsPrice )*(H.Discount+H.Discount2+H.Discount3) /(TotalAmount)END) Discount,
		  CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , D.TaxOverWorthCostDtl+D.TollOverWorthCostDtl) Tax,CONVERT(decimal(18,3) , (D.GoodsQuantity*D.GoodsPrice) - (case when TotalAmount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (D.GoodsQuantity*D.GoodsPrice )*(H.Discount+H.Discount2+H.Discount3) /(TotalAmount)END) + D.TaxOverWorthCostDtl+D.TollOverWorthCostDtl) NetAmount
	FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H
	INNER JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
	ON H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
	INNER JOIN (SELECT ProcessID,ProcessNo,FiscalYear,SerialNo,GoodsID,
	            SUM(GoodsQuantity) TotalQuantity ,SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * GoodsQuantity*GoodsPrice) TotalAmount , SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * DiscountDtl) TotalDiscount ,
				SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * (TaxOverWorthCostDtl+TollOverWorthCostDtl)) TotalTax , SUM(CASE WHEN ProcessID=100 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * ((GoodsQuantity*GoodsPrice)-DiscountDtl+TaxOverWorthCostDtl+TollOverWorthCostDtl))TotalNetAmount
	            FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
				GROUP BY ProcessID,ProcessNo,FiscalYear,SerialNo,GoodsID)D2
	ON H.ProcessID=D2.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=D2.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=D2.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=D2.SerialNo
	INNER JOIN (SELECT * 
	            FROM inv.tblGoods 
				WHERE BarCode in (
								SELECT BarCode 
								FROM inv.tblGoods 
								WHERE LTRIM(BarCode)<>''
								group by BarCode
								HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
								) G
	ON D.GoodsID=G.GoodsID AND G.PartNumber=1
	INNER JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl GD
	ON D.GoodsID=GD.GoodsID AND LanguageID = 1
	INNER JOIN acc.tblAcnt A on A.PartNumber = @PartNo AND A.AcntCode=SUBSTRING(H.AcntCode,@Start,@LEN)
	WHERE H.ProcessID in (90,100) AND D.StoreID in ('04008') AND CreateTime>=@StartDate 
	order by InvoiceDate
END

)
RETURNS NVarChar(500)
--WITH ENCRYPTION
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Result    AS NVarChar(500)
	DECLARE @Parent_ID AS Int

	--Select *
	--From dbo.Sections
	--Where Title Like N'%سالن شکر%'
	--Order By Title

    -- ======================================================== Select
	--Select S1.Sec_No, S1.Title Name, S2.Sec_No Parent_ID, S2.Title Parent_Name
	Select @Parent_ID = S2.Sec_No
	From dbo.Sections S1
	Inner Join dbo.Sections S2 ON S2.Sec_No = S1.TFather
	Where S1.Sec_No = @Section_No
	Order By S1.Title

    -- ========================================================
	IF @Parent_ID IN(8, 9, 184)

	End

	End

    -- ======================================================== Result
	RETURN IsNull(@Result, '')
END

Create PROCEDURE [emp].[RptEmp_Vacation_Mission_OverTimeWork_Statistics_Month]

DECLARE @StrSelect	NVarChar(max);

DECLARE	@Vacation	int=1;

DECLARE	@OverTimeWork	int=1;

Declare @StrSelectVacation nvarchar(max)=''
DECLARE	@StrSelectMission nvarchar(max)=''
DECLARE	@StrSelectOverTimeWork nvarchar(max)=''
DECLARE @StrUnion nvarchar(20) 

DECLARE @StrOrder nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @SumConfirm int=0
Declare @SumVocatiomMissionOverTime int=0  
  
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF (@RepInfo	Is Null)	SET @RepInfo = '1@1@1'
	IF (@RepOptions Is Null)	SET @RepOptions = '111';

	SET @LangID		= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 1);
	SET @SessionNo	= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 2);
	SET @ReportID	= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 3);
	

	SET @Confirm0	= Substring(@RepOptions, 1, 1); -- تایید شود
	SET @Confirm1	= Substring(@RepOptions, 2, 1); -- رد شود
	SET @Confirm2	= Substring(@RepOptions, 3, 1); -- بررسی نشود

	SET @Vacation	= Substring(@RepOptions,4, 1); -- مرخصی
	SET @Mission	= Substring(@RepOptions,5, 1); -- ماموریت
	SET @OverTimeWork	= Substring(@RepOptions,6, 1); -- اضافه کاری
	
	SET @rdoGroupDate	= Substring(@RepOptions,7, 1); -- گروه بندی بر اساس تاریخ
	SET @rdoGroupPersonel	= Substring(@RepOptions,8, 1); --  گروه بندی بر اساس پرسنل
	SET @OrderPersonelCode= Substring(@RepOptions,9, 1); -- مرتب سازی بر اساس کد پرسنلی
	SET @OrderPersonelName =Substring(@RepOptions,10, 1); -- مرتب سازی بر اساس نام پرسنل
	SET @OrderDate=Substring(@RepOptions,11, 1); -- مرتب سازی بر اساس تاریخ

	SET @StrWhere=''
	set @StrConfirmFilter=''
	SET @StrWhereVocation=''
	SET @StrWhereMission=''
	SET @StrWhereOverTimeWork=''
	SET @StrUnion='Union All'
	SET @StrOrder=''
	-- Where Clause -----------------------------------------------------------
	set @SumConfirm=@Confirm0+@Confirm1+@Confirm2
	
	set @SumVocatiomMissionOverTime=@Vacation+@Mission+@OverTimeWork

	if (@SumVocatiomMissionOverTime=0)
	BEGIN
	  
	   SET @Vacation=1
	   SET @Mission=1
	   SET @OverTimeWork=1

	END

	if (@SumConfirm =0)
	BEGIN
	  
	   Set @Confirm0=1 
	   Set @Confirm1=1
	   Set @Confirm2=1

	END
	

	--select @Confirm0 , @Confirm1,@Confirm2 , @Vacation , @Mission , @OverTimeWork

	IF (@PersonnelIDFr Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (pd.PersonnelID >= ''' + @PersonnelIDFr + ''')'

	IF (@PersonnelIDTo Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (pd.PersonnelID <= ''' + @PersonnelIDTo + ''')'

    
	SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere +'And (vh.StartDate>='''+@DateFrom+''' and vh.StartDate<='''+@DateTo+''')'  -- تاریخ
	

	IF (@Confirm0 = 1 and @SumConfirm<>0 ) -- اگر تایید شود
		SET @StrConfirmFilter = ',0'

	IF (@Confirm1 = 1 and @SumConfirm<>0) -- اگر رد شود
		SET @StrConfirmFilter = @StrConfirmFilter + ',1 '

	IF (@Confirm2 = 1 and @SumConfirm<>0) -- اگر بررسی نشود
		SET @StrConfirmFilter = @StrConfirmFilter + ',2'

	IF @SumConfirm <>0
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND vh.NotConfirm   in (-1' + @StrConfirmFilter + ') '

	IF(@VocationType is not null)and @VocationType<>''
	set @StrWhereVocation='AND (vh.VacationTypeID='+@VocationType+')'


	IF(@MissionType IS NOT NULL)and @MissionType<>''
	SET @StrWhereMission=' and (vh.MissionTypeID='+@MissionType+')'

	IF(@OverTimeWorkType IS NOT NULL)
	and @OverTimeWorkType<>''
	SET @StrWhereOverTimeWork=' AND (vh.OverTimeWorkTypeID='+@OverTimeWorkType +')'




	IF(@OrderDate=1)
	SET @StrOrder=' order by A.StartDate '

	IF(@OrderPersonelCode=1)
	SET @StrOrder=' order by A.PersonnelID '

	IF(@OrderPersonelName=1)
	SET @StrOrder=' order by A.LastName '
	  


	IF (@Vacation = 1 )
		set @StrSelectVacation='SELECT vh.DocStep as HeaderDocStep, vd.DocStep as DetailDocStep ,  vh.ConfirmerPersID ,  case vh.ProcessID when 350 then N''مرخصی روزانه'' when 351 then N''مرخصی ساعتی'' when 360 then N''ماموریت روزانه'' when 361 then N''ماموریت ساعتی'' when 371 then N''اضافه کاری روزانه'' when 370 then N''اضافه کاری ساعتی'' end as VocationType ,   vd.VacationTypeID, ISNULL( vtd.VacationTypeName ,'''') VacationTypeName,  vh.PersonnelID, pd.FirstName, pd.LastName, pd.FatherName, vd.StartTime, vd.EndTime, vd.StartDate, vd.EndDate
                         FROM            emp.tblVacationDtl AS vd INNER JOIN
                         emp.tblVacationHdr AS vh ON vd.ProcessID = vh.ProcessID AND vd.SerialNo = vh.SerialNo INNER JOIN
                         prs.tblPersonnelsDtl AS pd ON pd.PersonnelID = vh.PersonnelID						
						 left join emp.tblVacationTypesDtl vtd on vtd.VacationTypeID=vh.VacationTypeID	 and vtd.LanguageID='+@LangID+'
                         where vh.ProcessID in (350,351)'+@StrWhere +@StrWhereVocation
						
	IF (@Mission = 1)
	BEGIN

	   set @StrSelectMission=' SELECT vh.DocStep as HeaderDocStep, vd.DocStep as DetailDocStep ,  vh.ConfirmerPersID ,  case vh.ProcessID when 350 then N''مرخصی روزانه'' when 351 then N''مرخصی ساعتی'' when 360 then N''ماموریت روزانه'' when 361 then N''ماموریت ساعتی'' when 371 then N''اضافه کاری روزانه'' when 370 then N''اضافه کاری ساعتی'' end as VocationType ,   vd.MissionTypeID as VacationTypeID,  ISNULL(vtd.MissionTypeName,'''') VacationTypeName,  vh.PersonnelID, pd.FirstName, pd.LastName, pd.FatherName, vd.StartTime, vd.EndTime, vd.StartDate, vd.EndDate
                         FROM            emp.tblVacationDtl AS vd INNER JOIN
                         emp.tblVacationHdr AS vh ON vd.ProcessID = vh.ProcessID AND vd.SerialNo = vh.SerialNo INNER JOIN
                         prs.tblPersonnelsDtl AS pd ON pd.PersonnelID = vh.PersonnelID						
						 left join emp.tblMissionTypesDtl vtd on vtd.MissionTypeID=vh.MissionTypeID and vtd.LanguageID='+@LangID+'
						 where vh.ProcessID in(360,361)'+@StrWhere+@StrWhereMission


       IF(@Vacation=1)
	   SET @StrSelectMission=@StrUnion+@StrSelectMission
	
	END
		
	IF (@OverTimeWork =1)
	BEGIN
	   set @StrSelectOverTimeWork=' SELECT  vh.DocStep as HeaderDocStep, vd.DocStep as DetailDocStep ,  vh.ConfirmerPersID ,    case vh.ProcessID when 350 then N''مرخصی روزانه'' when 351 then N''مرخصی ساعتی'' when 360 then N''ماموریت روزانه'' when 361 then N''ماموریت ساعتی'' when 371 then N''اضافه کاری روزانه'' when 370 then N''اضافه کاری ساعتی'' end as VocationType ,   vh.OverTimeWorkTypeID as VacationTypeID, ISNULL( vtd.OverTimeWorkTypeName ,'''') VacationTypeName ,  vh.PersonnelID, pd.FirstName, pd.LastName, pd.FatherName, vd.StartTime, vd.EndTime, vd.StartDate, vd.EndDate
                         FROM            emp.tblVacationDtl AS vd INNER JOIN
                         emp.tblVacationHdr AS vh ON vd.ProcessID = vh.ProcessID AND vd.SerialNo = vh.SerialNo INNER JOIN
                         prs.tblPersonnelsDtl AS pd ON pd.PersonnelID = vh.PersonnelID
						 left join emp.tblOverTimeWorkTypesDtl vtd on vtd.OverTimeWorkTypeID=vh.OverTimeWorkTypeID and vtd.LanguageID='+@LangID+'
						 where vh.ProcessID in (370,371)'+@StrWhere+@StrWhereOverTimeWork
        IF(@Vacation=1 OR @Mission=1)
	    SET @StrSelectOverTimeWork=@StrUnion+@StrSelectOverTimeWork
	
	END
				
	
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	SET @StrSelect = @StrSelectVacation++@StrSelectMission+@StrSelectOverTimeWork
	SET @StrSelect='SELECT *   ,  case A.EndDate when '''' then A.StartDate else A.EndDate end as CustomEndDate , case A.EndDate  when '''' then 0 else    DATEDIFF(Day ,pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian( A.StartDate),pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian( A.EndDate) )+1  end as DayDiff ,case A.StartTime  when '''' then 0 else  DATEDIFF(MINUTE , A.StartTime, A.EndTime )  end as TimeDiff FROM ( '+@StrSelect+' )A'+@StrOrder
	
   --	select @StrWhere
	
    -- select @StrSelect
	-- Run -----------------------------------------------------
	print @StrSelect;
	Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
	------------------------------------------------------------
END

create view inv.vwExport_Goods_Sale
as
	SELECT H.GoodsID, H.BarCode, D.GoodsName ,H.UnitID,ISNULL(SubUnitID,'') SubUnitID,ISNULL(UnitValue,1)UnitValue,ISNULL(MainUnitValue,1)MainUnitValue,
	  	  (SELECT SUM (ISNULL(O,0)) FROM (
		                            SELECT (SELECT  TOP 1 QtyRemain
			  							    FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S
										    WHERE S.GoodsID =D.GoodsID AND S.StoreID = t.StoreID
										    ORDER BY DocDate DESC,VolumeRowNo  DESC
										  ) AS O
								    FROM inv.tblStores  t  
										)u
		  ) AS GoodsRemain
	FROM inv.tblGoodsDtl D
			inner join inv.tblGoods H ON H.GoodsID = D.GoodsID
			LEFT join (SELECT  * FROM inv.tblSubUnitsDtl) S ON H.GoodsID = S.GoodsID

CREATE VIEW [inv].[vwExport_StorageDocsDtl]
AS
	SELECT  D.SerialNo AS 'شماره سند', 
			P.ProcessName AS 'نوع سند', 
			D.DocDate AS 'تاريخ سند', 
			pub.GetCodeName(D.AcntCode, 1) AS 'نام مشتری', 
			acc.funLayerAcntName(D.AcntCode, 2, 1) as 'تفصیلی 1',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(D.AcntCode, 2, 2) as 'تفصیلی 2',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(D.AcntCode, 2, 3) as 'تفصیلی 3',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(D.AcntCode, 2, 4) as 'تفصیلی 4',
            D.AcntCode AS 'کد مشتری',
			D.VisitorAcntCode AS 'کد ويزيتور',
			inv.funLayerGoodsName(D.GoodsID, 1) as 'نام 1 کالا',
			inv.funLayerGoodsName(D.GoodsID, 2) as 'نام 2 کالا',
			inv.funLayerGoodsName(D.GoodsID, 3) as 'نام 3 کالا',
			inv.funLayerGoodsName(D.GoodsID, 4) as 'نام 4 کالا',
--			G.GoodsName AS 'نام کالا',
			D.GoodsID AS 'کد کالا', 
			D.GoodsQuantity AS 'واحد اصلی', 
            D.SubUnitQuantity AS 'واحد فرعی', 
			D.GoodsPrice AS 'فی',
			(D.SubUnitPrice * D.SubUnitQuantity) AS 'مبلغ سطر', 
			D.DiscountDtl AS 'تخفيف سطر', 
            pub.GetCodeName(D.VisitorAcntCode, 1) AS 'نام ويزيتور', 
			CK.CustomerKindName AS 'نوع مشتری',
			H.BaseDistributionSerialNo as 'شماره فرم'
	FROM	inv.tblStorageDocsDtl AS D 
				INNER JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsHdr as H on H.ProcessID = D.ProcessID AND H.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo and H.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear and H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
				INNER JOIN pub.tblProcess AS P ON P.ProcessID = D.ProcessID AND P.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo 
--				INNER JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl AS G ON G.GoodsID = D.GoodsID AND G.LanguageID = 1 
				INNER JOIN sal.tblCustomerKindsDtl AS CK ON CK.CustomerKindID = pub.funGetCustomerKindID(D.AcntCode) AND CK.LanguageID = 1

CREATE VIEW [inv].[vwExport_StorageDocsHdr]
AS
	select	H.SerialNo as 'شماره سند', 
			P.ProcessName as 'نوع سند', 
			H.DocDate as 'تاریخ سند', 
			pub.GetCodeName(H.AcntCode, 1) as 'نام مشتری', 
			H.AcntCode as 'کد مشتری',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(H.AcntCode, 2, 1) as 'تفصیلی 1',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(H.AcntCode, 2, 2) as 'تفصیلی 2',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(H.AcntCode, 2, 3) as 'تفصیلی 3',
			acc.funLayerAcntName(H.AcntCode, 2, 4) as 'تفصیلی 4',
			CK.CustomerKindName AS 'نوع مشتري',

-- Last Modified : 1390/05/18
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Description   : اسناد انبار
-- =============================================
CREATE View [inv].[vwStorageDocsHdr]
As
	SELECT *, 0-([CurrencyDiscount]*CurrencyRate)-
	            (CurrencyTransportationCost *CurrencyRate ) +
				(CurrencyTransportationIncome *CurrencyRate ) -
	            [Discount]-[Discount2]-[Discount3]-[TotalLineDiscount]-[AfterSaleDiscount]-[EarnestMoney]-[OtherCost]-[TransportationCost]	+
				[OtherIncome]+[TransportationIncome]+[PackingCost]+[TaxCost]-[FixCost]	+[IAToll]+
				case when DiscountTaxOverWorth=1 then 0 else  	[TaxOverWorthCost]+[TollOverWorthCost] end 	+[IAToll]-[DistributeAmount] AS SidePriceSum
	FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr

Create View [inv].[vwStorageDocsHdr_Currency]
As
	SELECT *,case when (CurrencyRate=0) then 0 else (1/CurrencyRate) end *( 0-[Discount]-[Discount2]-[Discount3]-[TotalLineDiscount]-[AfterSaleDiscount]-[OtherCost]-[TransportationCost]+[OtherIncome]+[TransportationIncome]+[PackingCost]+[TaxCost]-[FixCost]+[TaxOverWorthCost]+[TollOverWorthCost]+[IAToll]-[DistributeAmount]) AS SidePriceSum
	FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H

CREATE VIEW [inv].[vwStorageDtl]
AS
	select	ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, VolumeRowNo, PhysicallyEffected, 
			EnterKind, D.GoodsID, SubUnitID, SubUnitQuantity, GoodsQuantity, QtyRemain, GoodsAmount, 
			AtomAmount, GoodsPrice, DescDtl, BaseDocRowNo, DiscountPercentDtl, 
			DiscountDtl, BaseDocDate, VirtualQuantity, IsReward, GoodsID2, Wage, WageRate, 
			FormulaProductCount, CurrencyAmount, CalculatingAmount, VchDate2, G1.GoodsName, 
			G2.GoodsName GoodsName2, U.UnitName SubUnitName,
			case when (D.EnterKind > 0) then D.GoodsQuantity else 0 end QuantityInput,
			case when (D.EnterKind < 0) then D.GoodsQuantity else 0 end QuantityOutput,
			case when (D.EnterKind > 0) then D.GoodsAmount else 0 end AmountInput,
			case when (D.EnterKind < 0) then D.GoodsAmount else 0 end AmountOutput
			,BatchNo,VirtualQuantity Qty
	from	inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
				left join inv.tblGoodsDtl G1 on G1.GoodsID = D.GoodsID 
				left join inv.tblGoodsDtl G2 on G2.GoodsID = D.GoodsID2
				left join inv.tblUnitsDtl U on U.UnitID = D.SubUnitID

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia

-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
Create VIEW [inv].[vwStorageDtl_Currency]
AS
SELECT D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, D.RowNo, D.DocRowNo, D.VolumeRowNo, D.DocStep, D.DocDate, D.StoreID, 
	   D.PhysicallyEffected, D.EnterKind, D.StoreID2, D.AcntCode, D.VisitorAcntCode, D.OrderAcntCode, D.GoodsID, D.SubUnitID, 
	   D.GoodsID3, D.GoodsQuantity3, D.SubUnitQuantity3, D.GoodsPrice3, D.SubUnitID3, D.Height, D.Width, 
	   D.ServiceAmount, D.Price0, D.SaleTypeID, D.VisitorPercent,D.VisitorPercent2,D.VisitorAcntCode2, D.SubUnitQuantity, D.GoodsQuantity, D.QtyRemain, 
	   D.BaseFiscalYear, D.BaseSerialNo, D.BaseDocRowNo, D.BaseDocType, D.AgreeNo, D.BatchNo, D.BaseDocDate, 
	   D.DiscountPercentDtl, D.CustomerCode,
	   CASE WHEN (H.CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/H.CurrencyRate) END * D.DiscountDtl DiscountDtl,
	   CASE WHEN (H.CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/H.CurrencyRate) END * D.DiscountDtl DiscountDtl2,
	   CASE WHEN (H.CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/H.CurrencyRate) END * D.GoodsAmount GoodsAmount, 
	   D.AmntRemain, isnull((Select Sum(GoodsQuantity * CurrencyAmount)
					  From inv.tblStorageDocsAtom
					  Where  ProcessID=D.ProcessID And ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo And FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear And 
							 SerialNo=D.SerialNo And DocRowNo = D.DocRowNo),0) AtomAmount, 
	   CASE WHEN (H.CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/H.CurrencyRate) END * D.GoodsPrice GoodsPrice, D.DescDtl, D.BaseProcessID, D.BaseProcessNo, 
	   D.VirtualQuantity, D.IsReward,D.IsReward0, D.FormulaNo, D.GoodsID2, D.Wage, D.WageRate, D.FormulaProductCount, D.CurrencyAmount, D.CalculatingAmount, 
	   D.VchDate2, CASE WHEN (H.CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/H.CurrencyRate) END * D.SubUnitPrice SubUnitPrice,
	   CASE WHEN (H.CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/H.CurrencyRate) END * D.SubUnitPrice2 SubUnitPrice2,D.UserGoodsAmount,

	select	H.ProcessID, H.ProcessNo, H.FiscalYear, H.SerialNo, H.FormulaNo, H.DocDate, H.StoreID, 
			H.AcntCode, H.VisitorAcntCode, H.OrderAcntCode, H.Amount, H.Discount + H.Discount2 + H.Discount3 as DiscountHdr, 
			H.TotalLineDiscount, H.VchNo, H.WageRate, H.ProductCount, H.ProductID, D.SaleTypeID, 
			H.VisitorCostAcntCode, H.VisitorCost, H.DiscountAcntCode,

			H.Price, H.TaxOverWorthCost, H.VchNo2, H.SettlementDate, H.TransportationIncomeAcntCode, 
			H.TransportationIncome, H.OtherCostAcntCode, H.OtherIncomeAcntCode, H.OtherCost, H.OtherIncome, 
			H.AfterSaleDiscount, H.AfterSaleVchNo, H.AfterSaleDate, H.AfterSaleDiscountAcntCode, H.VchDate, 
			H.TollOverWorthCost, H.DriverID, D.StoreID2 as StoreID22,
			D.DocRowNo, D.VolumeRowNo, D.PhysicallyEffected, D.EnterKind, D.GoodsID, D.SubUnitID,

			D.IsReward, D.FormulaProductCount, G1.GoodsName,
			P1.ProcessName,	I1.StoreName, I2.StoreName as StoreName22, ST.SaleTypeName, 
			pub.GetCodeName(H.AcntCode, 1) AcntName,
			H.Amount-H.Discount-H.Discount2-H.Discount3-H.FixCost-H.OtherCost-H.DistributeAmount-H.TransportationCost-H.OtherIncome+H.TransportationIncome+H.PackingCost+H.TaxCost+H.TaxOverWorthCost+H.TollOverWorthCost AS TotalPrice,
			cast(Substring(H.DocDate, 6, 2) as int) as MonthCode, pub.funGetTypeText(10, cast(Substring(H.DocDate, 6, 2) as int), 1) as MonthName
			,H.GoodsReciverID 
			/*
			H.CurrencyTypeID, H.CurrencyRate, H.StoreID2, H.BaseProcessID, H.BaseProcessNo, H.BaseFiscalYear, H.BaseSerialNo,
			H.TransporterID, H.LocationID, H.TransportationCost, H.PackingCost, H.TaxCost, 
			D.GoodsID2, D.CurrencyAmount, D.Wage, U.UnitName SubUnitName,
			I2.StoreName StoreName2, DR.FirstName + ' ' + DR.LastName as DriverName, CT.CurrencyTypeName, 
			TR.TransporterName, LC.LocationName, G2.GoodsName GoodsName2, 
			pub.GetCodeName(H.VisitorAcntCode, 1) VisitorAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.OrderAcntCode, 1) OrderAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.VisitorCostAcntCode, 1) VisitorCostAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.DiscountAcntCode, 1) DiscountAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.EarnestMoneyAcntCode, 1) EarnestMoneyAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.TransportationCostAcntCode, 1) TransportationCostAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.TransportationIncomeAcntCode, 1) TransportationIncomeAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.OtherCostAcntCode, 1) OtherCostAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.OtherIncomeAcntCode, 1) OtherIncomeAcntName,
			pub.GetCodeName(H.AfterSaleDiscountAcntCode, 1) AfterSaleDiscountAcntName,*/
	from inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H
		inner join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D on H.ProcessID = D.ProcessID AND H.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo and H.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear and H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
		left join pub.tblProcess P1 on P1.ProcessID = H.ProcessID and P1.ProcessNo = H.ProcessNo
		left join pub.tblProcess P2 on P2.ProcessID = H.BaseProcessID and P2.ProcessNo = H.BaseProcessNo
		left join sal.tblSaleTypesDtl ST on ST.SaleTypeID = D.SaleTypeID
		left join inv.tblStoresDtl I1 on I1.StoreID = H.StoreID 
		left join inv.tblStoresDtl I2 on I2.StoreID = D.StoreID2
		left join inv.tblGoodsDtl G1 on G1.GoodsID = D.GoodsID

		/*left join inv.tblUnitsDtl U on U.UnitID = D.SubUnitID*/
		/*left join inv.tblStoresDtl I2 on I2.StoreID = H.StoreID2*/
		/*left join pub.tblCurrencyTypesDtl CT on CT.CurrencyTypeID = H.CurrencyTypeID*/
		/*left join sal.tblTransportersDtl TR on TR.TransporterID = H.TransporterID*/
		/*left join pub.tblLocationsDtl LC on LC.LocationID = H.LocationID*/
		/*left join pub.tblDriversDtl DR on DR.DriverID = H.DriverID*/
