CREATE VIEW [inv].[vwStorageHdr]
AS
	SELECT H.ProcessID, H.ProcessNo, H.FiscalYear, H.SerialNo, FormulaNo, DocDate, H.StoreID, 
		   H.StoreID2, H.AcntCode, VisitorAcntCode, OrderAcntCode, H.CurrencyTypeID, CurrencyRate, 
		   Amount, DiscountPercent, Discount,Discount2,Discount3 , TotalLineDiscount, BaseProcessID, 
		   BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo, VchNo, DocDesc, WageRate, ProductCount, 
		   ProductID, AgreeNo, H.SaleTypeID, H.TransporterID, H.LocationID, TransportationCost, 
		   PackingCost, TaxCost, VisitorCostAcntCode, VisitorPercent, VisitorCost, DiscountAcntCode, 
		   EarnestMoney, EarnestMoneyPercent, EarnestMoneyAcntCode, BatchNo, TransportationCostAcntCode, 
		   Price, TaxOverWorthCost, VchNo2, IsConfirmed, SettlementDate, TransportationIncomeAcntCode, 
		   TransportationIncome, OtherCostAcntCode, OtherIncomeAcntCode, OtherCost, OtherIncome, 
		   DocDate2, DocDate3, DocDate4, AfterSaleDiscount, AfterSaleDesc, AfterSaleVchNo, AfterSaleDate, 
		   OldSerialNo, HardRecivable, IsAutoDoc, AfterSaleDiscountAcntCode, VchDate, TollOverWorthCost, 
		   H.DriverID, DistributerID1, DistributerID2, BaseDistributionProcessID, BaseDistributionProcessNo, 
		   BaseDistributionFiscalYear, BaseDistributionSerialNo, DestinationAddress, BaseSaleSerialNo,
		   P1.ProcessName,	P2.ProcessName as BaseProcessName, P3.ProcessName BaseDProcessName,
		   I1.StoreName, I2.StoreName StoreName2, DR.FirstName + ' ' + DR.LastName as DriverName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(AcntCode, 1) AcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(VisitorAcntCode, 1) VisitorAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(OrderAcntCode, 1) OrderAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(VisitorCostAcntCode, 1) VisitorCostAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(DiscountAcntCode, 1) DiscountAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(EarnestMoneyAcntCode, 1) EarnestMoneyAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(TransportationCostAcntCode, 1) TransportationCostAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(TransportationIncomeAcntCode, 1) TransportationIncomeAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(OtherCostAcntCode, 1) OtherCostAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(OtherIncomeAcntCode, 1) OtherIncomeAcntName,
		   pub.GetCodeName(AfterSaleDiscountAcntCode, 1) AfterSaleDiscountAcntName,
		   CT.CurrencyTypeName, ST.SaleTypeName, TR.TransporterName, LC.LocationName,H.GoodsReciverID,
		   Amount - Discount - Discount2-Discount3 - OtherCost - TransportationCost - EarnestMoney + 
		   OtherIncome + TransportationIncome + PackingCost + TaxCost + TaxOverWorthCost + 
		   TollOverWorthCost AS TotalPrice, isnull(F.MemberDate, '') MemberDate,DocDesc2,
		   CurrencyTransportationCost, CurrencyTransportationIncome
	FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblProcess P1 ON P1.ProcessID = H.ProcessID 
								   AND P1.ProcessNo = H.ProcessNo
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblProcess P2 ON P2.ProcessID = H.BaseProcessID 
								   AND P2.ProcessNo = H.BaseProcessNo
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblProcess P3 ON P3.ProcessID = H.BaseDistributionProcessID 
								   AND P3.ProcessNo = H.BaseDistributionProcessNo
		LEFT JOIN inv.tblStoresDtl I1 ON I1.StoreID = H.StoreID 
		LEFT JOIN inv.tblStoresDtl I2 ON I2.StoreID = H.StoreID2
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblCurrencyTypesDtl CT ON CT.CurrencyTypeID = H.CurrencyTypeID
		LEFT JOIN sal.tblSaleTypesDtl ST ON ST.SaleTypeID = H.SaleTypeID
		LEFT JOIN sal.tblTransportersDtl TR ON TR.TransporterID = H.TransporterID
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblLocationsDtl LC ON LC.LocationID = H.LocationID
		LEFT JOIN pub.tblDriversDtl DR ON DR.DriverID = H.DriverID
		OUTER APPLY acc.funGetCodeInfo(H.AcntCode) AS F

		   TaxSerialNo,TaxSerialNoInvoice,0 BascolWeight,0 WasteWeight,0 PureWeight,0 LoadWeight,DiscountPercent2, CurrencyTransportationCost, CurrencyTransportationIncome,
		   KotagNo,KotagDate,AssessmentLocation,ExitLocation,PriceParvane ,DescRetSaleID,ExtraField1,SenderDepartmentID,
		   NetWeightHdr,GrossWeight,CurrencyValue,DeclaredCompanyName, TaxID, BaseTaxID,TPInp ,TPEdited,PayType,TPContractNo,DocDesc2,SourceFiscalYear,SourceSerialNo,TransportationKindID,
		   NoSentTTMS,TPEditedDate,ProdManUnitCount,ProdManSubUnitCount, Export

storedProcedures.name: RptStore_Stock_PharmacyGroup
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Ahmadnejad
-- Create date   : 1386
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1392/08/29
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Hamid
-- Description   : <Store Stock>
-- ==============================================
Create PROCEDURE [inv].[RptStore_Stock_PharmacyGroup]
	@SelectedStore		Int = 0,
	@SelectedGoods		Int = 0,
	@DocDateFr			Char(10) = Null,
	@DocDateTo			Char(10) = Null,
	@IncludeQuantity	Bit = 1, -- شامل ستون مقدار
	@IncludePrice		Bit = 1, -- شامل ستون قیمت
	@IncludePrim		Bit = 1, -- شامل ستون اول دوره
	@IncludeInput		Bit = 1, -- شامل ستون ورود
	@IncludeOutput		Bit = 1, -- شامل ستون خروج
	@IncludeGroup		Bit = 1, -- شامل ستون گروه
	@IncludeNoCurrent	Bit = 1, -- شامل کالاهای بدون گردش
	@AmountWithoutQty	Bit = 0, -- مانده ریالی برای کالاهای با موجودی صفر نیز محاسبه شود 
	@IncludeZeroAmount	Bit = 1, -- شامل ردیفهای بدون قیمت
	@IncludeZeroQuantity	Bit = 1, -- شامل کالاهای با موجودی صفر یا کمتر
	@GroupByStore		Bit = 1, -- به تفکیک انبار
	@SortFields			NVarChar(100) = Null,
	@RepInfo			NVarChar(100) = '1@1@1@1@1',
	@ExtraParams		NVarChar(200) = Null
	
--WITH ENCRYPTION
AS 
---- Declarations ---------------
DECLARE @StrSelect	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @StrFrom	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @StrWhere	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @AllGoods	NVarChar(4000);
DECLARE @StrGroup	NVarChar(2000);
DECLARE @StrStore	NVarChar(2000);
DECLARE @StrHaving	NVarChar(2000);
DECLARE @StrAmount	NVarChar(4000);
DECLARE @StrYear	Char(4);
Declare @GoodsAmount varchar(20)
Declare @LastCalc char(10)

DECLARE	@LangID		Char(1);
DECLARE	@SessionNo	Int; 
DECLARE	@ReportID	Int;
DECLARE	@UserID		Int;
DECLARE	@UserIsAdmin bit;

DECLARE @DateField	NVarchar(20);

DECLARE @DrugExpDateFrom	VarChar(20);
DECLARE @DrugExpDateTo	VarChar(20);

Begin --============== S T A R T  C O D E ===================================================

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Init Variables ----------------------------------------------------------
	IF (@SelectedGoods Is Null) SET @SelectedGoods = 0;
	IF (@SelectedStore Is Null) SET @SelectedStore = 0;

	SET @LangID		= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 1);
	SET @SessionNo	= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 2);
	SET @ReportID	= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 3);
	SET @UserID		= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 4);
	SET @UserIsAdmin= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 5);

	SET @StrYear = LTrim(RIGHT(db_name(), 4));
	SET @GoodsAmount = LTRIM(inv.funGoodsAmount(@DocDateTo))

    SET @DrugExpDateFrom = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 1)); 
    SET @DrugExpDateTo = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 2)); 
	
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	set @LastCalc = ''
	
	select @LastCalc = IsNull(Max(ToDate), '')
	from inv.tblStorageCosts
	
	begin try
		drop table #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices
	end try
	begin catch
	end catch
	
	create table #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices
	(
		GoodsID varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		BuyPrice float not null
	);

	insert into #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices
	select *
	from 
	(
		select distinct GoodsID, 
			(
				select top 1 GoodsPrice
				from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D 
				where (D.GoodsID = M.GoodsID) and (D.ProcessID = 55)
				order by DocDate DESC, VolumeRowNo DESC
			) BuyPrice
		from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl M
	) T 
	where BuyPrice is not null

	update #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices
	set BuyPrice = GoodsPrice
	from inv.tblGoods
	where #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices.GoodsID = inv.tblGoods.GoodsID 
		and #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices.BuyPrice = 0

	insert into #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices(GoodsID, BuyPrice)
	select GoodsID, GoodsPrice
	from inv.tblGoods
	where GoodsID not in (select GoodsID from #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices)
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Where Clause ------------------------------------------------------------
	if (@IncludePrice = 1)
		--set @DateField = 'VchDate2'
		set @DateField = 'DocDate'
	else
		set @DateField = 'DocDate'

	SET @StrWhere = '(D.FiscalYear = ' + @StrYear + ') And D.GoodsID IN (Select GoodsID From inv.tblGoods Where IsService = 0)';

	If (@DocDateTo Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (D.' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' <= ''' + @DocDateTo + ''')'

	If (@IncludeZeroAmount = 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (D.GoodsAmount <> 0)'

	If (@SelectedGoods > 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedGoods, 'D.GoodsID') 
	If (@SelectedStore > 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedStore, 'D.StoreID') 

	if (@DrugExpDateFrom <> '')
		Set @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND D.ExpireDate >= ''' + @DrugExpDateFrom + ''''
	if (@DrugExpDateTo <> '')
		Set @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND D.ExpireDate <= ''' + @DrugExpDateTo + ''''
		
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	if (@IncludeNoCurrent = 1)
		set @AllGoods = ' 
			union all 
			select	50 ProcessID, ' + @StrYear + ' FiscalYear, ''0000/00/00'' DocDate, S.StoreID, 
					G.GoodsID, '''' ExpireDate, 0 GoodsQuantity, 0 GoodsAmount, 0 EnterKind, 0 PhysicallyEffected
			from	inv.tblStores S
						cross join inv.tblGoods G
			where  (StoreID <> '''') and (GoodsID <> '''')'
	else
		set @AllGoods = ''
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	IF (@GroupByStore = 1)
	begin
		SET @StrGroup = 'D.StoreID, D.GoodsID, GH.UnitID, D.ExpireDate'
		set @StrStore = 'D.StoreID'
	end
	Else
	begin
		SET @StrGroup = 'D.GoodsID, GH.UnitID, D.ExpireDate'
		set @StrStore = 'Cast(''-'' AS VarChar(20))'
	end

	set @StrAmount = @GoodsAmount + ' as GoodsAmount'

	-- Select Clause -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	SET @StrSelect = '
	SELECT	D.GoodsID, ' + ltrim(@StrStore) + ' StoreID, D.ExpireDate,' + 
			CASE WHEN (@DocDateFr Is Not Null) THEN '
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' <  ''' + @DocDateFr  + ''' THEN D.EnterKind * D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalQuantityPrim, 
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' >= ''' + @DocDateFr  + ''' AND D.EnterKind = +1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalQuantityInput,
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' >= ''' + @DocDateFr  + ''' AND D.EnterKind = -1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalQuantityOutput, 
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' <  ''' + @DocDateFr  + ''' THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsAmount ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalPricePrim,
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' >= ''' + @DocDateFr  + ''' AND D.EnterKind = +1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsAmount ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalPriceInput,
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' >= ''' + @DocDateFr  + ''' AND D.EnterKind = -1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsAmount ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalPriceOutput '
			ELSE '
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN D.ProcessID =  50 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalQuantityPrim, 
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN D.ProcessID <> 50 AND D.EnterKind = +1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalQuantityInput,
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN D.ProcessID <> 50 AND D.EnterKind = -1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalQuantityOutput, 
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN D.ProcessID =  50 THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsAmount ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalPricePrim,
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN D.ProcessID <> 50 AND D.EnterKind = +1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsAmount ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalPriceInput,
			isnull(SUM(CASE WHEN D.ProcessID <> 50 AND D.EnterKind = -1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsAmount ELSE 0 END),0) AS TotalPriceOutput '
			END + ', GH.UnitID
	into ##tbl_Store_Stock
	FROM
		(
			select ProcessID, FiscalYear, DocDate, StoreID, GoodsID, ExpireDate, GoodsQuantity, ' + LTRIM(@StrAmount) + ', EnterKind, PhysicallyEffected
			from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl ' + @AllGoods + '
		) D
		LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoods GH ON GH.GoodsID = D.GoodsID 
		LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl GD ON GD.GoodsID = GH.GoodsID
	WHERE	' + @StrWhere + '
	GROUP BY ' + @StrGroup
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	-- Having Clause ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	IF (@IncludeZeroQuantity = 0) 
	Begin
		IF (@StrSelect <> '') 
		
			SET @StrSelect = @StrSelect + 
				CASE WHEN (@DocDateFr Is Not Null) THEN 
					' HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' <  ''' + @DocDateFr + ''' THEN D.GoodsQuantity * D.EnterKind ELSE 0 END) +
							 SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' >= ''' + @DocDateFr + ''' AND D.EnterKind = +1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END) -
							 SUM(CASE WHEN ' + LTrim(@DateField) + ' >= ''' + @DocDateFr + ''' AND D.EnterKind = -1 THEN D.GoodsQuantity ELSE 0 END) > 0 '
				ELSE + ' HAVING SUM(D.GoodsQuantity*D.EnterKind) > 0 ' 
				END   
	End

	begin try
		drop table ##tbl_Store_Stock
	end try
	begin catch
	end catch
	
	-- Run -----------------------------------------------------
	print @StrSelect;
	Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

	if (@UserIsAdmin = 0)
	begin
		exec pub.SpFilterByPermission2 '##tbl_Store_Stock', 'StoreID', 'inv.tblStores', @UserID;
		exec pub.SpFilterByPermission2 '##tbl_Store_Stock', 'GoodsID', 'inv.tblGoods', @UserID;
	end
	
	set @StrSelect = '
	select	D.*, GD.GoodsName, UD.UnitName, GH.TechnicalNo, GH.TechnicalSpecifications, S.StoreName, 
			''' + @LastCalc + ''' as LastAmountDate
	from	##tbl_Store_Stock D
			left join #tbl_RptStore_Stock_Prices P on P.GoodsID = D.GoodsID
			left join inv.tblGoods GH on GH.GoodsID = D.GoodsID 
			left join inv.tblGoodsDtl GD on GD.GoodsID = D.GoodsID 
			left join inv.tblUnitsDtl UD ON UD.UnitID = D.UnitID 
			left join inv.tblStoresDtl S ON S.StoreID = D.StoreID'
				
	-- Sort Clause ---------------------------------------------
	If (@SortFields Is Not Null) AND (@SortFields <> '') 
		SET @StrSelect = @StrSelect + ' 
	ORDER BY ' + @SortFields
	------------------------------------------------------------
	print @StrSelect;
	Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

	------------------------------------------------------------
End

Create PROCEDURE inv.SpTransferTaskDoingDtl
AS
Begin
	select 	h.* into #tblStorageDocsDtl
	from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl h
	inner join  pln.tblTaskOrderHdr t
	on h.BaseProcessID=t.ProcessID	and h.BaseProcessNo=t.ProcessNo	and h.BaseFiscalYear=t.FiscalYear	and h.BaseSerialNo=t.SerialNo
	where h.ProcessID in (72,73) and h.BaseProcessID=610 and TaskStateID<>4
	order by h.ProcessID, h.ProcessNo, h.FiscalYear, h.SerialNo, h.DocRowNo

	update #tblStorageDocsDtl
	set EnterKind=0
	select * from #tblStorageDocsDtl
	order by ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo


End

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 1391/01/16
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Description	 : Inv Transfer Docs
-- ----------------------------------------------
--  اسناد امانی جهت انتقال
-- ==============================================
Create PROCEDURE [inv].[SpTransferTrustListDtl] 
	@ProcessID1	int,
	@ProcessID2	int
AS
Begin
	select T.*,CASE WHEN S.SubUnitID IS NULL THEN RemainQuantity ELSE RemainQuantity*UnitValue/MainUnitValue END SubRemainQuantity
	into #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain
	from
	(
		select	D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, D.RowNo,GoodsID, SubUnitID,
				D.GoodsQuantity - 
				isnull((
					select SUM(I.GoodsQuantity)
					from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl I
					where (I.ProcessID = @ProcessID2) 
						and (I.BaseProcessID = D.ProcessID) 
						and (I.BaseProcessNo = D.ProcessNo) 
						and (I.BaseFiscalYear = D.FiscalYear) 
						and (I.BaseSerialNo = D.SerialNo) 
						and (I.GoodsID = D.GoodsID) 
						and (I.BaseDocRowNo = D.DocRowNo) 
				),0) RemainQuantity
		from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
		where D.ProcessID = @ProcessID1
	) T
	LEFT JOIN inv.tblSubUnitsDtl S ON T.GoodsID=S.GoodsID and T.SubUnitID=S.SubUnitID

	select D.*
	into #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
	from #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain R 
			inner join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D on D.ProcessID = R.ProcessID and D.ProcessNo = R.ProcessNo and D.FiscalYear = R.FiscalYear and D.SerialNo = R.SerialNo and D.RowNo = R.RowNo
	where (R.RemainQuantity > 0)

	update #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
	set #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.GoodsQuantity = R.RemainQuantity, 
		#tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.SubUnitQuantity = R.SubRemainQuantity,
		#tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.EnterKind = 0
	from #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result D 
			inner join #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain R on D.ProcessID = R.ProcessID and D.ProcessNo = R.ProcessNo and D.FiscalYear = R.FiscalYear and D.SerialNo = R.SerialNo and D.RowNo = R.RowNo
	
	select *
	from #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
	order by ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo
End

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia

-- Viewed By	 :

CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[SpTransferTrustListHdr] 
	@ProcessID1	int,
	@ProcessID2	int
AS
Begin
	select 	H.*
	from
	(
		select Distinct D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo
		from 
		(
			select	D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, D.RowNo, 
					D.GoodsQuantity - 
					isnull((
						select SUM(I.GoodsQuantity)
						from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl I
						where (I.ProcessID = @ProcessID2) 
							and (I.BaseProcessID = D.ProcessID) 
							and (I.BaseProcessNo = D.ProcessNo) 
							and (I.BaseFiscalYear = D.FiscalYear) 
							and (I.BaseSerialNo = D.SerialNo) 
							and (I.GoodsID = D.GoodsID) 
							and (I.BaseDocRowNo = D.DocRowNo) 
					),0) RemainQuantity
			from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D 
			where D.ProcessID = @ProcessID1
		) D
		where D.RemainQuantity > 0
	) T inner join inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H on H.ProcessID = T.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo = T.ProcessNo and H.FiscalYear = T.FiscalYear and H.SerialNo = T.SerialNo 
	order by ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo
End

SpBusinessList1
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 1391/01/16
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1392/04/05
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[SpBusinessList1]
	@ProcessID	int, -- 55 or 90
	@GoodsName	nvarchar(50), 
	@DocYear	int, -- 4 digit
	@DocSeason	int, -- 1 .. 4
	@TaxOnly	bit,
	@CRCOnly	bit,
	@DateStep   bit

AS
declare	@RetPID int
declare	@DateFr char(5)
declare	@DateTo char(5)
Begin
	if @ProcessID = 55 set @RetPID = 60
	if @ProcessID = 90 set @RetPID = 100

	if (@DocSeason = 1)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '01/01'
		set @DateTo = '03/31'
	end

	if (@DocSeason = 2)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '04/01'
		set @DateTo = '06/31'
	end

	if (@DocSeason = 3)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '07/01'
		set @DateTo = '09/31'
	end

	if (@DocSeason = 4)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '10/01'
		set @DateTo = '12/31'
	end

	select X.AcntCode, left(X.Address1,70) Address1, X.CityCode, X.CustomerFirstName, X.CustomerLastName, 
		REPLACE(X.EconomicalCode,' ','') EconomicalCode,
		X.GoodsID, X.IsReturn, X.LocationID, 
		LEFT(REPLACE(X.NationalIDNumber,'-',''), 10) NationalIDNumber, 
		X.OrganzationName, Case When CityCode = '0' Then '0' Else LEFT(CityCode, 2) End StateCode,
		X.PersonNameEx, X.PersonType, X.Tel, X.ZipCode, left(X.NationalIdentity, 11) NationalIdentity,
		X.SaleCustomerType, X.BuyCustomerType,
	    '' EmptyString, 0 GoodsIDEx,
		cast(2 as int) CustomerType, cast(0 as int) Zone, case when (@GoodsName <> '') then @GoodsName else G.GoodsName end GoodsName, 
		ROUND(Sum(X.SumPrice-X.VATTax-X.VATTol),0) SumPrice, ROUND(Sum(X.VATTax),0) VATTax, ROUND(Sum(X.VATTol),0) VATTol
		
	from
	(
		select H.AcntCode,F.SaleCustomerType,F.BuyCustomerType, D.IsReturn, F.EconomicalCode, F.NationalIDNumber, F.ZipCode, F.Tel, F.LocationID, F.Address1, 
			F.CustomerFirstName, F.CustomerLastName, F.OrganzationName, 
			Case When L.LocationIDEx = '' Then '0' Else IsNull(L.LocationIDEx, 0) End CityCode,
			Case When F.NationalIdentity <> '' then F.NationalIdentity else F.NationalIDNumber end NationalIdentity, 
			(H.SidePriceSum + D.SumPrice) SumPrice, H.TaxOverWorthCost VATTax, H.TollOverWorthCost VATTol,
			Case When F.EconomicalCode <> '' and F.EconomicalCode <> '0' then cast(2 as int) else cast(1 as int) end PersonType,
			Case When F.EconomicalCode <> '' and F.EconomicalCode <> '0' then OrganzationName else CustomerLastName end PersonNameEx,
			Case When (@GoodsName <> '') then '0' else 
				(
					select top 1 GoodsID 
					from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
					where (ProcessID = @ProcessID or ProcessID = @RetPID) 
						and AcntCode = H.AcntCode
				) end GoodsID
		from
		(
			select	D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, 
					cast(case when (D.ProcessID=@RetPID) then 1 else 0 end as bit) IsReturn,
					SUM(D.GoodsQuantity*D.GoodsPrice+AtomAmount) SumPrice
			from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D 
			Inner Join inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H2 ON H2.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H2.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo and H2.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear and 
												   H2.SerialNo=D.SerialNo			
			where (D.ProcessID = @ProcessID or D.ProcessID = @RetPID)

					and (Left(Case When @DateStep = 0 Then D.DocDate Else
					Case When H2.VchDate <> '' Then H2.VchDate Else  D.DocDate End End, 4) = @DocYear) 

					and (RIGHT(Case When @DateStep = 0 Then D.DocDate Else
					Case When H2.VchDate <> '' Then H2.VchDate Else  D.DocDate End End, 5) >= @DateFr) 

					and (RIGHT(Case When @DateStep = 0 Then D.DocDate Else
					Case When H2.VchDate <> '' Then H2.VchDate Else  D.DocDate End End, 5) <= @DateTo)

					and ((@CRCOnly=0) Or (@CRCOnly=1 and D.GoodsAmount>0)) 
			group by D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, case when (D.ProcessID=@RetPID) then 1 else 0 end
		) D	
			inner join inv.vwStorageDocsHdr H on H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo and H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear and H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
			OUTER APPLY acc.funGetCodeInfo(H.AcntCode) AS F
			left  join pub.tblLocations L on L.LocationID = F.LocationID
		where	(@ProcessID<>90 or 
				(@ProcessID =90 
				and ((F.NationalIdentity is not null) 
				and (F.NationalIdentity <> '') 
				and (F.NationalIdentity <> '0'))
				or ((F.NationalIDNumber is not null) 
				and (F.NationalIDNumber <> '')
				and (F.NationalIDNumber <> '0'))
				))
				and (H.AcntCode <> '')
	) X 
		left join inv.tblGoodsDtl G on G.GoodsID = X.GoodsID
	where ((@TaxOnly=0) Or (@TaxOnly=1 and X.VATTax+X.VATTol>0)) 
	group by X.AcntCode, X.Address1, X.CityCode, X.CustomerFirstName, X.CustomerLastName, X.EconomicalCode,

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================

CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[SpBusinessList2]
	@ProcessID	int, -- 55 or 90
	@GoodsName	nvarchar(50), 
	@DocYear	int, -- 4 digit
	@DocSeason	int, -- 1 .. 4
	@TaxOnly	bit,
	@CRCOnly	bit,
	@DateStep   bit

AS
declare	@RetPID int
declare	@DateFr char(5)
declare	@DateTo char(5)
Begin
	if @ProcessID = 55 set @RetPID = 60
	if @ProcessID = 90 set @RetPID = 100

	if (@DocSeason = 1)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '01/01'
		set @DateTo = '03/31'
	end

	if (@DocSeason = 2)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '04/01'
		set @DateTo = '06/31'
	end

	if (@DocSeason = 3)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '07/01'
		set @DateTo = '09/31'
	end

	if (@DocSeason = 4)
	begin
		set @DateFr = '10/01'
		set @DateTo = '12/31'
	end

	select X.AcntCode, left(X.Address1,70) Address1, X.CityCode, X.CustomerFirstName, X.CustomerLastName, 
		REPLACE(X.EconomicalCode,' ','') EconomicalCode,
		X.GoodsID, X.IsReturn, X.LocationID, 
		REPLACE(X.NationalIDNumber,'-','') NationalIDNumber, 
		X.OrganzationName, Case When CityCode = '0' Then '0' Else LEFT(CityCode, 2) End StateCode,
		case when X.NationalIdentity <> '' then X.NationalIdentity else X.NationalIDNumber end NationalIdentity, 
		'' EmptyString, 0 GoodsIDEx, X.PersonNameEx, X.PersonType, X.Tel, X.ZipCode, cast(2 as int) CustomerType, 
		cast(0 as int) Zone, case when (@GoodsName <> '') then @GoodsName else G.GoodsName end GoodsName, 
		ROUND(Sum(X.SumPrice-X.VATTax-X.VATTol),0) SumPrice, ROUND(Sum(X.VATTax),0) VATTax, ROUND(Sum(X.VATTol),0) VATTol,
		(ltrim(str(@DocYear)) + '/' + LTRIM(@DateTo)) DocDate
	from
	(
			select H.AcntCode, D.IsReturn, F.EconomicalCode, F.NationalIDNumber, F.ZipCode, F.Tel, F.LocationID, F.Address1, 
				F.CustomerFirstName, F.CustomerLastName, F.OrganzationName, 
			    Case When L.LocationIDEx = '' Then '0' Else IsNull(L.LocationIDEx, 0) End CityCode,
				LEFT(F.NationalIdentity, 11) NationalIdentity, (H.SidePriceSum + D.SumPrice) SumPrice, H.TaxOverWorthCost VATTax, H.TollOverWorthCost VATTol,
				case when F.EconomicalCode <> '' and F.EconomicalCode <> '0' then cast(2 as int) else cast(1 as int) end PersonType,
				case when F.EconomicalCode <> '' and F.EconomicalCode <> '0' then F.OrganzationName else case when F.CustomerFirstName='' and F.CustomerLastName='' then pub.GetCodeName(AcntCode, 1) else F.CustomerFirstName + ' ' + F.CustomerLastName end end PersonNameEx,
				case when (@GoodsName <> '') then '0' else 
					(
						select top 1 GoodsID 
						from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
						where (ProcessID = @ProcessID or ProcessID = @RetPID) 
							and AcntCode = H.AcntCode
					) end GoodsID
			from
			(
				select	D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, 
						cast(case when (D.ProcessID=@RetPID) then 1 else 0 end as bit) IsReturn,
						SUM(D.GoodsQuantity*D.GoodsPrice+AtomAmount) SumPrice
				from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D 
				Inner Join inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H2 ON H2.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H2.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo and H2.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear and 
												   H2.SerialNo=D.SerialNo				
				where (D.ProcessID = @ProcessID or D.ProcessID = @RetPID)

						and (Left(Case When @DateStep = 0 Then D.DocDate Else
						Case When H2.VchDate <> '' Then H2.VchDate Else  D.DocDate End End, 4) = @DocYear) 

						and (RIGHT(Case When @DateStep = 0 Then D.DocDate Else
						Case When H2.VchDate <> '' Then H2.VchDate Else  D.DocDate End End, 5) >= @DateFr) 

						and (RIGHT(Case When @DateStep = 0 Then D.DocDate Else
						Case When H2.VchDate <> '' Then H2.VchDate Else  D.DocDate End End, 5) <= @DateTo)

						and ((@CRCOnly=0) Or (@CRCOnly=1 and D.GoodsAmount>0)) 
				group by D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, case when (D.ProcessID=@RetPID) then 1 else 0 end
			) D	
				inner join inv.vwStorageDocsHdr H on H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo and H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear and H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
				OUTER APPLY acc.funGetCodeInfo(H.AcntCode) AS F
				left  join pub.tblLocations L on L.LocationID = F.LocationID
			where	(F.NationalIdentity is null or F.NationalIdentity = '' or F.NationalIdentity = '0') 
				and (F.NationalIDNumber is null or F.NationalIDNumber = '' or F.NationalIDNumber = '0')
				and ((@TaxOnly=0) Or (@TaxOnly=1 and TaxOverWorthCost+TollOverWorthCost>0)) 
				and (H.AcntCode <> '')
	) X 
		left join inv.tblGoodsDtl G on G.GoodsID = X.GoodsID
	where ((@TaxOnly = 0) Or (@TaxOnly=1 and X.VATTax+X.VATTol>0)) 
	group by X.AcntCode, X.Address1, X.CityCode, X.CustomerFirstName, X.CustomerLastName, X.EconomicalCode, 
		X.GoodsID, X.IsReturn, X.LocationID, X.NationalIDNumber, X.OrganzationName, X.PersonNameEx, 
		X.PersonType, X.Tel, X.ZipCode, G.GoodsName, X.NationalIdentity
		
End

CREATE PROCEDURE inv.Rpt_GoodsStatusInStore_SHV
	@GoodsID	  VarChar(20) = '', --42020801001007
	@FiscalYear	  Int 	      = 1401,
	@FrDate		  Char(10) 	  = '1401/01/01',
	@ToDate		  Char(10) 	  = '1401/12/29'
	--@ToDateRemain Char(10) 	  = '1500/12/30'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ================================
	SELECT GoodsID, GoodsName, DocDate, LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (DocDate), ''))) DocDate_Grg, 
		  --(CONVERT(Numeric(16,3), CAST(Last_Remain As Float)) - Produce_Qty - SaleRet_Qty + Sale_Qty) Before_Remain,
		   Produce_Qty, Sale_Qty, SaleRet_Qty, Use_Qty, UseRet_Qty, CartFr_Qty, CartTo_Qty, UnitName, PureWeight,
		   CONVERT(Numeric(16,3), CAST(First_Remain As Float))   First_Remain,
		   CONVERT(Numeric(16,3), CAST(Last_Remain As Float))    Last_Remain,
		   CONVERT(Numeric(16,3), CAST(Current_Remain As Float)) Current_Remain
	FROM
	(
		SELECT G.DocDate, G.GoodsID, G.GoodsName, G.PureWeight
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(S_Prd.GoodsQuantity)), 0)	  Produce_Qty
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(S_Sal.GoodsQuantity)), 0)     Sale_Qty
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(S_Ret.GoodsQuantity)), 0)     SaleRet_Qty 
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(Uses.GoodsQuantity)), 0)      Use_Qty 
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(Use_Ret.GoodsQuantity)), 0)   UseRet_Qty 
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(Cart_From.GoodsQuantity)), 0) CartFr_Qty 
			   --, IsNull(Floor(Sum(Cart_TO.GoodsQuantity)), 0)   CartTo_Qty
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(S_Prd.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0)     Produce_Qty
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(S_Sal.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0)     Sale_Qty
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(S_Ret.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0)     SaleRet_Qty 
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(Uses.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0)      Use_Qty 
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(Use_Ret.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0)   UseRet_Qty 
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(Cart_From.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0) CartFr_Qty 
			   , IsNull(Round(Sum(Cart_TO.GoodsQuantity), 2), 0)   CartTo_Qty
			   , [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, @FiscalYear, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + '/01/01', 0) First_Remain
			   , [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, @FiscalYear, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, @ToDate, 0) Last_Remain
			   , [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, @FiscalYear, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/12/30', 0) Current_Remain
			   , U.UnitName
		FROM
			(
				Select Distinct H.DocDate, H.GoodsID, D.GoodsName, G.UnitID, G.PureWeight
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl H
				Inner Join inv.tblGoods    G ON H.GoodsID = G.GoodsID
				Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl D ON H.GoodsID = D.GoodsID
				Where 1 = 1
					And SUBSTRING(H.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN('40', '41', '42', '43')
					And LEN(H.GoodsID) = 14
					And Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then G.GoodsID Else '' End  = Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then @GoodsID Else '' End
					And Case When @FrDate  <> '' Then H.DocDate Else '' End >= Case When @FrDate  <> '' Then @FrDate  Else '' End
					And Case When @ToDate  <> '' Then H.DocDate Else '' End <= Case When @ToDate  <> '' Then @ToDate  Else '' End
			) G -- ==== لیست کالاها
		Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl U ON G.UnitID = U.UnitID	                    -- ==== واحدهای کالاها
		Left  Join 																-- ==== تولید
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where ProcessID IN (72, 80) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) S_Prd ON S_Prd.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And S_Prd.DocDate = G.DocDate

		Left  Join 																-- ==== فروش
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where 1 = 1
					And ProcessID IN (90) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) S_Sal ON S_Sal.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And S_Sal.DocDate = G.DocDate

		Left  Join 																-- ==== برگشت از فروش 
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where 1 = 1
					And ProcessID IN (100) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) S_Ret ON S_Ret.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And S_Ret.DocDate = G.DocDate


		Left  Join 																-- ==== مصرف
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where 1 = 1
					And ProcessID IN (110) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) Uses ON Uses.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And Uses.DocDate = G.DocDate

		Left  Join 																-- ==== برگشت از مصرف
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where 1 = 1
					And ProcessID IN (115) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) Use_Ret ON Use_Ret.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And Use_Ret.DocDate = G.DocDate

		Left  Join 																-- ==== از کارت
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where 1 = 1
					And ProcessID IN (260) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) Cart_From ON Cart_From.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And Cart_From.DocDate = G.DocDate

		Left  Join 																-- ==== به کارت
			(
				Select DocDate, GoodsID, SUM(GoodsQuantity) GoodsQuantity
				From inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
				Where 1 = 1
					And ProcessID IN (265) 
					And ProcessNo = 1 
					And FiscalYear = @FiscalYear
				Group By DocDate, GoodsID
			) Cart_TO ON Cart_TO.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And Cart_TO.DocDate = G.DocDate

		WHERE Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then G.GoodsID Else '' End = Case When @GoodsID <> '' Then @GoodsID Else '' End
		Group By G.DocDate, G.GoodsID, G.GoodsName, U.UnitName, G.PureWeight
	) A
	--WHERE Produce_Qty > 0 OR Sale_Qty > 0 OR SaleRet_Qty > 0
	ORDER BY GoodsID, DocDate

END

		a.LastUpdate,

(H.Discount+H.Discount2)*((a.GoodsQuantity*a.GoodsAmount) - a.Discount+a.Discount2)/ CASE WHEN Price = 0 then cast(1 as float) else cast(Price as float) end) as totalGoodsPrice

outer apply  [acc].[funGetCodeInfo](a.AcntCode) f
--where   CONVERT(VARCHAR,a.LastUpdate,20)>=@DocDateFrom

left join inv.tblGoodsUserPrice d
on    a.UserPriceID=d.ID

--OFFSET 0 Rows

end

		((a.GoodsPrice*a.GoodsQuantity)-DiscountDtl) -(b.Discount+b.Discount2+b.Discount3+AfterSaleDiscount)*((a.GoodsQuantity*a.GoodsPrice) - a.DiscountDtl)/ CASE WHEN b.Price = 0 then cast(1 as float) else cast(b.Price as float) end  as  totalGoodsPrice,
		(a.GoodsAmount*a.GoodsQuantity) as PurAmount
					
from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl a
inner join inv.tblStorageDocsHdr b
on a.ProcessID=b.ProcessID and a.ProcessNo=b.ProcessNo and a.FiscalYear=b.FiscalYear and a.SerialNo=b.SerialNo
outer apply  [acc].[funGetCodeInfo](a.AcntCode) f
where (a.ProcessID =90 or a.ProcessID= 100 ) 
--and CONVERT(VARCHAR,a.LastUpdate,20)>=@DocDateFrom
  )c
left join inv.tblGoodsUserPrice d
on    c.UserPriceID=d.ID

--ORDER BY  LastUpdate
--OFFSET 0 Rows 
--FETCH NEXT @MaxResultCount  Rows ONLY 

end

storedProcedures.name: Rpt_Store_Cart_To_Cart
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC inv.Rpt_Store_Cart_To_Cart
     @FiscalYear      Int         = 1403,
     @SerialNoFr      Int         = 691,
     @SerialNoTo      Int         = 691,
     @DocDateFr       Char(10)    = '1402/03/01',
     @DocDateTo       Char(10)    = '1402/03/31',
     @GoodsID_Contain VarChar(20) = '',
     @GoodsID_Fr      VarChar(20) = '',
     @GoodsID_To      VarChar(20) = ''
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect_1  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere    NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1  = ''
	SET @StrSelect_2  = ''
	SET @StrWhere     = '1 = 1'
	
	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.ProcessID IN(260)
		  And D1.ProcessNo IN(1)'

	IF @FiscalYear <> 0 And @FiscalYear Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear)))

	IF @SerialNoFr <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.SerialNo  >= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoFr)))

	IF @SerialNoTo <> 0 And @SerialNoTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.SerialNo  <= ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@SerialNoTo)))

	IF @DocDateFr <> '' And @DocDateFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.DocDate   >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateFr)) + ''''

	IF @DocDateTo <> '' And @DocDateTo Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.DocDate   <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@DocDateTo)) + ''''

	IF @GoodsID_Contain <> '' And @GoodsID_Contain Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + '  
		  And (D1.GoodsID Like ''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID_Contain)) + '%'' OR D2.GoodsID Like ''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID_Contain)) + '%'')'

	IF @GoodsID_Fr <> '' And @GoodsID_Fr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D1.GoodsID   >= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID_Fr)) + ''''

	IF @GoodsID_To <> '' And @GoodsID_To Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' 
		  And D2.GoodsID   <= ''' + LTrim(RTrim(@GoodsID_To)) + ''''

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = '
		-- =================================================================================== SELECT
		SELECT *, To_Goods_Amnt - Fr_Goods_Amnt Amount_Diff, (To_Goods_Amnt - Fr_Goods_Amnt) * Quantity Row_Amount_Diff
		FROM
        (
          SELECT LTrim(RTrim(Str(D1.FiscalYear))) + ''/'' +  LTrim(RTrim(Str(D1.SerialNo))) Fiscal_Serial, D1.DocDate, D1.StoreID From_Store, pub.GetStoreName(D1.StoreID, 1) From_Store_Name, D1.StoreID2 To_Store,
                 pub.GetStoreName(D1.StoreID2, 1) To_Store_Name, D1.GoodsID From_Goods, pub.GetGoodsName(D1.GoodsID, 1) From_GoodsName, 
                 Cast(D1.SubUnitQuantity As Decimal(28, 2)) Quantity, D2.GoodsID To_Goods, pub.GetGoodsName(D2.GoodsID, 1) To_GoodsName,
                 Cast(inv.funGetLastEndAmount(D1.GoodsID, Null, ''1500/12/29'') As Decimal(28, 2)) Fr_Goods_Amnt,
                 Cast(inv.funGetLastEndAmount(D2.GoodsID, Null, ''1500/12/29'') As Decimal(28, 2)) To_Goods_Amnt
          FROM       inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D1
          INNER JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D2 ON D2.ProcessID = 265 And D1.ProcessNo = D2.ProcessNo And D1.FiscalYear = D2.FiscalYear And
                                                 D1.SerialNo = D2.SerialNo
          WHERE ' + @StrWhere + '
        ) A
        ORDER BY DocDate, Fiscal_Serial, From_Goods
		'
	-- ============================== EXEC
	PRINT @StrSelect_1
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

END

CREATE PROCEDURE inv.tblSetNumurationStore 
@FiscalYear as INT=0,
@SerialNo as INT=0,
@RowNo as INT =0,
@DocDate as char(10)='',
@BatchNo as varchar(20)='',
@GoodsID as varchar(20)='',
@StoreID as varchar(20)='',
@GoodsQuantity as Float=0,
@PSerialNo as varchar(30)=''
AS
BEGIN

	declare @SubUnitID varchar(20)
	declare @DescDtl Nvarchar(100)
	SET @DescDtl = N'PDA'

	IF @GoodsID  = ''
	BEGIN
		SELECT top 1 @GoodsID=GoodsID,@SubUnitID=SubUnitID,@GoodsQuantity =GoodsQuantity 
		from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
		WHERE     (BatchNo =@BatchNo) AND StoreID = @StoreID
		order by DocDate desc,VolumeRowNo desc

		IF @GoodsID = ''
			SELECT top 1 @GoodsID=GoodsID,@SubUnitID=SubUnitID,@GoodsQuantity =GoodsQuantity 
			from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
			WHERE     (BatchNo =@BatchNo)  --AND StoreID = '202'
			order by DocDate desc,VolumeRowNo desc

		IF @GoodsID = ''
		begin
			SELECT @GoodsID=RelatedGoodsID ,@GoodsQuantity = BatchCount 
			FROM inv.tblBatch 
			WHERE (BatchNo =@BatchNo)
			
			IF @GoodsID <> ''
				select @SubUnitID=UnitID from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID = @GoodsID
			
		END

		IF @GoodsID = ''
		BEGIN
			select @GoodsID = SettingValue from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey='DefaultLostGoodsID'
			IF @GoodsID <> ''
				select @SubUnitID=UnitID from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID = @GoodsID
			ELSE
				SET @SubUnitID = ''
		END	
		IF @GoodsQuantity = 0
			SET @GoodsQuantity	= 1
	END	
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (select COUNT(*) from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID = @GoodsID)=0
		BEGIN
			SET @DescDtl = @GoodsID + N' - PDA - کالای نا معتبر '
			select @GoodsID = SettingValue from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey='DefaultLostGoodsID'
			IF @GoodsID <> ''
				select @SubUnitID=UnitID from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID = @GoodsID
			ELSE
				SET @SubUnitID = ''
		END	


		select @SubUnitID=UnitID from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID = @GoodsID

	END
	
	insert into inv.tblStoresNumerationDtl
	(SerialNo, RowNo, DocDate, StoreID, GoodsID, DescDtl, DocRowNo, SubUnitID, GoodsQuantity, SubUnitQuantity, BatchNo, UserPriceID)
	select @SerialNo, @RowNo, @DocDate, @StoreID, @GoodsID, @DescDtl ,@RowNo DocRowNo, @SubUnitID, @GoodsQuantity,@GoodsQuantity SubUnitQuantity, @BatchNo,0 UserPriceID
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [inv].[spGetStoreTwoFiscalYerasDiff] 
  @storeID as nvarchar(10)='1'
, @CurrentYearDB   nvarchar(100) =  'TS_Donar_1_1395' 
, @NextYearDB as nvarchar(100) ='TS_Donar_1_1396'
, @LangID as int = 1
AS BEGIN

DECLARE @StrSelect AS NVARCHAR(MAX)


set @StrSelect= '
SELECT 
*  ,[pub].[funGetGoodsName](a.GoodsID ,'+ cast(@LangID as varchar(2)) +')GoodsName ,CurrentYearStock - NextYearAmont DIFF FROM 
(
SELECT   D.GoodsID, ISNULL(SUM( D.GoodsQuantity * D.EnterKind) ,0) CurrentYearStock 
,(SELECT ISNULL(SUM( GoodsQuantity * EnterKind) ,0) 
		   FROM '+@NextYearDB+'.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl a 
   WHERE ProcessID=50 AND ProcessNo=1 
   AND FiscalYear='+RIGHT(@NextYearDB,2)+'  AND StoreID='+@storeID+'  AND GoodsID=D.GoodsID  ) NextYearAmont
      FROM '+@CurrentYearDB+'.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
      WHERE  ( D.FiscalYear = '+right(@CurrentYearDB,2)+') AND LEFT( D.GoodsID,  12) 
      IN (Select GoodsID From '+@CurrentYearDB+'.inv.tblGoods WHERE IsService = 0)
      AND D.StoreID='+@storeID+'
		GROUP BY   GoodsID
)a	 WHERE CurrentYearStock <> NextYearAmont'


        Print @StrSelect;
		Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;	

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [inv].[UpdateComplexGoods] @LangID AS	INT = 1 
AS
BEGIN



DECLARE @UnitPart AS INT
SET @UnitPart=(SELECT TOP 1   SettingValue  FROM pub.tblSettings WHERE SettingKey='UnitPart') 

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.table_types WHERE [name] like '#ComplexGoods')
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		DROP TABLE #ComplexGoods
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	END CATCH 
 END


;WITH cmb AS 
(
SELECT /*distinct rn =DENSE_RANK()over (order by GoodsID ),*/a.GoodsID,GoodsName,a.PartNumber ,LanguageID 
,G.UnitID 
FROM inv.tblGoodsDtl a 
INNER JOIN inv.tblGoods G on G.GoodsID = a.GoodsID and a.LanguageID =@LangID
 WHERE a.PartNumber=1 AND LanguageID=@LangID AND LEN(a.GoodsID)=9 --and GoodsID in(501000350,101000120,101000148,101000220)
 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pub.tblCodingRelation b WHERE 
 b.Code=SUBSTRING(a.GoodsID,1,LEN(a.GoodsID ))AND LinkedPartNo=1  
 AND /*PartNo=2 AND*/ TableName='inv.tblGoods' )>0
)

SELECT-- cmb_no =ROW_NUMBER() over (order by newID()) 
     c1.GoodsID GoodsID1 , c2.GoodsID GoodsID2 , c3.GoodsID GoodsID3 , c4.GoodsID GoodsID4  , c5.GoodsID GoodsID5
     ,c1.GoodsName GoodsName1,c2.GoodsName GoodsName2,c3.GoodsName GoodsName3,c4.GoodsName  GoodsName4,c5.GoodsName GoodsName5
     ,c1.UnitID  INTO #ComplexGoods
   FROM cmb c1, inv.tblGoodsDtl  c2
              , inv.tblGoodsDtl  c3
              , inv.tblGoodsDtl  c4
              , inv.tblGoodsDtl  c5
              
 
WHERE   c2.PartNumber =2	
		AND c3.PartNumber=3
		AND c4.PartNumber=4
		AND c5.PartNumber=5
 
 AND c2.GoodsID in (SELECT AcntXCode  FROM pub.tblCodingRelation bb WHERE 
 bb.Code=SUBSTRING(bb.Code ,1,LEN(bb.Code ))AND LinkedPartNo=1  
 AND PartNo=2 AND TableName='inv.tblGoods' AND bb.Code = c1.GoodsID)
 
  AND c3.GoodsID in (SELECT AcntXCode  FROM pub.tblCodingRelation bb WHERE 
 bb.Code=SUBSTRING(bb.Code ,1,LEN(bb.Code ))AND LinkedPartNo=1  
 AND PartNo=3 AND TableName='inv.tblGoods' AND bb.Code = c1.GoodsID)
 
  AND c4.GoodsID in (SELECT AcntXCode  FROM pub.tblCodingRelation bb WHERE 
 bb.Code=SUBSTRING(bb.Code ,1,LEN(bb.Code ))AND LinkedPartNo=1  
 AND PartNo=4 AND TableName='inv.tblGoods' AND bb.Code = c1.GoodsID)

  AND c5.GoodsID IN (SELECT AcntXCode  FROM pub.tblCodingRelation bb WHERE 
 bb.Code=SUBSTRING(bb.Code ,1,LEN(bb.Code ))AND LinkedPartNo=1  
 AND PartNo=5 AND TableName='inv.tblGoods' AND bb.Code = c1.GoodsID)
 
ORDER BY c1.GoodsID ,c2.GoodsID ,c3.GoodsID ,c4.GoodsID  ,c5.GoodsID 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DELETE [inv].[tblComplexGoodsDtl]
DELETE [inv].[tblComplexGoods]

INSERT INTO [inv].[tblComplexGoods]
           ([GoodsID]
           ,[CodeClosed]
           ,[UnitID]
           ,[RecID]
           ,[SessionNo])
    SELECT GoodsID1+GoodsID2+GoodsID3+GoodsID4+GoodsID5 GoodsID
           ,0 [CodeClosed]
           ,[UnitID]
           ,'' [RecID]
           ,'' [SessionNo]
           FROM  #ComplexGoods
           ----------------------
           
           INSERT INTO  [inv].[tblComplexGoodsDtl]
           ([GoodsID]
           ,[LanguageID]
           ,[GoodsName])
    SELECT 
            GoodsID1+GoodsID2+GoodsID3+GoodsID4+GoodsID5 GoodsID
           ,@LangID LanguageID
           ,GoodsName1+' '+GoodsName2+' '+GoodsName3+' '+GoodsName4+' '+GoodsName5 GoodsName
           FROM  #ComplexGoods

	BEGIN TRY
		DROP TABLE #ComplexGoods
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	END CATCH 

End

storedProcedures.name: SpRemoveZeroedTrustListDtlFromNewYear
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\
-- Create date   : 1404/05/08
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Description	 : Inv Transfer Docs
-- ----------------------------------------------
-- حذف اسناد امانی انتقال‌یافته فاقد مانده
-- ==============================================
Create PROCEDURE [inv].[SpRemoveZeroedTrustListDtlFromNewYear] 
	@ProcessID1		INT,
	@ProcessID2		INT,
	@DBName			NVARCHAR(500),
	@DestFiscalYear SMALLINT

AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @StrSelect NVARCHAR(MAX)

	IF @ProcessID1 = 130
	BEGIN
		SET @StrSelect = '
		SELECT T.*,
			   CASE WHEN S.SubUnitID IS NULL THEN RemainQuantity ELSE RemainQuantity * UnitValue / MainUnitValue END SubRemainQuantity
		INTO #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain
		FROM (SELECT D.ProcessID, 
					 D.ProcessNo, 
					 D.FiscalYear, 
					 D.SerialNo, 
					 D.RowNo,
					 GoodsID, 
					 SubUnitID,
					 D.GoodsQuantity - ISNULL(( SELECT SUM(I.GoodsQuantity)
					 						   FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl I
					 						   WHERE (I.ProcessID = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ProcessID2))) + ') 
					 						     AND (I.BaseProcessID = D.ProcessID) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseProcessNo = D.ProcessNo) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseFiscalYear = D.FiscalYear) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseSerialNo = D.SerialNo) 
					 						     AND (I.GoodsID = D.GoodsID) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseDocRowNo = D.DocRowNo)),0) RemainQuantity
			  FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
			  WHERE D.ProcessID = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ProcessID1))) + ') T
			  LEFT JOIN inv.tblSubUnitsDtl S ON T.GoodsID=S.GoodsID 
											AND T.SubUnitID=S.SubUnitID
		SELECT D.*
		INTO #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
		FROM #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain R 
		INNER JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D ON D.ProcessID = R.ProcessID 
										  AND D.ProcessNo = R.ProcessNo 
										  AND D.FiscalYear = R.FiscalYear 
										  AND D.SerialNo = R.SerialNo 
										  AND D.RowNo = R.RowNo
		WHERE (R.RemainQuantity > 0)

		UPDATE #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
		SET #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.GoodsQuantity = R.RemainQuantity, 
			#tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.SubUnitQuantity = R.SubRemainQuantity,
			#tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.EnterKind = 0
		FROM #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result D 
		INNER JOIN #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain R ON D.ProcessID = R.ProcessID 
													   AND D.ProcessNo = R.ProcessNo 
													   AND D.FiscalYear = R.FiscalYear 
													   AND D.SerialNo = R.SerialNo 
													   AND D.RowNo = R.RowNo

		DELETE FROM D
		FROM ' + LTrim(RTrim(@DBName)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
		INNER JOIN (
		SELECT ProcessID,
			   ProcessNo,
			   FiscalYear,
			   SerialNo,
			   DocRowNo,
			   GoodsID 
		FROM ' + LTrim(RTrim(@DBName)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
		WHERE ProcessID = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ProcessID1))) + ' 
		  AND FiscalYear < ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@DestFiscalYear))) + '
		EXCEPT 
		SELECT ProcessID,
			   ProcessNo,
			   FiscalYear,
			   SerialNo,
			   DocRowNo,
			   GoodsID 
		FROM #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result ) T ON D.ProcessID = T.ProcessID
												   AND D.ProcessNo = T.ProcessNo
												   AND D.FiscalYear = T.FiscalYear
												   AND D.SerialNo = T.SerialNo
												   AND D.DocRowNo = T.DocRowNo
												   AND D.GoodsID = T.GoodsID'
	END
	ELSE IF @ProcessID1 = 131
	BEGIN
		SET @StrSelect = '
		SELECT T.*,
			   CASE WHEN S.SubUnitID IS NULL THEN RemainQuantity ELSE RemainQuantity * UnitValue / MainUnitValue END SubRemainQuantity
		INTO #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain
		FROM (SELECT D.ProcessID, 
					 D.ProcessNo, 
					 D.FiscalYear, 
					 D.SerialNo, 
					 D.RowNo,
					 GoodsID, 
					 SubUnitID,
					 D.GoodsQuantity - ISNULL(( SELECT SUM(I.GoodsQuantity)
					 						   FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl I
					 						   WHERE (I.ProcessID = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ProcessID2))) + ') 
					 						     AND (I.BaseProcessID = D.ProcessID) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseProcessNo = D.ProcessNo) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseFiscalYear = D.FiscalYear) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseSerialNo = D.SerialNo) 
					 						     AND (I.GoodsID = D.GoodsID) 
					 						     AND (I.BaseDocRowNo = D.DocRowNo)),0) RemainQuantity
			  FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
			  WHERE D.ProcessID = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ProcessID1))) + ') T
			  LEFT JOIN inv.tblSubUnitsDtl S ON T.GoodsID=S.GoodsID 
											AND T.SubUnitID=S.SubUnitID
		SELECT D.*
		INTO #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
		FROM #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain R 
		INNER JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D ON D.ProcessID = R.ProcessID 
										  AND D.ProcessNo = R.ProcessNo 
										  AND D.FiscalYear = R.FiscalYear 
										  AND D.SerialNo = R.SerialNo 
										  AND D.RowNo = R.RowNo
		WHERE (R.RemainQuantity > 0)

		UPDATE #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result
		SET #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.GoodsQuantity = R.RemainQuantity, 
			#tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.SubUnitQuantity = R.SubRemainQuantity,
			#tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result.EnterKind = 0
		FROM #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result D 
		INNER JOIN #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Remain R ON D.ProcessID = R.ProcessID 
													   AND D.ProcessNo = R.ProcessNo 
													   AND D.FiscalYear = R.FiscalYear 
													   AND D.SerialNo = R.SerialNo 
													   AND D.RowNo = R.RowNo

		DELETE FROM D
		FROM ' + LTrim(RTrim(@DBName)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D
		INNER JOIN (
		SELECT ProcessID,
			   ProcessNo,
			   FiscalYear,
			   SerialNo,
			   DocRowNo,
			   GoodsID 
		FROM ' + LTrim(RTrim(@DBName)) + '.inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
		WHERE ProcessID = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ProcessID1))) + ' 
		  AND FiscalYear < ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@DestFiscalYear))) + '
		EXCEPT 
		SELECT ProcessID,
			   ProcessNo,
			   FiscalYear,
			   SerialNo,
			   DocRowNo,
			   GoodsID 
		FROM #tbl_vwTransferTrustListDtl_Result ) T ON D.ProcessID = T.ProcessID
												   AND D.ProcessNo = T.ProcessNo
												   AND D.FiscalYear = T.FiscalYear
												   AND D.SerialNo = T.SerialNo
												   AND D.DocRowNo = T.DocRowNo
												   AND D.GoodsID = T.GoodsID'
	END 
	PRINT @StrSelect
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect 
End

As
	select	D.ProductSerialID, F.FinalRowNo, D.SerialStatusID as FinalSerialStatusID,
			S.SerialStatusName as FinalSerialStatusName
	from	pln.tblProductSerialStatus D

-- =============================================
CREATE View [pln].[vwTaskOrderDtl]
As
	SELECT	D.*, H.ProductID, H.OrderCount, H.TaskStateID, S.ProduceStepName, 
			S.DepartmentID, S.CostAcntCode, S.CostPerProduct, DP.DepartmentName, 
			IsNull(F.FaultTime, 0) FaultTime, IsNull(I.IdleTime, 0) IdleTime, H.DocDate,S.ProduceStepTime PrdStepTime
			,H.ProductWidth , H.ProductHeight , H.ProductQuantity2 
	FROM	pln.tblTaskOrderHdr H
				INNER JOIN pln.tblTaskOrderDtl D ON H.ProcessID = D.ProcessID AND H.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo 
				INNER JOIN pln.tblProduceStepDtl S ON S.ProductID = H.ProductID AND S.SerialNo = D.ProduceStepSerialNo and S.ProduceStepID = D.ProduceStepID
				LEFT  JOIN prs.tblDepartmentsDtl DP ON DP.DepartmentID = S.DepartmentID AND DP.LanguageID = 1
				LEFT  JOIN 
				(
					SELECT ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, IsNull(Sum(FaultTime), 0) AS FaultTime
					FROM pln.tblFaultItems F 
					GROUP BY ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo
				) F ON F.ProcessID = D.ProcessID AND F.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo AND F.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear AND F.SerialNo = D.SerialNo AND F.DocRowNo = D.DocRowNo
				LEFT  JOIN 
				(
					SELECT ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo, IsNull(Sum(I.IdleTimeValue), 0) AS IdleTime
					FROM pln.tblTaskOrderIdleTimes TI
							INNER JOIN pub.tblIdleTimes I ON I.IdleTimeID = TI.IdleTimeID
					GROUP BY ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo
				) I ON I.ProcessID = D.ProcessID AND I.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo AND I.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear AND I.SerialNo = D.SerialNo AND I.RowNo = D.RowNo

CREATE View [pln].[vwTaskOrderHdr]
As
	SELECT	H.*, GP.GoodsID AS ProductName, GS.GoodsName,
			prs.funGetPersonnelName(Confirmer1ID,1) Confirmer1Name,
			prs.funGetPersonnelName(Confirmer2ID,1) Confirmer2Name,
			prs.funGetPersonnelName(Confirmer3ID,1) Confirmer3Name,
			prs.funGetPersonnelName(Approver1ID, 1) Approver1Name,

				INNER JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl GP 
					ON GP.GoodsID = H.ProductID AND GP.LanguageID = 1
				LEFT  JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl GS 
					ON GS.GoodsID = H.GoodsID   AND GS.LanguageID = 1
				LEFT  JOIN pln.tblProduceOrderDtl PO 
					ON H.BaseProcessID = PO.ProcessID AND H.BaseProcessNo = PO.ProcessNo and H.BaseFiscalYear = PO.FiscalYear and H.BaseSerialNo = PO.SerialNo and H.ProdDocRowNo = PO.DocRowNo

storedProcedures.name: SP_Insert_Task_Order_Operators
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC pln.SP_Insert_Task_Order_Operators
	@SerialNoFr    Int           = 0,
	@SerialNoTo    Int           = 0,
	@RowNoFr       Int           = 0,
	@RowNoTo       Int           = 0,
	@PersonnelID   VarChar(20)   = '',
	@PersonnelName NVarChar(Max) = '',
	@OP_TYPE       Int           = 0
	
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 0 = Select
	-- ===== OP_TYPE 1 = Copy
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrSelect_1 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrSelect_2 NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_1  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_2  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_3  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_4  NVarchar(Max);
	DECLARE @StrWhere_5  NVarchar(Max);

	-- ===================================================================================
	DECLARE @FiscalYear Int 

    Select @FiscalYear = FiscalYear From TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_0000.pub.tblFiscalYears Where IsDefault = 'True'

	-- ===================================================================================
	SET @StrSelect_1 = ''
	SET @StrSelect_2 = ''

	SET @StrWhere_1 = '1 = 1
               And ProcessID     = 610
               And ProcessNo     = 1
               And FiscalYear    = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear)))

	SET @StrWhere_2 = '1 = 1
                 And ProcessID  = 610
                 And ProcessNo  = 1
                 And FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + 
                 Case When @SerialNoFr = @SerialNoTo OR @SerialNoTo = 0 Then '
			     And RowNo     <> ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoFr)) 
                 Else '' End
	
	SET @StrWhere_3 = '1 = 1
                      And ProcessID  = 610
                      And ProcessNo  = 1
                      And FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FiscalYear))) + 
                      Case When @SerialNoFr = @SerialNoTo OR @SerialNoTo = 0 Then '
			          And RowNo     <> ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoFr)) 
                      Else '' End + '
					  And RowNo      = @RowNo'

	SET @StrWhere_4 = '1 = 1'
	SET @StrWhere_5 = ''

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== WHERE
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @SerialNoFr <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
               And SerialNo      = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoFr))

	IF @RowNoFr <> 0 And @RowNoFr Is Not Null
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
               And RowNo     = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoFr))

	IF @SerialNoTo <> 0 And @SerialNoTo Is Not Null
	Begin
		SET @StrWhere_2 = @StrWhere_2 + '  
                 And SerialNo   = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoTo))
		SET @StrWhere_3 = @StrWhere_3 + '  
                      And SerialNo   = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoTo))
	End
    ELSE
	Begin
		SET @StrWhere_2 = @StrWhere_2 + '  
                 And SerialNo   = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoFr))
		SET @StrWhere_3 = @StrWhere_3 + '  
                      And SerialNo   = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoFr))
	End

	IF @RowNoTo <> 0 And @RowNoTo Is Not Null
	Begin
		SET @StrWhere_2 = @StrWhere_2 + '  
                 And RowNo      = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoTo))
		--SET @StrWhere_3 = @StrWhere_3 + '  
  --                    And RowNo      = ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoTo))
	End

	IF @PersonnelID <> '' And @PersonnelID Is Not Null
	Begin
		SET @StrWhere_1 = @StrWhere_1 + '  
               And OperatorID    Like ''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@PersonnelID)) + '%'''
		SET @StrWhere_3 = @StrWhere_3 + '  
                      And OperatorID   Like ''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@PersonnelID)) + '%'''
	End

	IF @PersonnelName <> '' And @PersonnelName Is Not Null
	Begin
		SET @StrWhere_5 = @StrWhere_5 + '  
               And PersonnelName Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@PersonnelName)) + '%'''
		SET @StrWhere_4 = @StrWhere_4 + '  
              And PersonnelName Like N''%' + LTrim(RTrim(@PersonnelName)) + '%'''
	End

	-- ===================================================================================
	-- =================================================================================== Select
	-- ===================================================================================
	IF @SerialNoFr <> 0 And @SerialNoFr Is Not Null
	BEGIN
		IF @OP_TYPE = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @StrSelect_1 = '
			-- ====================================== SELECT
			SELECT *
			FROM
			(
             Select ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo, OperatorID, PD.FirstName + '' '' + PD.LastName PersonnelName
             From  pln.tblTaskOrderOperators TP
			 Inner Join prs.tblPersonnelsDtl PD ON PD.PersonnelID = TP.OperatorID
			) A
            Where ' + @StrWhere_1 + @StrWhere_5

		END
		ELSE IF @OP_TYPE = 1 
		BEGIN
			SET @StrSelect_1 = '
			-- ====================================== Create Temp Table
			IF object_id (''dbo.tbl_Temp'') Is Not Null DROP TABLE dbo.tbl_Temp

			Create Table dbo.tbl_Temp
			(
				ProcessID    SmallInt      Not Null,
				ProcessNo    TinyInt       Not Null,
				FiscalYear   SmallInt      Not Null,
				SerialNo     Int           Not Null,
				RowNo        Int           Not Null,
				OperatorID   VarChar(20)   Not Null,
				OperatorName NVarChar(Max) Not Null
			)

			-- ====================================== Select Source Data
			INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_Temp
			SELECT ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear,
                   Case When ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoTo)) + ' <> 0 Then ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoTo)) + ' Else SerialNo End SerialNo, 
                   Case When ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoTo)) + ' <> 0 Then ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoTo)) + ' Else RowNo End RowNo, 
                   OperatorID, PersonnelName
			FROM
			(
			 Select ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo, OperatorID, PD.FirstName + '' '' + PD.LastName PersonnelName
			 From  pln.tblTaskOrderOperators TP
			 Inner Join prs.tblPersonnelsDtl PD ON PD.PersonnelID = TP.OperatorID
			 Where ' + @StrWhere_1 + '
			 ) A
			Where ' + @StrWhere_4 + '

			--Select * From dbo.tbl_Temp

			-- ====================================== Init Cursor_01
			Declare @ProcessID  Smallint  
			Declare @ProcessNo  Tinyint  
			Declare @FiscalYear Smallint  
			Declare @SerialNo   Int
			Declare @RowNo      Int
			Declare @OperatorID Varchar(20)  

			-- ======================================== START Cursor_01
			DECLARE Cursor_01 CURSOR FOR   

			-- ====================================== SELECT
			   SELECT ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, 
                      Case When ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoTo)) + ' <> 0 Then ' + LTrim(RTrim(@SerialNoTo)) + ' Else SerialNo End SerialNo, 
                      Case When ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoTo)) + ' <> 0 Then ' + LTrim(RTrim(@RowNoTo)) + ' Else RowNo End RowNo
			   FROM  pln.tblTaskOrderDtl
			   WHERE ' + @StrWhere_2 + '	   

			OPEN Cursor_01'
		  
			SET @StrSelect_2 = '
			FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_01 INTO @ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @RowNo
		  
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
			BEGIN
                --SELECT @ProcessID ProcessID, @ProcessNo ProcessNo, @FiscalYear FiscalYear, @SerialNo SerialNo, @RowNo RowNo

				-- ========================================= DELETE
				DELETE 
				FROM  pln.tblTaskOrderOperators
				WHERE ' + @StrWhere_3 + '

				-- ========================================
				-- ======================================== Init Cursor_02
				-- ========================================
				Declare @ProcessID_2  Smallint  
				Declare @ProcessNo_2  Tinyint  
				Declare @FiscalYear_2 Smallint  
				Declare @SerialNo_2   Int
				Declare @RowNo_2      Int
				Declare @OperatorID_2 Varchar(20)  
				Declare @Max_ID       BigInt

				-- ======================================== START Cursor_02
				DECLARE Cursor_02 CURSOR FOR   

				-- ======================================== SELECT
				   SELECT ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @RowNo, OperatorID  
				   FROM dbo.tbl_Temp

				OPEN Cursor_02  
		  
				FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_02 INTO @ProcessID_2, @ProcessNo_2, @FiscalYear_2, @SerialNo_2, @RowNo_2, @OperatorID
		  
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
				BEGIN  
					-- ========================================= Get Max_ID
					Select @Max_ID = Max(TaskOrderOperatorID) + 1 From pln.tblTaskOrderOperators
		
					-- ========================================= INSERT
                    --SELECT @Max_ID TaskOrderOperatorID, @ProcessID ProcessID, @ProcessNo ProcessNo, 
                    --       @FiscalYear FiscalYear, @SerialNo_2 SerialNo, @RowNo_2 RowNo, @OperatorID OperatorID

					-- =====
					INSERT INTO pln.tblTaskOrderOperators(TaskOrderOperatorID, ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo, OperatorID)
					Values(@Max_ID, @ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo_2, @RowNo_2, @OperatorID)
					
					FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_02 INTO @ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @RowNo, @OperatorID
				END   
		  
				CLOSE Cursor_02  
				DEALLOCATE Cursor_02
				-- ========================================
				-- ======================================== END Cursor_02
				-- ========================================
		  
				FETCH NEXT FROM Cursor_01 INTO @ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @RowNo
			-- ======================================== END Cursor_01
			END   
		  
			CLOSE Cursor_01  
			DEALLOCATE Cursor_01
			'
		END


		-- ============================== EXEC
		PRINT @StrSelect_1
		PRINT @StrSelect_2
		SET   @StrSelect_1 = @StrSelect_1 + @StrSelect_2

		-- ============================== EXEC
		EXEC  sp_executesql @StrSelect_1

	END
	ELSE
	    Select 'شماره برگه مبدا و شماره ردیف مبدا را انتخاب کنید.'

END
