-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC pln.Rpt_Product_Task_Order_2
	@ProductID	  VarChar(20) = '',
	@GoodsID      Varchar(20) = Null,
	@FiscalYearFr Int         = Null,
	@SerialNoFr	  Int         = Null,
	@FiscalYearTo Int         = Null,
	@SerialNoTo   Int         = Null,
	@DocDateFr    Char(10)    = '',
	@DocDateTo    Char(10)    = '',
	@Test         Bit         = 0

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @RepOptions NVarChar(200) = '111'
    DECLARE @RepInfo    NVarChar(200) = '1@1@1'
	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Drop Temp Tables
	-- ==========================================================================
	Begin Try
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_1
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_3
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
	End Try
	Begin Catch
	End Catch

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_Prds_List 2
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
	(
	    TechnicalNo       NVarchar(50)  NULL,
		ProductID	      VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ProductName	      NVarChar(500) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		UnitID	          VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		UnitName	      NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Goods_Tool	      Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Arz	      Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Ertefa	  Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Vazn	      Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Vazn_Khales Decimal(28,9),
		Vazn_Khales		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Tedad_dar_Karton  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		G_Masraf_Konande  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Tool_Dar_Arz	  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Zekhamat		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ExtraField6		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ExtraField7		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ExtraField8		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		MapNo			  NVarChar(Max) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Remain			  Decimal(28,9),
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_Prds_List (TechnicalNo, ProductID, ProductName, UnitID, UnitName, Goods_Tool, Goods_Arz, Goods_Ertefa, Goods_Vazn, Goods_Vazn_Khales,
	                                    Vazn_Khales, Tedad_dar_Karton, G_Masraf_Konande, Tool_Dar_Arz, Zekhamat, ExtraField6, ExtraField7, ExtraField8, MapNo, Remain)
	Select 
       G.TechnicalNo, G.GoodsID ProductID, GD.GoodsName ProductName, G.UnitID, UD.UnitName,
	   G.GoodsLength Goods_Tool, G.GoodsWidth Goods_Arz, G.GoodsHeight Goods_Ertefa, G.GoodsWeight Goods_Vazn, G.PureWeight Goods_Vazn_Khales,
	   ExtraField1 Vazn_Khales, ExtraField2 Tedad_dar_Karton, ExtraField3 G_Masraf_Konande, ExtraField4 Tool_Dar_Arz, ExtraField5 Zekhamat, 
	   ExtraField6, ExtraField7, ExtraField8, MapNo, [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/01/01', 0) Remain

	From inv.tblGoods                          G
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl                GD ON G.GoodsID = GD.GoodsID
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl                UD ON G.UnitID  = UD.UnitID
	--Inner Join inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListDtl GG ON GG.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And GG.GoodsGroupID = '0404'
	Where 1 = 1
		And Case When @ProductID <> '' Then G.GoodsID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> '' Then @ProductID Else '' End)
		--And SubString(G.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
		--And Len(G.GoodsID) = 14
		--And G.GoodsID     IN ('32040601', '32040601', '32040601')
		And G.CodeClosed   = 0
	Order By G.GoodsID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_1
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_1
	(
		SerialNo        Int,
		ProductID	    VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodsID         VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		GoodstName	    NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Order_Date		Char(10),
		Order_SerialNo  Int,
		Task_Date	    Char(10),
		ProductLineID   VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ProductLineName NVarChar(500) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ShiftTypeName   NVarChar(500) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		AcceptableCount Decimal(28,9),
		R_Count         Int,
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_1 (SerialNo, ProductID, GoodsID, GoodstName, Order_Date, Order_SerialNo, Task_Date, ProductLineID, ProductLineName, ShiftTypeName, AcceptableCount, R_Count)
	Select TD.SerialNo, TH.ProductID, SD.GoodsID, GD.GoodsName, PH.DocDate Order_Date, PH.SerialNo, TH.DocDate Task_Date, TD.ProductionLineID, PL.ProductionLineName, ST.ShiftTypeName, 
	       Sum(TD.AcceptableCount) AcceptableCount, Count(ProductID) R_Count
	From pln.tblTaskOrderDtl             TD
	Inner Join pln.tblTaskOrderHdr       TH ON TH.ProcessID  = TD.ProcessID  And TH.ProcessNo = TD.ProcessNo And
										       TH.FiscalYear = TD.FiscalYear And TH.SerialNo  = TD.SerialNo
	Inner Join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl     SD ON TH.ProcessID  = SD.BaseProcessID  And TH.ProcessNo = SD.BaseProcessNo And
										       TH.FiscalYear = SD.BaseFiscalYear And TH.SerialNo  = SD.BaseSerialNo And 
											   TD.RowNo = SD.BaseDocRowNo
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl           GD ON GD.GoodsID = SD.GoodsID
    Inner Join pln.tblProduceOrderHdr    PH ON PH.ProcessID = TH.BaseProcessID And PH.ProcessNo = TH.BaseProcessNo And
										    PH.FiscalYear = TH.BaseFiscalYear And PH.SerialNo  = TH.BaseSerialNo
    Left  Join emp.tblShiftTypesDtl      ST ON ST.ShiftTypeID = TD.ShiftTypeID
    Left  Join pln.tblProductionLinesDtl PL ON PL.ProductionLineID = TD.ProductionLineID
	Where 1 = 1
		And TH.ProcessID IN(610)
        And Case When @ProductID    <> '' Then TH.ProductID  Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID    <> '' Then @ProductID    Else '' End)
        And Case When @GoodsID      <> '' Then SD.GoodsID    Else '' End IN (Case When @GoodsID      <> '' Then @GoodsID      Else '' End)
        And Case When @FiscalYearFr <> 0  Then TD.FiscalYear Else 0  End >=  Case When @FiscalYearFr <> 0  Then @FiscalYearFr Else 0  End
        And Case When @FiscalYearTo <> 0  Then TD.FiscalYear Else 0  End <=  Case When @FiscalYearTo <> 0  Then @FiscalYearTo Else 0  End
        And Case When @SerialNoFr   <> 0  Then TD.SerialNo   Else 0  End >=  Case When @SerialNoFr   <> 0  Then @SerialNoFr   Else 0  End
        And Case When @SerialNoTo   <> 0  Then TD.SerialNo   Else 0  End <=  Case When @SerialNoTo   <> 0  Then @SerialNoTo   Else 0  End
        --And Case When @DocDateFr    <> '' Then TH.DocDate    Else '' End >=  Case When @DocDateFr    <> '' Then @DocDateFr    Else '' End
        --And Case When @DocDateTo    <> '' Then TH.DocDate    Else '' End <=  Case When @DocDateTo    <> '' Then @DocDateTo    Else '' End	
		--And SubString(TH.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
	Group By TD.ProcessID, TD.ProcessNo, TD.FiscalYear, TD.SerialNo, PH.SerialNo, TH.ProductID, SD.GoodsID,
	         GD.GoodsName, PH.DocDate, TH.DocDate, TD.ProductionLineID, PL.ProductionLineName, ST.ShiftTypeName
	Order By PH.DocDate, TH.DocDate, TH.ProductID

	---- ===== Test Select
    --Select SerialNo, ProductID, GoodsID, GoodstName, Order_Date, Order_SerialNo, Task_Date, ProductLineID, ProductLineName, ShiftTypeName, AcceptableCount, R_Count        
    --From ##Temp_Table_1
    --Where 1 = 1
    --    And Case When @ProductID  <> '' Then ProductID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID  <> '' Then @ProductID  Else '' End)
    --    And Case When @GoodsID    <> '' Then GoodsID   Else '' End IN (Case When @GoodsID    <> '' Then @GoodsID    Else '' End)
    --    And Case When @SerialNoFr <> 0  Then SerialNo  Else 0  End >=  Case When @SerialNoFr <> 0  Then @SerialNoFr Else 0  End
    --    And Case When @SerialNoTo <> 0  Then SerialNo  Else 0  End <=  Case When @SerialNoTo <> 0  Then @SerialNoTo Else 0  End
    --    --And Case When @DocDateFr  <> '' Then Task_Date Else '' End >=  Case When @DocDateFr  <> '' Then @DocDateFr  Else '' End
    --    --And Case When @DocDateTo  <> '' Then Task_Date Else '' End <=  Case When @DocDateTo  <> '' Then @DocDateTo  Else '' End	
    ----Group By DocDate

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_Prds_List 1
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_3
	(
		ProcessID		     Int	       Null,
		ProcessNo	     	 Int	       Null,
		FiscalYear		     Int	       Null,
		SerialNo	     	 Int	       Null,
		ProductID	     	 Varchar(20)   collate arabic_cs_as,
		FormulaNo		     Int	       Null,
		GoodsID			     Varchar(20)   collate arabic_cs_as,
		SentQuantity	     Float	       Null,
		FormulaQuantity      Float         Null,
		Kind			     Int,
		BaseFiscalYear	     Smallint      Null,
		BaseSerialNo	     Int           Null,
		BaseDocRowNo	     Int           Null,
		DocDate			     Char(10)      collate arabic_cs_as Null,
		ProdQuantity	     Float	       Null,
		GoodsAmount	         Float	       Null,
		ProductName		     Nvarchar(120) Null,
		GoodsName		     Nvarchar(120) Null,
		UnitName		     NVarchar(50),
		ProductUnitName	     NVarchar(50),
		Task_RowNo   	     Int           Null,
		Standard_Prs_Count   Int           Null,
		Used_Prs_Count       Int           Null,
		ProducedCount_Row    Float         Null,
		ProducedCount_Sum    Float         Null,
		ProductCountStandard Float         Null,
		ProductCount_Done    Float         Null
		--OrderCount               Float                            null,
		--ProducedCount_Row        Float                            null,
		--ProducedCount_Sum        Float                            null,
		--TotalTimeMin             Float                            null,
		--ProductCountStandardBase Float                            null,
		--TimeCountStandardBase    Float                            null
	);
	
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_3(
                               ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, ProductID, FormulaNo, GoodsID, SentQuantity, FormulaQuantity, Kind, BaseFiscalYear,
							   BaseSerialNo, BaseDocRowNo, DocDate, ProdQuantity, GoodsAmount, Task_RowNo, Standard_Prs_Count, Used_Prs_Count, ProducedCount_Row,
							   ProducedCount_Sum, ProductCountStandard, ProductCount_Done, ProductName, GoodsName, UnitName, ProductUnitName)

	EXEC prd.RptPrd_ProduceVariance_SHV_2 @FiscalYearFr,@FiscalYearTo,@SerialNoFr,@SerialNoTo,@DocDateFr,@DocDateTo,0,0,0,0,0,0,@ProductID,@GoodsID,@RepOptions,@RepInfo

	---- ===== Test Select
    --Select *
    --       --ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, BaseSerialNo, ProductID, ProductName, ProductUnitName, 
    --       --FormulaNo, GoodsID, GoodsName, UnitName, SentQuantity, FormulaQuantity
    --From ##Temp_Table_3
    --Where 1 = 1
    --    And Case When @ProductID    <> '' Then ProductID    Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID    <> '' Then @ProductID    Else '' End)
    --    And Case When @GoodsID      <> '' Then GoodsID      Else '' End IN (Case When @GoodsID      <> '' Then @GoodsID      Else '' End)
    --    And Case When @FiscalYearFr <> 0  Then FiscalYear   Else 0  End >=  Case When @FiscalYearFr <> 0  Then @FiscalYearFr Else 0  End
    --    And Case When @FiscalYearTo <> 0  Then FiscalYear   Else 0  End <=  Case When @FiscalYearTo <> 0  Then @FiscalYearTo Else 0  End
    --    And Case When @SerialNoFr   <> 0  Then BaseSerialNo Else 0  End >=  Case When @SerialNoFr   <> 0  Then @SerialNoFr   Else 0  End
    --    And Case When @SerialNoTo   <> 0  Then BaseSerialNo Else 0  End <=  Case When @SerialNoTo   <> 0  Then @SerialNoTo   Else 0  End
    --    And Case When @DocDateFr    <> '' Then DocDate      Else '' End >=  Case When @DocDateFr    <> '' Then @DocDateFr    Else '' End
    --    And Case When @DocDateTo    <> '' Then DocDate      Else '' End <=  Case When @DocDateTo    <> '' Then @DocDateTo    Else '' End	
    ----Group By ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, BaseSerialNo, ProductID, ProductName, ProductUnitName, FormulaNo, GoodsID, GoodsName, UnitName

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Last SELECT
	-- ==========================================================================
	IF @Test = 0
	Begin
		Select T1.SerialNo [ش.سفارش کار], LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.Task_Date, ''))) [تاریخ سفارش کار], T1.Order_SerialNo [ش.سفارش تولید], 
               T1.ShiftTypeName [شیفت], T1.ProductLineName [خط تولید], P.ProductID [کد محصول], P.ProductName [نام محصول], T1.GoodsID [کد کالا], 
			   T1.GoodstName [نام کالا], T3.UnitName [واحد کالا], T3.ProductUnitName [واحد محصول], Sum(T3.FormulaQuantity) [مقدار فرمول],
			   Sum(T3.SentQuantity) [مصرف واقعی], T3.GoodsAmount [قیمت واحد], Standard_Prs_Count [تعداد پرسنل استاندارد], Used_Prs_Count [تعداد پرسنل تولید],
               ProducedCount_Sum [تعداد تولید واقعی], ProductCountStandard [تعداد تولید با نفر استاندارد], ProductCount_Done [تعداد تولید با نفر واقعی]
		From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List P
		Inner Join ##Temp_Table_1 T1 ON T1.ProductID = P.ProductID
		Inner Join ##Temp_Table_3 T3 ON T3.BaseSerialNo = T1.SerialNo And T3.ProductID = T1.ProductID And 
		                                T3.GoodsID = T1.GoodsID --And T3.GoodsAmount > 0
		Where 1 = 1
			--And SubString(P.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
		Group By T1.SerialNo, LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.Task_Date, ''))), T1.Order_SerialNo, T1.ShiftTypeName, T1.ProductLineName, P.ProductID, 
                 P.ProductName, T1.GoodsID, T1.GoodstName, T3.UnitName, T3.ProductUnitName, T3.GoodsAmount, Standard_Prs_Count, Used_Prs_Count,
				 ProducedCount_Sum, ProductCountStandard, ProductCount_Done
		Order By LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.Task_Date, ''))), P.ProductID
	End

	-- ================================ Select Products Whith Last Prd_Info
	--Select T1.ProductID, T1.ProductName, T1.DocDate Last_Prd_Date, T1.GoodsQuantity Last_Prd_Qty, 
	--	   T1.UnitName, T1.Remain ProductRemain, 
	--	   IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') Selfon_ID, IsNull(T2.GoodsName, '') Selfon_Name, IsNull(T2.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain
	--From  ##Temp_Table_1 T1
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_2 T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID

	-- ================================ Test
	IF @Test = 1
	Begin
		Select * From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
		--Select * From ##Temp_Table_1
	End
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC pln.Rpt_Product_Task_Order
	@ProductID	  VarChar(20) = '',
	@FiscalYearFr Int = Null,
	@SerialNoFr	  Int = Null,
	@FiscalYearTo Int = Null,
	@SerialNoTo   Int = Null,
	@DocDateFr    Char(10)    = '',
	@DocDateTo    Char(10)    = '',
	@Test         Bit         = 0

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Drop Temp Tables
	-- ==========================================================================
	Begin Try
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
		Drop Table ##Temp_Table_1
	End Try
	Begin Catch
	End Catch

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_Prds_List
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
	(
	    TechnicalNo       NVarchar(50)  NULL,
		ProductID	      VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ProductName	      NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		UnitID	          VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		UnitName	      NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Goods_Tool	      Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Arz	      Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Ertefa	  Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Vazn	      Decimal(28,9),
		Goods_Vazn_Khales Decimal(28,9),
		Vazn_Khales		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Tedad_dar_Karton  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		G_Masraf_Konande  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Tool_Dar_Arz	  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Zekhamat		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ExtraField6		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ExtraField7		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		ExtraField8		  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		MapNo			  NVarChar(200) Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Remain			  Decimal(28,9),
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_Prds_List (TechnicalNo, ProductID, ProductName, UnitID, UnitName, Goods_Tool, Goods_Arz, Goods_Ertefa, Goods_Vazn, Goods_Vazn_Khales,
	                                    Vazn_Khales, Tedad_dar_Karton, G_Masraf_Konande, Tool_Dar_Arz, Zekhamat, ExtraField6, ExtraField7, ExtraField8, MapNo, Remain)
	Select 
       G.TechnicalNo, G.GoodsID ProductID, GD.GoodsName ProductName, G.UnitID, UD.UnitName,
	   G.GoodsLength Goods_Tool, G.GoodsWidth Goods_Arz, G.GoodsHeight Goods_Ertefa, G.GoodsWeight Goods_Vazn, G.PureWeight Goods_Vazn_Khales,
	   ExtraField1 Vazn_Khales, ExtraField2 Tedad_dar_Karton, ExtraField3 G_Masraf_Konande, ExtraField4 Tool_Dar_Arz, ExtraField5 Zekhamat, 
	   ExtraField6, ExtraField7, ExtraField8, MapNo, [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, G.GoodsID,  NULL, '1500/01/01', 0) Remain

	From inv.tblGoods                          G
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsDtl                GD ON G.GoodsID = GD.GoodsID
	Inner Join inv.tblUnitsDtl                UD ON G.UnitID  = UD.UnitID
	Inner Join inv.tblGoodsGroupsGoodsListDtl GG ON GG.GoodsID = G.GoodsID And GG.GoodsGroupID = '0404'
	Where 1 = 1
		And Case When @ProductID <> '' Then G.GoodsID Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> '' Then @ProductID Else '' End)
		And SubString(G.GoodsID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
		And Len(G.GoodsID) = 14
		And G.CodeClosed   = 0
	Order By G.GoodsID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Temp_Table_1
	-- ==========================================================================
	Create Table ##Temp_Table_1
	(
		SerialNo        Int,
		ProductID	    VarChar(20)   Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		Order_Date		Char(10),
		Task_Date	    Char(10),
		ShiftTypeName   NVarChar(500)  Collate Arabic_CS_AS Null,
		AcceptableCount Decimal(28,9),
		R_Count         Int,
	);

	-- ================================
	INSERT INTO ##Temp_Table_1 (SerialNo, ProductID, Order_Date, Task_Date, ShiftTypeName, AcceptableCount, R_Count)
	Select TD.SerialNo, TH.ProductID, PH.DocDate Order_Date, TH.DocDate Task_Date, ST.ShiftTypeName, Sum(TD.AcceptableCount) AcceptableCount, Count(ProductID) R_Count
	From pln.tblTaskOrderDtl          TD
	Inner Join pln.tblTaskOrderHdr    TH ON TH.ProcessID  = TD.ProcessID  And TH.ProcessNo = TD.ProcessNo And
										    TH.FiscalYear = TD.FiscalYear And TH.SerialNo  = TD.SerialNo
    Inner Join pln.tblProduceOrderHdr PH ON PH.ProcessID = TH.BaseProcessID And PH.ProcessNo = TH.BaseProcessNo And
										    PH.FiscalYear = TH.BaseFiscalYear And PH.SerialNo  = TH.BaseSerialNo
    Left  Join emp.tblShiftTypesDtl   ST ON ST.ShiftTypeID = TD.ShiftTypeID
	Where 1 = 1
		And TH.ProcessID IN(610)
		And Case When @ProductID    <> '' Then TH.ProductID  Else '' End IN (Case When @ProductID <> ''   Then @ProductID    Else '' End)
        And Case When @FiscalYearFr <> 0  Then TH.FiscalYear Else 0  End >=  Case When @FiscalYearFr <> 0 Then @FiscalYearFr Else 0  End
        And Case When @FiscalYearTo <> 0  Then TH.FiscalYear Else 0  End <=  Case When @FiscalYearTo <> 0 Then @FiscalYearTo Else 0  End
        And Case When @SerialNoFr   <> 0  Then TH.SerialNo   Else 0  End >=  Case When @SerialNoFr <> 0   Then @SerialNoFr   Else 0  End
        And Case When @SerialNoTo   <> 0  Then TH.SerialNo   Else 0  End <=  Case When @SerialNoTo <> 0   Then @SerialNoTo   Else 0  End
		And Case When @DocDateFr    <> '' Then TH.DocDate    Else '' End >=  Case When @DocDateFr <> ''   Then @DocDateFr    Else '' End
		And Case When @DocDateTo    <> '' Then TH.DocDate    Else '' End <=  Case When @DocDateTo <> ''   Then @DocDateTo    Else '' End	
		And SubString(TH.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')
	Group By TD.ProcessID, TD.ProcessNo, TD.FiscalYear, TD.SerialNo, TH.ProductID, PH.DocDate, TH.DocDate, ST.ShiftTypeName
	Order By PH.DocDate, TH.DocDate, TH.ProductID

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- ========================================================================== Last SELECT
	-- ==========================================================================
	IF @Test = 0
	Begin
		Select LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.Order_Date, ''))) [تاریخ سفارش تولید], LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(T1.Task_Date, ''))) [تاریخ سفارش کار], 
		       T1.ShiftTypeName [شیفت], T1.SerialNo [ش.سفارش کار], 
		       P.ProductName [نام محصول], P.ProductID [کد محصول], 
			   Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float) [تعداد در جعبه],
			   --Case When Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) > 0 And 
			   --          Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) Is Not Null Then 
			   --     Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) 
			   --Else 
			   --     Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Vazn_Khales)) As float) * Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float)
			   --End [وزن خالص],
			                  Cast(T1.AcceptableCount As Decimal(28, 2)) [تعداد جعبه تولیدی],
			   Cast(T1.AcceptableCount As float) * Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float) [تعداد بسته تولیدی],
			   T1.R_Count [تعداد پالت وزن شده], 
			   Cast(0 As float) [مغایرت وزن استاندارد و تولید شده],
			   Cast(0 As float) [وزن میانگبن محصول تولیدی],
			   Cast(0 As float) [درصد مغایرت وزنی],
               Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) [وزن خالص جعبه],
               Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) / 
			       Case When Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float) > 0 Then 
				        Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float) 
				   Else 1 End [وزن خالص بسته]
			   --LTrim(RTrim(IsNull(pub.funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian (T1.DocDate), ''))) DocDate_Grg,
			   --Cast(0 As float) [جمع وزن پالت ها],
			   --(T1.AcceptableCount * Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float)) * 
			   --Case When Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) > 0 And 
			   --          Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) Is Not Null Then 
			   --     Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Goods_Vazn_Khales)) As float) 
			   --Else 
			   --     Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Vazn_Khales)) As float) * Cast(LTrim(RTrim(Tedad_dar_Karton)) As float)
			   --End [وزن خالص پالت ها], 
			   --,IsNull(P.UnitName, '') [واحد], P.Remain [موجودی]
		From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List P
		Inner Join ##Temp_Table_1 T1 ON T1.ProductID = P.ProductID
		Where 1 = 1
			And SubString(P.ProductID, 1, 2) IN ('40', '41', '42', '43')

		Order By T1.Order_Date, T1.Task_Date, P.ProductID
	End

	-- ================================ Select Products Whith Last Prd_Info
	--Select T1.ProductID, T1.ProductName, T1.DocDate Last_Prd_Date, T1.GoodsQuantity Last_Prd_Qty, 
	--	   T1.UnitName, T1.Remain ProductRemain, 
	--	   IsNull(T2.GoodsID, '') Selfon_ID, IsNull(T2.GoodsName, '') Selfon_Name, IsNull(T2.Remain, 0) Selfon_Remain
	--From  ##Temp_Table_1 T1
	--Left Join ##Temp_Table_2 T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID

	-- ================================ Test
	IF @Test = 1
	Begin
		Select * From ##Temp_Table_Prds_List
		--Select * From ##Temp_Table_1
	End
END

storedProcedures.name: SpPln_GenerateTaskOrders
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ===================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 1393/05/12
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1394/03/06
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Zia
-- =============================================
Create PROCEDURE [pln].[SpPln_GenerateTaskOrders]
	@ProcSet	VarChar(100),
	@Options	VarChar(20) = '', -- bit array
	@ExtraInfo	NVarChar(100) = '1@1@1'
--WITH ENCRYPTION
AS
declare @ProcessID	int; 
declare @ProcessNo	int;
declare @FiscalYear int;
declare @SerialNo	int;
declare @DocRowNo	int;		 
declare @MaxSerialNo int;

declare @LangID		Char(1);
declare @ProdType	bit;			 
declare @SessionNo  varChar(10);
declare @ReportID   varChar(10);

declare @StrSelect  nvarchar(4000);
declare @StrWhere	nvarchar(2000);
declare @CallType	int
declare @DocDate	char(10)
declare @AllStore	int 
declare	@StepDflt	int
declare	@FrmlDflt	int
declare	@SetStateID3	int
declare	@ProductID	VarChar(20) 

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- Init ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	IF (@ExtraInfo Is Null) SET @ExtraInfo = '1@1@1';
	IF (@Options   Is Null) SET @Options = '1';

	SET @LangID		= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 1);
	SET @SessionNo	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 2);
	SET @ProdType	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 4);
	SET @CallType	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 5);
	SET @DocDate	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 6);
	SET @AllStore	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 7);
	SET @StepDflt	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 8);
	SET @FrmlDflt	= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 9);	
	SET @SetStateID3= pub.funSplitString(@ExtraInfo, '@', 10);	
 
	if @SetStateID3<> 3 
		set @SetStateID3=1
	set @FrmlDflt= isnull(@FrmlDflt,0)

	SET @ProcessID	= pub.funSplitString(@ProcSet, '@', 1);
	SET @ProcessNo	= pub.funSplitString(@ProcSet, '@', 2);
	SET @FiscalYear	= pub.funSplitString(@ProcSet, '@', 3);
	SET @SerialNo	= pub.funSplitString(@ProcSet, '@', 4);
    --SET @ProductID = pub.funSplitString(@ProcSet, '@', 5);
	SET @DocRowNo	= pub.funSplitString(@ProcSet, '@', 6);
	
	-- Select -------------------------------------------------------------------
 
	create table #tblGoodsStore
	(
		GoodsID				varchar(20) ,
		GoodsName			varchar(2000) ,
		AcceptStoreID		varchar(20) ,
		FailedStoreID		varchar(20) ,
		UsageStoreID		varchar(20) ,
		LossStoreID			varchar(20) ,
		AcceptStoreName		varchar(2000) ,
		FailedStoreName		varchar(2000) ,
		UsageStoreName		varchar(2000) ,
		LossStoreName		varchar(2000) ,
		ProducerAcntCode	varchar(20) ,
		ProducerName		varchar(2000) 
	)

	create table #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore
	(
		GoodsID	varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		UsageStoreID  varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		AcceptStoreID varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		FailedStoreID varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		LossStoreID   varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		ProducerAcntCode   varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null
	)

	create table #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping
	(
		ProcessID	int not null,
		ProcessNo	int not null,
		FiscalYear	int not null,
		SerialNo	int not null,
		DocRowNo	int not null,		
		BaseProcessID	int not null,
		BaseProcessNo	int not null,
		BaseFiscalYear	int not null,
		BaseSerialNo	int not null,
		BaseDocRowNo	int not null,
		StepNo			int not null,
		FormulaNo		int not null,
		DocDate			char(10) not null,
		GoodsID			varchar(20) collate arabic_cs_as not null,
		Quantity		float not null,
		ProductWidth	float not null,   
		ProductHeight	float not null,
		ProductQuantity2	float not null,
		LevelStr	varchar(500),
		BatchNo	varchar(20)
	)

	declare @PlnTskSaveStoreDocPerStep bit;
	set @PlnTskSaveStoreDocPerStep=0

	create table #tbl_GoodsID
	( 
	GoodsID	varchar(20) not null
	)
	Declare @GoodsID	varchar(20) =''
	
	if (@PlnTskSaveStoreDocPerStep = 1)
	begin 
	insert into #tbl_GoodsID
		select GoodsID
		from pln.tblAvailProduceOrders A
			inner join pln.tblProduceStepDtl B
			on B.ProductID=A.GoodsID and A.StepNo=B.SerialNo 
		where	(A.ProcessID = @ProcessID) 
			and (A.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
			and (A.FiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
			and (A.SerialNo = @SerialNo)
			and (@DocRowNo=0 or  A.DocRowNo = @DocRowNo)
			and (B.DocRowNo=1)					
	end 
	else
	begin 
		insert into #tbl_GoodsID
	select GoodsID
			from pln.tblAvailProduceOrders A
		where	(A.ProcessID = @ProcessID) 
			and (A.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
			and (A.FiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
			and (A.SerialNo = @SerialNo)
			and (@DocRowNo=0 or  A.DocRowNo = @DocRowNo)		
	end 
		 										
	Declare @Extra as varchar(50) 
	select top 1  @ProductID =ProductID
		from pln.tblAvailProduceOrders A
			inner join pln.tblProduceOrderDtl B
			on B.ProcessID=A.ProcessID 
			and A.ProcessNo=B.ProcessNo 
			and A.FiscalYear=B.FiscalYear 
			and A.SerialNo=B.SerialNo 			
			and A.BaseDocRowNo=B.DocRowNo 			
		where	(A.ProcessID = @ProcessID) 
			and (A.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
			and (A.FiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
			and (A.SerialNo = @SerialNo)
			and (@DocRowNo=0 or A.DocRowNo = @DocRowNo)				 

	DECLARE csrGoodsID CURSOR FOR 

	select Distinct GoodsID from #tbl_GoodsID

	OPEN csrGoodsID
	FETCH NEXT FROM csrGoodsID INTO @GoodsID

	WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0
	BEGIN
		delete  from #tblGoodsStore

		 set @Extra =@LangID + '@'+@ProductID+'@@' +ltrim(str(@StepDflt)) +'@'+ ltrim(str(@FrmlDflt	))

		INSERT INTO #tblGoodsStore
		exec  pln.spDefaultStoreID @GoodsID,0,0,@Extra
		
		insert into #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore(GoodsID, UsageStoreID, AcceptStoreID, FailedStoreID, LossStoreID,ProducerAcntCode)	
		Select GoodsID, UsageStoreID, AcceptStoreID, FailedStoreID, LossStoreID,ProducerAcntCode From  #tblGoodsStore
																						
		FETCH NEXT FROM csrGoodsID INTO @GoodsID
	END

	CLOSE csrGoodsID
	DEALLOCATE csrGoodsID
 
	select @MaxSerialNo = isnull(MAX(SerialNo),0)
	from pln.tblTaskOrderHdr
	where ProcessID=610 and ProcessNo=1 and FiscalYear=@FiscalYear

	-- ایجاد جدول 2 برای حالتی که سفارش انجام براساس موجودی انبار باشد و بعضی را بهخاطر موجود بودن تولید نکند  سریالها پشت سر هم باشند
	select *  into  #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping
	
	insert into #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2(ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo,BaseDocRowNo, GoodsID, Quantity, StepNo, FormulaNo, DocDate,ProductWidth,ProductHeight,ProductQuantity2,LevelStr,BatchNo)
	select	610 ProcessID, 1 ProcessNo, @FiscalYear FiscalYear, 
			Row_Number() over (order by A.SerialNo, A.DocRowNo) + @MaxSerialNo, 
			A.DocRowNo, 
			A.ProcessID BaseProcessID, A.ProcessNo BaseProcessNo, 
			A.FiscalYear BaseFiscalYear, 
			A.SerialNo BaseSerialNo,
			A.BaseDocRowNo ,
			A.GoodsID, A.GoodsQuantity, A.StepNo, A.FormulaNo, H.DocDate,A.ProductWidth,A.ProductHeight,A.ProductQuantity2,LevelStr,BatchNo
	from pln.tblAvailProduceOrders A
	inner join pln.tblProduceOrderHdr H on H.ProcessID=A.ProcessID and H.ProcessNo=A.ProcessNo and H.FiscalYear=A.FiscalYear and H.SerialNo=A.SerialNo
	--left join pln.tblProduceStepHdr S on S.ProductID=A.GoodsID and S.SerialNo=A.StepNo-- and S.FormulaNo=A.FormulaNo --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
	where (A.ProcessID = @ProcessID) 
		and (A.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
		and (A.FiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
		and (A.SerialNo = @SerialNo)
		and (@DocRowNo=0 or  A.DocRowNo = @DocRowNo)	

	if @ProdType=1
		begin
		-- برای بدست آوردن شماره بچ سفارش برای موجودی انبار		
	Update #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 		set BatchNo=O.BatchNo
	--select O.BatchNo,A.*
	from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 A
		inner join 	pln.tblProduceOrderDtl H on H.ProcessID=A.BaseProcessID and H.ProcessNo=A.BaseProcessNo and H.FiscalYear=A.BaseFiscalYear and H.SerialNo=A.BaseSerialNo and H.DocRowNo=A.BaseDocRowNo
		inner join sal.tblSaleOrderDtl O on H.BaseProcessID=O.ProcessID and H.BaseProcessNo=O.ProcessNo and H.BaseFiscalYear=O.FiscalYear and H.BaseSerialNo=O.SerialNo and H.BaseDocRowNo=O.DocRowNo
			where (A.BaseProcessID = @ProcessID) 
				and (A.BaseProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
				and (A.BaseFiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
				and (A.BaseSerialNo = @SerialNo)
				and (A.DocRowNo = @DocRowNo)	

 if @CallType=2
	update #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2
		set DocDate=@DocDate
			
	-- برای حذف بچ نیمه ساختهایی که بچ و فرمول تولید ندارند
	 Update #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 
	 set BatchNo=(case when (select count(*) from inv.tblGoods  
									where #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2.GoodsID=inv.tblGoods.GoodsID and inv.tblGoods.HasBatchNo=1)>0
									And (select count(*) from prd.tblFormulasDtl  where ProductID=#tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2.GoodsID)>0							
									then   BatchNo else '' end) 
	 --- بررسی موجودی تمامی انبار ها
	if @AllStore=1
			update #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2
			set  Quantity= 
							case when   [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL , m.GoodsID , NULL, m.DocDate, 0) >= m.Quantity
							then 0 else  m.Quantity-[inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL  , m.GoodsID , NULL, m.DocDate, 0) end 
			from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 m
			 inner join 	#tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore s 
			 on m.GoodsID=s.GoodsID
				where LevelStr<>'0'
	else
			
			update #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2
			set  Quantity= 
							case when   [inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.AcceptStoreID  , m.GoodsID , BatchNo, m.DocDate, 0) >= m.Quantity
							then 0 else  m.Quantity-[inv].[funGetGoodsRemain](NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.AcceptStoreID  , m.GoodsID , BatchNo, m.DocDate, 0) end 
			from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 m
			 inner join 	#tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore s 
			 on m.GoodsID=s.GoodsID
				where LevelStr<>'0'

	

			delete from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 where Quantity=0
			
		end

 if @CallType=2
	update #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2
		set DocDate=@DocDate

	-- ایجاد جدول 2 برای حالتی که سفارش انجام براساس موجودی انبار باشد و بعضی را بهخاطر موجود بودن تولید نکند  سریالها پشت سر هم باشند
	insert into #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping(ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo,BaseDocRowNo, GoodsID, Quantity, StepNo, FormulaNo, DocDate,ProductWidth,ProductHeight,ProductQuantity2,BatchNo)
	select	ProcessID,  ProcessNo, FiscalYear, 
			Row_Number() over (order by A.SerialNo, A.DocRowNo) + @MaxSerialNo, 
			DocRowNo, BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo,BaseDocRowNo, GoodsID, Quantity, StepNo, FormulaNo, DocDate,ProductWidth,ProductHeight,ProductQuantity2,BatchNo
	from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping2 A

	DECLARE @MaxRecID INT
	SELECT @MaxRecID = ISNULL(MAX(Id),0) FROM hst.tblUniqueId
 
 -- در بعضی از مواقع هنگام صدور سفارش کار تعداد با سفارش تولید متفاوت صادر می=شود برای جلوگیری این قسمت اضافه شد 
if (	Select Count(*)
		from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping t
		inner join pln.tblProduceOrderDtl p 
			on p.ProcessID=t.BaseProcessID 
				and p.ProcessNo=t.BaseProcessNo
				and p.FiscalYear=t.BaseFiscalYear
				and p.SerialNo=t.BaseSerialNo
				and p.DocRowNo=t.BaseDocRowNo
				and p.ProductID=t.GoodsID
		where Abs(t.Quantity-p.ProductCount)>1)>0  
	BEGIN
		--مشکل مغایرت تعداد سفارش کار و تعداد سفارش تولید
		Raiserror ('مشکل مغایرت تعداد سفارش کار و تعداد سفارش تولید',16,1)
		Return
	END	
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	insert into pln.tblTaskOrderHdr(ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocDate, ProductID, GoodsID, MapNo, UseFactor, OrderCount, BatchNo, Confirmer1ID, Confirmer2ID, Confirmer3ID, Approver1ID, Approver1Date, Approver2ID, Approver2Date, Approver3ID, Approver3Date, ReferenceNo, TaskStateID, RecID, SessionNo, DocStep, ProduceStepSerialNo, IsForFailed, AcceptCount, UsageStoreID, AcceptStoreID, FailedStoreID, ProductStoreID, RepairStepID, LossStoreID, FormulaNo, ProducerAcntCode, VchNo,ProductWidth,ProductHeight,ProductQuantity2
		, BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo,BaseDocRowNo,ProdDocRowNo)
	select	A.ProcessID, A.ProcessNo, A.FiscalYear, A.SerialNo, A.DocDate, A.GoodsID, '' GoodsID, '' MapNo, 0 UseFactor, A.Quantity,  A.BatchNo, '' Confirmer1ID, '' Confirmer2ID, '' Confirmer3ID, '' Approver1ID, '' Approver1Date, '' Approver2ID, '' Approver2Date, '' Approver3ID, '' Approver3Date, '' ReferenceNo, @SetStateID3 TaskStateID,Row_Number() over(order by A.SerialNo) + @MaxRecID  RecID, @SessionNo, 1 DocStep, S.SerialNo ProduceStepSerialNo, 0 IsForFailed, 0 AcceptCount, GS.UsageStoreID, GS.AcceptStoreID, GS.FailedStoreID, '' ProductStoreID, '' RepairStoreId, GS.LossStoreID, A.FormulaNo, GS.ProducerAcntCode ProducerAcntCode, 0 VchNo,ProductWidth,ProductHeight,ProductQuantity2
	 ,BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo,DocRowNo,BaseDocRowNo
	from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping A
			inner join pln.tblProduceStepHdr S on S.ProductID=A.GoodsID and S.SerialNo=A.StepNo  --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
			inner join prd.tblFormulasHdr F on F.ProductID=A.GoodsID and F.SerialNo=A.FormulaNo --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
			left join #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore GS on GS.GoodsID=A.GoodsID
	where (A.BaseProcessID = @ProcessID) 
		and (A.BaseProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
		and (A.BaseFiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
		and (A.BaseSerialNo = @SerialNo)
		and S.FormulaNo is not null


	update pln.tblTaskOrderHdr
	set ShiftTypeIDHdr=b.ShiftTypeID ,ProductionLineIDHdr=b.ProductionLineID
	from pln.tblTaskOrderHdr a
	inner join  pln.tblProduceOrderDtl b
	on a.BaseProcessID=b.ProcessID and a.BaseProcessNo=b.ProcessNo and a.BaseFiscalYear=b.FiscalYear 
		and a.BaseSerialNo=b.SerialNo and a.ProdDocRowNo=b.DocRowNo
	where (a.BaseProcessID = @ProcessID) 
		and (a.BaseProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
		and (a.BaseFiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
		and (a.BaseSerialNo = @SerialNo)

	update pln.tblTaskOrderHdr
	set BatchNo=''
	from pln.tblTaskOrderHdr a
	inner join inv.tblGoods b 
	on a.ProductID=b.GoodsID
	and b.HasBatchNo=0

	UPDATE hst.tblUniqueId
	set Id = @MaxRecID + 
	       (select COUNT(*) 
				from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping A
				inner join pln.tblProduceStepHdr S on S.ProductID=A.GoodsID and S.SerialNo=A.StepNo  --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
				inner join prd.tblFormulasHdr F on F.ProductID=A.GoodsID and F.SerialNo=A.FormulaNo --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
				left join #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore GS on GS.GoodsID=A.GoodsID
		where (A.BaseProcessID = @ProcessID) 
			and (A.BaseProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
			and (A.BaseFiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
			and (A.BaseSerialNo = @SerialNo)
			and S.FormulaNo is not null)

	select @MaxSerialNo = isnull(MAX(ItemRelationID),0)
	from pln.tblItemRelations
	--where ProcessID=610 and ProcessNo=1 and FiscalYear=@FiscalYear

    INSERT INTO pln.tblItemRelations (ItemRelationID, ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo, BaseDocRowNo, ProductCount) 
	select Row_Number() over (order by A.SerialNo) + @MaxSerialNo, A.ProcessID, A.ProcessNo, A.FiscalYear, A.SerialNo, 0, A.BaseProcessID, A.BaseProcessNo, A.BaseFiscalYear, A.BaseSerialNo, A.DocRowNo, A.Quantity
	from #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_Mapping A
		inner join pln.tblProduceStepHdr S on S.ProductID=A.GoodsID and S.SerialNo=A.StepNo  --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
		inner join prd.tblFormulasHdr F on F.ProductID=A.GoodsID and F.SerialNo=A.FormulaNo --and S.IsDefaultMethod=1
		left join #tbl_Pln_GenerateTaskOrders_GoodsStore GS on GS.GoodsID=A.GoodsID
	where (A.BaseProcessID = @ProcessID) 
		and (A.BaseProcessNo = @ProcessNo) 
		and (A.BaseFiscalYear = @FiscalYear) 
		and (A.BaseSerialNo = @SerialNo)
		and S.FormulaNo is not null
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
END

views.name: vwFormulasDtl
views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Create date   : 1389/09/16
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
CREATE VIEW [prd].[vwFormulasDtl]
AS
	SELECT D.*, 
		   G1.GoodsName as ProductName, 
		   G2.GoodsName,
		   [pub].[funGetGoodsUnitID] (D.GoodsID) GoodsUnitId,
		   [inv].[funGetUnitNameWithGoodsID] (D.GoodsID,1) GoodsUnitName,
		   [pub].[funGetGoodsSubUnitID] (D.GoodsID) GoodsSubUnitId,
		   [inv].[funGetUnitName] ([pub].[funGetGoodsSubUnitID] (D.GoodsID),1) GoodsSubUnitName 
	FROM prd.tblFormulasDtl D
	LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl G1 ON G1.GoodsID = D.ProductID
	LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl G2 ON G2.GoodsID = D.GoodsID

views.name: vwFormulasHdr
views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================

-- Viewed By	 :

CREATE VIEW [prd].[vwFormulasHdr]
AS
	SELECT H.*, 
		   G.GoodsName as ProductName,
		   [pub].[funGetGoodsUnitID] (H.ProductID) ProductUnitId ,
		   [inv].[funGetUnitNameWithGoodsID] (H.ProductID,1) ProductUnitName ,
		   [pub].[funGetGoodsSubUnitID] (H.ProductID) ProductSubUnitId,
		   [inv].[funGetUnitName] ([pub].[funGetGoodsSubUnitID] (H.ProductID),1) ProductSubUnitName
	FROM prd.tblFormulasHdr H
	LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl G ON G.GoodsID = H.ProductID

views.name: vwFunctions
views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Ahmadnejad
-- Create date   : 1389/02/23
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1389/03/08
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Ahmadnejad
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
CREATE VIEW [prs].[vwFunctions]
AS
	select	FD.*, prs.funGetHourMinutesStandard(prs.funGetMinutes(HourlyOvertime)+prs.funGetMinutes(VacationOvertime))VacationHourlyOvertime,
			/* name of month */
			pub.funGetTypeText(10, FD.MonthCode, 1) AS MonthName,
			/* name of personnel */
			(PD.FirstName + ' ' + PD.LastName) AS PersonnelName,
			/* monthly payement */
			(FD.MonthlyFunction * DH.Basepay) AS MonthPayment, 
			/* leave minutes sum before this month */
			prs.funGetHourMinutes(
			(
				select sum(Mins)
				from 
				(
					select prs.funGetMinutes(LeaveTime) AS Mins
					from prs.tblFunctionsDtl
					where (PersonnelID = FD.PersonnelID) and (MonthCode <= FD.MonthCode)
				) LeaveMins
			)) LeaveMinsBeforeMonth,
			/* leave days sum before this month */
			(
				select sum(Days)
				from 
				(
					select LeaveDay AS Days
					from prs.tblFunctionsDtl
					where (PersonnelID = FD.PersonnelID) and (MonthCode <= FD.MonthCode)
				) LeaveDays
			) LeaveDaysBeforeMonth,
			/* leave (minutes & days) sum before this month */
			prs.funGetDayHourMinsLeave(
			prs.funGetHourMinutes(
			(
				select sum(Mins)
				from 
				(
					select prs.funGetMinutes(LeaveTime) + (LeaveDay * prs.funGetMinutes((SELECT RTrim(LTrim(SettingValue)) FROM pub.tblSettings WHERE SettingKey = 'DailyLeaveHours'))) AS Mins
					from prs.tblFunctionsDtl
					where (PersonnelID = FD.PersonnelID) and (MonthCode <= FD.MonthCode)
				) LeaveMins
			))) LeaveAllBeforeMonth,
			/* leave without pay (minutes + days) */
			prs.funGetHourMinutes(
			prs.funGetMinutes(HourlyLeaveWithoutPay) + (LeaveWithoutPay * prs.funGetMinutes((SELECT RTrim(LTrim(SettingValue)) FROM pub.tblSettings WHERE SettingKey = 'DailyLeaveHours'))) 
			) LeaveWithoutPayAll
	from	prs.tblFunctionsDtl FD
				inner join prs.tblSalaryCalculation SC on SC.MonthCode = FD.MonthCode and SC.PersonnelID = FD.PersonnelID
				inner join prs.tblDecreeHdr DH on DH.SerialNo = SC.DecreeSerialNo and DH.PersonnelID = SC.PersonnelID
				inner join prs.tblPersonnelsDtl PD on PD.PersonnelID = FD.PersonnelID and PD.LanguageID = 1

CREATE VIEW [prs].[vwSalaryCalculation]
AS
	select	SC.*, 
			/* name of month */
			pub.funGetTypeText(10, SC.MonthCode, 1) AS MonthName,
			/* name of personnel */
			(PD.FirstName + ' ' + PD.LastName) AS PersonnelName,
			isnull((
				select SUM(L.ThisMonthInstallment)
				from prs.tblInstallmentDeductionsDtl L
				where (L.MonthCode = SC.MonthCode) AND (L.PersonnelID = SC.PersonnelID) 
			),0) ThisMonthLoan
			, c1.Cost CelebrationHoilday, c2.Cost AS CelebrationEndWork
	from	prs.tblSalaryCalculation SC
				inner join prs.tblPersonnelsDtl PD on PD.PersonnelID = SC.PersonnelID and PD.LanguageID = 1
					LEFT OUTER JOIN
                          (SELECT     * FROM         prs.tblCelebrationDtl
                             WHERE     (ProcessID = 320)) AS c1 ON c1.PersonnelID = SC.PersonnelID AND c1.MonthCode = SC.MonthCode
			LEFT OUTER JOIN
                          (SELECT     * FROM         prs.tblCelebrationDtl
                             WHERE     (ProcessID = 325)) AS c2 ON c2.PersonnelID = SC.PersonnelID AND c2.MonthCode = SC.MonthCode

storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Creation date : 1392/08/05
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Description	 : لیست فیلدهای حکم
-- ==============================================
Create PROCEDURE [prs].[SpPrs_DecreeChangableFields]
AS 
Begin 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select D.FieldName, D.FieldText+ ' (حکم)' as FieldText,  D.ord
	from
	(
		select 'JobCategoryPay' FieldName, 'مزد گروه شغلی روزانه  ' as [FieldText], 1 as ord
		union
		select 'PastWagesDailyPay', 'مزد سنوات قابل پرداخت روزانه  ' as [FieldText], 2 as ord
		union
		select 'DailyInferiorPay', 'حق پست (روزانه)' as [FieldText], 3 as ord
		union
		select 'DailyInferiorPayRemain', 'حق پست ماندگاری (روزانه)' as [FieldText], 4 as ord
		union
		select 'JobCategoryPayInsure' FieldName, 'مزد گروه شغلی روزانه بیمه  ' as [FieldText], 5 as ord
		union
		select 'PastWagesDailyPayInsure', 'مزد سنوات قابل پرداخت روزانه بیمه ' as [FieldText], 6 as ord
		union
		select 'DailyInferiorPayInsure', 'حق پست (روزانه) بیمه'  as [FieldText], 7 as ord
		union
		select 'DailyInferiorPayRemainInsure','حق پست ماندگاری (روزانه) بیمه' as [FieldText], 8 as ord
		union
		select 'HourlyOvertimeBase', 'مبلغ پایه اضافه کاری ساعتی' as [FieldText], 9 as ord
		union
		select 'HourlyOverProduct', 'مبلغ پایه اضافه تولید ساعتی' as [FieldText], 10 as ord
		union
		select 'HourlyWorkDeductionBase', 'مبلغ پایه کسر کاری ساعتی' as [FieldText], 11 as ord
		union
		select 'VacationOvertimeBase', 'مبلغ پایه اضافه کاری تعطیلی' as [FieldText], 12 as ord
		union
		select 'LeavePay', 'مبلغ پایه مرخصی روزانه' as [FieldText], 13 as ord
		union
		select 'HourlyDelayBase', 'مبلغ پایه تاخیر ساعتی' as [FieldText], 14 as ord
		union
		select 'AbsenceBase', 'مبلغ پایه غیبت روزانه' as [FieldText], 15 as ord
		union
		select 'MissionTime', 'ماموریت ساعتی' as [FieldText], 16 as ord
		union
		select 'MissionDaily', 'ماموریت روزانه' as [FieldText], 17 as ord
		union
		select 'BasepayTime', 'حقوق پایه ساعتی ' as [FieldText], 18 as ord
		union
		select 'TaxPercent', 'درصد مالیات' as [FieldText], 19 as ord
		union
		select 'ExemptPercent', 'درصد معافیت مالیاتی' as [FieldText], 20 as ord
				
	) D
	union all
	select 'Benefit' + ltrim(B.BenefitID), B.BenefitName + ' (مزایای مستمر)', 2000+cast(B.BenefitID  as int) as ord
	from prs.tblBenefits1Dtl B
	where B.BenefitID <> ''
	union all
	select 'Deduction' + ltrim(B.BenefitID), B.BenefitName  + ' (کسورات مستمر)', 3000+cast(B.BenefitID  as int) as ord
	from prs.tblDeduction1Dtl B
	where B.BenefitID <> ''
	order by ord, FieldText

End

storedProcedures.definition:
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE pub.SPCopyUserFormAccess
	@FrDBName_0000	NVarchar(500) = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_0000',
	@ToDBName_0000	NVarchar(500) = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_0000',
	@FrDBName_1300	NVarchar(500) = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_1398',
	@ToDBName_1300	NVarchar(500) = 'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_1399',
	@FromUser		VarChar(50)   = 'HamidSoltani',
	@ToUser			VarChar(50)   = 'NegarAliyyi',
	@Del_Previous   Bit           = 0,
	@Upd_Previous   Bit           = 0
AS

DECLARE @StrSelect	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrSelect1	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrSelect2	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrWhere1 	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrWhere2 	 NVarchar(Max);

DECLARE @StrFromUser NVarchar(2000);
DECLARE @StrToUser	 NVarchar(2000);

DECLARE @FromFSY	 Char(10);
DECLARE @ToFSY		 Char(10);

BEGIN 
	--============== S T A R T  C O D E =======================================
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SET @StrSelect   = ''
	SET @StrSelect1  = ''
	SET @StrSelect2  = ''
	SET @StrFromUser = '1 = 1'
	SET @StrToUser   = '1 = 1'
	
	Select @FromFSY = Substring(@FrDBName_1300, Len(@FrDBName_1300) - 3, Len(@FrDBName_1300))
	Select @ToFSY	= Substring(@ToDBName_1300, Len(@ToDBName_1300) - 3, Len(@ToDBName_1300))
	
	-- ============================================================== Create Where String
	IF @FromUser <> '' And @FromUser Is Not Null
		SET @StrFromUser = @StrFromUser + ' And ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.pub.funUserName(UserID) = LTrim(RTrim(''' + @FromUser + '''))'
	
	IF @ToUser <> '' And @ToUser Is Not Null
		SET @StrToUser = @StrToUser + ' And ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.funUserName(UserID) = LTrim(RTrim(''' + @ToUser + '''))'
	Else
		SET @ToUser = ''
			
	-- ============================================================== Gey UserName By User ID
	IF @ToUser <> '' And @ToUser Is Not Null
		SET @StrSelect1 = '
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== START SET Forms Access
	-- ====================================================================================================
	   DECLARE @ToUserID   Int;
	   DECLARE @FrUserID   Int;
	
	-- =======
	   Select @ToUserID = UserID 
	   From  ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblUsers
	   Where ' + @StrToUser + '

	-- =======
	   Select @FrUserID = UserID 
	   From  ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblUsers
	   Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
	-- =========================
	'

	-- ============================================================== Delete Form Access
	IF @Del_Previous = 1
	BEGIN
		IF (@FromUser <> '' And @ToUser <> '') And (@FrDBName_0000 <> @ToDBName_0000 OR @FromUser <> @ToUser)
		Begin
			SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 +
			'	
	-- ==================================================================================================== Delete From Tbl_ParameterAccess
	   DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '

	-- ========================= Delete From Tbl_ProcessConfirmAccessDtl
       DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblProcessConfirmAccessDtl Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End 

		End
		
		IF (@FromUser <> '' And @ToUser <> '') And (@FrDBName_0000 <> @ToDBName_0000 OR @FromUser <> @ToUser OR @FromFSY <> @ToFSY)
		Begin		
			SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 +
		'	
	-- ==================================================================================================== Delete From Tbl_FormAccess
	   DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess Where FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ToFSY))) + ' And ' + 
																   Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '
		'
		End
	END

	-- ========================================================================================
	-- ======================================================================================== Acnt Form Access
	-- ========================================================================================
	IF (@FromUser <> '' And @ToUser <> '') And (@FrDBName_0000 <> @ToDBName_0000 OR @FromUser <> @ToUser OR @FromFSY <> @ToFSY)
	Begin	
		SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- ==================================================================================================== Tbl_FormAccess
       INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess (UserID, FrmID, FormAccess, AllowNew, AllowEdit, AllowChangeCode, AllowDelete, 
                                                             AllowDeleteAll, AllowPrint, AllowExport, AllowDesignReport, AllowViewDeletedRecords, 
                                                             AllowViewHistory, AllowViewOldData, AllowEditDate, PrintAfterSave, FiscalYear)
       SELECT ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FrmID, FormAccess, AllowNew, AllowEdit, AllowChangeCode, AllowDelete, 
		      AllowDeleteAll, AllowPrint, AllowExport, AllowDesignReport, AllowViewDeletedRecords, 
              AllowViewHistory, AllowViewOldData, AllowEditDate, PrintAfterSave, ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ToFSY))) + '
	   FROM   ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess
	   WHERE  FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@FromFSY))) + ' And ' + @StrFromUser + 
              Case When @Del_Previous = 0 Then ' And
		      FrmID Not IN(
                            Select FrmID
                            From ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess
                            Where UserID = ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ' And FormAccess = 1
                          )' 
              Else 
		        '' 
		      End + '
	   ORDER BY FrmID
		'

		IF @Del_Previous = 0 And @Upd_Previous = 1
			SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- ==================================================================================================== UPDATE Tbl_FormAccess
       UPDATE ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess 
          SET FormAccess = FA2.FormAccess, AllowNew = FA2.AllowNew, AllowEdit = FA2.AllowEdit, AllowChangeCode = FA2.AllowChangeCode, 
              AllowDelete = FA2.AllowDelete, AllowDeleteAll = FA2.AllowDeleteAll, AllowPrint = FA2.AllowPrint, AllowExport = FA2.AllowExport, 
              AllowDesignReport = FA2.AllowDesignReport, AllowViewDeletedRecords = FA2.AllowViewDeletedRecords, AllowViewHistory = FA2.AllowViewHistory, 
              AllowViewOldData = FA2.AllowViewOldData, AllowEditDate = FA2.AllowEditDate, PrintAfterSave = FA2.PrintAfterSave
       
	   --SELECT FA1.FrmID, FA1.FormAccess, FA1.AllowNew, FA2.AllowEdit, FA1.AllowEdit, FA1.AllowChangeCode, FA1.AllowDelete, 
       --       FA1.AllowDeleteAll, FA1.AllowPrint, FA1.AllowExport, FA1.AllowDesignReport, FA1.AllowViewDeletedRecords, 
       --       FA1.AllowViewHistory, FA1.AllowViewOldData, FA1.AllowEditDate, FA1.PrintAfterSave, 1402

       FROM   ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess FA1
       INNER JOIN 
       (
         Select * 
         From ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.pub.tblFormAccess
         Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
       ) FA2 ON FA2.FiscalYear = FA1.FiscalYear And FA2.FrmID = FA1.FrmID
       WHERE FA1.FiscalYear = ' + LTrim(RTrim(Str(@ToFSY))) + ' And FA1.UserID = ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + '
		'

	End
	Else
		Print 'ERROR => Parametters ''FromUser And ToUser'' Are Same OR Parametters ''FromFSY And ToFSY'' Are Same'
		
	-- ========================================================================================
	-- ======================================================================================== Parametters Access
	-- ========================================================================================
	IF (@FromUser <> '' And @ToUser <> '') And (@FrDBName_0000 <> @ToDBName_0000 OR @FromUser <> @ToUser)
	Begin
		SET @StrSelect2 = 
		'
	-- ==================================================================================================== Parametters Access
	-- ===================================== INSERT Tbl_Parameters
	   INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameters
	   SELECT *
	   FROM   ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameters 
	   WHERE  ParameterEn Not IN(Select ParameterEn From ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameters)
	   ORDER BY ParameterEn

	-- ===================================== INSERT Tbl_ParametersDtl
	   INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParametersDtl (ParameterEn, LanguageID, ParameterName)
	   SELECT ParameterEn, LanguageID, ParameterName
	   FROM   ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParametersDtl
	   WHERE  ParameterEn Not IN(Select ParameterEn From ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParametersDtl)
	   ORDER BY ParameterEn

	-- ===================================== INSERT Tbl_ParameterAccess
	   INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess
	   SELECT ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', ParameterEn, Access
	   FROM   ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess 
	   WHERE  ' + @StrFromUser +            
	          Case When @Del_Previous = 0 Then ' And
		      ParameterEn Not IN(
                                 Select ParameterEn
                                 From ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess 
                                 Where UserID = ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ' --And Access = 1
                                )' 
              Else 
		        '' 
		      End + '
	   ORDER BY ParameterEn

	-- ==================================================================================================== Confirm Access
	-- ===================================== INSERT Tbl_ProcessConfirmAccess
	   INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblProcessConfirmAccessDtl
	   SELECT ProcessID, ProcessNo, ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', RowNo, DocRowNo, 
	          Confirm1, Confirm2, Confirm3, Confirm4, Confirm5, Voucher1, Voucher2, AllowEdit, Step
	   FROM   ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblProcessConfirmAccessDtl 
	   WHERE  ' + @StrFromUser + '
	   ORDER BY ProcessID, ProcessNo
		'
		
		IF @Del_Previous = 0 And @Upd_Previous = 1
			SET @StrSelect2 = @StrSelect2 + '
	-- ===================================== UPDATE Tbl_ParameterAccess
       UPDATE ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess 
          SET Access = PA2.Access
       --SELECT PA1.UserID, PA2.UserID, PA1.ParameterEn, PA2.ParameterEn, PA1.Access, PA2.Access

       FROM   ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess PA1
       INNER JOIN
       (
         Select * 
         From ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.usr.tblParameterAccess
         Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
       ) PA2 ON PA2.ParameterEn = PA1.ParameterEn
       WHERE PA1.UserID = ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + '
		'

	End
	Else
	Print 'ERROR => Parametters ''FrDBName_0000 And ToDBName_0000'' Are Same OR Parametters ''FromUser And ToUser'' Are Same'

	-- =========================
	PRINT @StrSelect1
	PRINT @StrSelect2

	SET @StrSelect = @StrSelect1 + @StrSelect2;
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE pub.SPCopyUserCodingAccess

	@FromUser		VarChar(50)   = 'HamidSoltani',

DECLARE @StrSelect	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrSelect1	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrSelect2	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrWhere1 	 NVarchar(Max);
DECLARE @StrWhere2 	 NVarchar(Max);

DECLARE @StrFromUser NVarchar(2000);
DECLARE @StrToUser	 NVarchar(2000);

BEGIN 
	--============== S T A R T  C O D E =======================================
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SET @StrSelect   = ''
	SET @StrSelect1  = ''
	SET @StrSelect2  = ''
	SET @StrFromUser = ' 1 = 1 '
	SET @StrToUser   = ' 1 = 1 '

	IF @FromUser <> '' And @FromUser Is Not Null
		SET @StrFromUser = @StrFromUser + 'And ' + @FrDBName_0000 + '.pub.funUserName(UserID) = LTrim(RTrim(''' + @FromUser + '''))'
	
	IF @ToUser <> '' And @ToUser Is Not Null
		SET @StrToUser = @StrToUser + 'And ' + @ToDBName_0000 + '.pub.funUserName(UserID) = LTrim(RTrim(''' + @ToUser + '''))'
	Else
		SET @ToUser = ''
			
	-- ============================================================== Gey UserName By User ID
	SET @StrSelect1 = '
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== START SET Coding Access
	-- ====================================================================================================
	DECLARE @ToUserID   Int;
	
	Select @ToUserID = UserID

	-- ====================================================================================================

		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode, RngType

	Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
	'

	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== Store Coding
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ================================================= Delete
	IF @Del_Previous = 1
		SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '

	-- =========================
	DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblStoresRng Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '
	'
	-- ================================================= Insert
	SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- =========================

	Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RangeID DESC) + (Select IsNull(MAX(RangeID), 0) From ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblStoresRng), 
		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode, RngType
	From  ' + @FrDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblStoresRng
	Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
	'

	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== Goods Coding
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ================================================= Delete
	IF @Del_Previous = 1
		SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- ==================================================================================================== Goods Coding
	-- =========================
	DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsRng Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '
	'
	-- ================================================= Insert

	-- =========================
	INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsRng (RangeID, UserID, FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, AllowDelete, 
													    AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode, RngType, PartNumber)

		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode, RngType, PartNumber
	From  ' + @FrDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsRng
	Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
	'

	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== Goods Group Coding
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ================================================= Delete
	IF @Del_Previous = 1
		SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- ==================================================================================================== Goods Group Coding
	-- =========================
	DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsGroupsRng Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '
	'
	-- ================================================= Insert
	SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- =========================
	INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsGroupsRng (RangeID, UserID, FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, 
                                                              AllowChange, AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode)
	Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RangeID DESC) + (Select IsNull(MAX(RangeID), 0) From ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsGroupsRng), 
		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode
	From  ' + @FrDBName_1300 + '.inv.tblGoodsGroupsRng
	Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
	'

	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== Our Banks Coding
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ================================================= Delete
	IF @Del_Previous = 1
		SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- ==================================================================================================== Our Banks Coding
	-- =========================
	DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.trs.tblOurBanksRng Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '
	'
	-- ================================================= Insert
	SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- =========================
	INSERT INTO ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.trs.tblOurBanksRng (RangeID, UserID, FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode, RngType)
	Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RangeID DESC) + (Select IsNull(MAX(RangeID), 0) From ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.trs.tblOurBanksRng), 
		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode, RngType
	From  ' + @FrDBName_1300 + '.trs.tblOurBanksRng
	Where ' + @StrFromUser + '
	'
	
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ==================================================================================================== SaleTypes Coding
	-- ====================================================================================================
	-- ================================================= Delete
	IF @Del_Previous = 1
		SET @StrSelect1 = @StrSelect1 + '
	-- ==================================================================================================== SaleTypes Coding
	-- =========================
	DELETE FROM ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.sal.tblSaleTypesRng Where ' + Case When @ToUser = '' Then '1 = 1' Else 'UserID = @ToUserID' End + '
	'
	-- ================================================= Insert
	SET @StrSelect2 = '
	-- =========================

	Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RangeID DESC) + (Select IsNull(MAX(RangeID), 0) From ' + @ToDBName_1300 + '.sal.tblSaleTypesRng), 
		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode
	From  ' + @FrDBName_1300 + '.sal.tblSaleTypesRng

	IF @Del_Previous = 1
		SET @StrSelect2 = @StrSelect2 + '

		   ' + Case When @ToUser <> '' Then '@ToUserID' Else 'UserID' End + ', FromCode, ToCode, AllowCodeView, AllowDefine, AllowChange, 
		   AllowDelete, AllowEdit, AllowCodeClosedEdit, AccessAllCode

	-- =============

	-- =============

	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect;
	
END

-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
-- =============================================================================================
CREATE PROC pub.SP_Bsckup_Restore_DB
     @Backup_OR_Restore Int           = 1, -- 1 => Backup And Restore | 2 => Backup | 3 => Restore
     @Backup_Date       Char(15)      = '', -- 14031201_1219
     @From_DB           NVarChar(Max) = N'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_1_1404',
     @To_DB             NVarChar(Max) = N'TS_ShirinVatanKarkhaneh_2_1404',
     @Path_Backup_File  NVarChar(Max) = N'D:\TakroSystem\.0.Backups\',
     @Path_Restore_DB   NVarChar(Max) = N'D:\TakroSystem\TS-Databases\'

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @Str_Query         NVarChar(Max) = ''

	-- =============================================================================== Init
	Select @Backup_Date = Case When @Backup_Date <> '' Then 
							   @Backup_Date 
						  Else Replace(pub.funChangeDate_GergorianToPersian(Cast(GetDate() AS Date)), '/', '') + '_' +
							   Replace(SubString(Cast(Cast(GetDate() AS Time) As VarChar(30)), 1, 5), ':', '')
						  End

	-- =============================================================================== CREATE Backup
	IF @Backup_OR_Restore = 1 OR @Backup_OR_Restore = 2
	Begin
		SET @Str_Query = '
		-- =============================================================================== CREATE Backup
		BACKUP DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + ' 
			   TO DISK = N''' + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Backup_File)) + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_'  + LTrim(RTrim(@Backup_Date)) + ''' WITH NOFORMAT, NOINIT,  
			   NAME    = N''' + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_'  + LTrim(RTrim(@Backup_Date)) + '-Full Database Backup'', SKIP, NOREWIND, NOUNLOAD, STATS = 5
			   '
	End

	-- =============================================================================== RESTORE Backup
	IF @Backup_OR_Restore = 1 OR @Backup_OR_Restore = 3
	Begin
		SET @Str_Query += '
		-- =============================================================================== RESTORE Backup
		USE [master]
		ALTER   DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB))   + ' SET  SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE
		RESTORE DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB))   + ' FROM DISK = N''' + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Backup_File)) + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_' + LTrim(RTrim(@Backup_Date)) + ''' WITH FILE = 1,  
				MOVE N'''  + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_dat'' TO N'''    + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Restore_DB)) + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB)) + '.mdf'',  
				MOVE N'''  + LTrim(RTrim(@From_DB)) + '_log'' TO N'''    + LTrim(RTrim(@Path_Restore_DB)) + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB)) + '.ldf'',  
				NOUNLOAD,  STATS = 5
		ALTER DATABASE ' + LTrim(RTrim(@To_DB)) + ' SET MULTI_USER'
	End

	-- ====================================
	PRINT @Str_Query;
	EXEC sp_executesql @Str_Query;

END

storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Jafari
-- Create date   : 1398/11/27
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : 
-- ----------------------------------------------
-- Description	 : < کنترل داده های بانک اطلاعاتی>
-- ==============================================
Create PROCEDURE pub.SpDBControl
	@CallType int 
--WITH ENCRYPTION
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @COUNT			int;
DECLARE @COUNTP2		int;
DECLARE @UnitPart		TINYINT
DECLARE @str_Goods		TINYINT
DECLARE @str_GoodsSum	TINYINT
Declare @Pub_MultiBranchISServer bit;
DECLARE @FiscalYear		int
	
	select @FiscalYear = cast( right (db_Name(),4) as int)
	
	SELECT @Pub_MultiBranchISServer = SettingValue from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey = 'Pub_MultiBranchISServer'
	set @Pub_MultiBranchISServer=isnull(@Pub_MultiBranchISServer,0)
	if @Pub_MultiBranchISServer='True'
	begin
	return 
	END	--if @Pub_MultiBranchISServer='False'

	SET @UnitPart  = 1
	SELECT @UnitPart = SettingValue from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey = 'UnitPart'

	IF @UnitPart IS NULL or @UnitPart = 0
		SET @UnitPart = 1

	select @str_Goods = ISNULL(SUM (Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7+Layer8+Layer9),0)
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where TableName='inv.tblGoods' AND PartNumber<@UnitPart

	select @str_GoodsSum = Layer1+Layer2+Layer3+Layer4+Layer5+Layer6+Layer7+Layer8+Layer9
	from pub.tblCodeLayer 
	where TableName= 'inv.tblGoods' AND PartNumber=@UnitPart
	set @COUNTP2=0
	
	select @COUNTP2 =COUNT(*) from inv.tblGoods where PartNumber >1

	Declare @NotControlTolerance bit;

	select SerialNo CallType, DescDtl ErrorType,  SerialNo ErrorCount, DescDtl ErrorDesc  
		into #TblError
	from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl
	where 1=0
		
	SELECT @NotControlTolerance = SettingValue FROM pub.tblSettings WHERE SettingKey = 'NotControlTolerance'	
	
--------'acc-1'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=10001 
	begin
		SELECT * into #tblacc1  --  @COUNT =COUNT(*) 
		FROM (
			Select SourceProcessID,SourceProcessNo,SourceFiscalYear,SourceSerialNo 
			From acc.tblVoucherDtl 
			where SourceProcessID in (Select ProcessID from trs.tblPayDtl) and SerialNo<>0 
			except
			Select ProcessID,ProcessNo,FiscalYear,SerialNo From  trs.tblPayDtl 
			)a

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblacc1) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into #TblError
				select 10001 CallType,'acc-1' CallType ,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblacc1) ErrorCount,' #$  (acc.tblVoucherDtl  1-1)  پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(وجود سند دریافت و پرداخت بدون برگ مرجع ) دارد ' ErrorDesc				 
			else
				Select * from #tblacc1
		end 
	end 
--------'acc-2'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=10002 
	begin
		SELECT * into #tblacc2  --@COUNT =COUNT(*) 
		FROM (
			Select SourceProcessID,SourceProcessNo,SourceFiscalYear,SourceSerialNo 
			From acc.tblVoucherDtl 
			where SourceProcessID in (Select ProcessID from inv.tblStorageDocsDtl ) and SourceSerialNo<>0	
			except
			Select ProcessID,ProcessNo,FiscalYear,SerialNo From  inv.tblStorageDocsDtl 
			)a
		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblacc2) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into #TblError
				select 10002 CallType,'acc-2' CallType ,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblacc2) ErrorCount,' #$  (acc.tblVoucherDtl  1-2)  پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(وجود سند انبار بدون برگ مرجع ) دارد ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblacc2
		end 
	end 
--------'inv-1'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=20001
	begin   --Drop Table #tblinv1

		SELECT S.* into #tblinv1  --@COUNT =COUNT(*) 
			FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S 
			INNER JOIN inv.tblGoods G 
			ON SUBSTRING(S.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=G.GoodsID AND G.PartNumber=@UnitPart AND 
			   S.SubUnitID=G.UnitID AND 
			   ROUND(GoodsQuantity,5)<>ROUND(SubUnitQuantity,5)
			   and 1=0

		if @COUNTP2>0 
			insert into #tblinv1 
			SELECT S.*  --@COUNT =COUNT(*) 
			FROM inv.tblStorageDocsDtl S 
			INNER JOIN inv.tblGoods G 
			ON SUBSTRING(S.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=G.GoodsID AND G.PartNumber=@UnitPart AND
