				select 50001 CallType,'prd-1' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblprd1) ErrorCount,' #$ (prd.tblFormulasHdr) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل تعریف چندین فرمول پیش فرض برای یک محصول ) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblprd1
		end	
	end 
--------'prd-2'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=50002
	begin
 
		select f.* into #tblprd2  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				inner join inv.tblGoods g on f.GoodsID =g.GoodsID
				and f.GoodsQuantity <>f.SubUnitQuantity
				and g.UnitID =f.UnitID
			and 1=0
		if @COUNTP2 >0
			insert into #tblprd2 
			select f.*  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				left join inv.tblGoods g ON SUBSTRING(f.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=g.GoodsID  AND g.PartNumber=@UnitPart AND f.UnitID =g.UnitID
				and f.GoodsQuantity <>f.SubUnitQuantity
				and g.UnitID =f.UnitID
		else 
			insert into #tblprd2 
			select f.*-- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				inner join inv.tblGoods g 
				ON f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID  AND f.UnitID =g.UnitID
				and f.GoodsQuantity <>f.SubUnitQuantity
				and g.UnitID =f.UnitID
		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblprd2) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 50002 CallType,'prd-2' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblprd2) ErrorCount,' #$ (prd.tblFormulasDtl) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل تعریف مقدار واحد اصلی و فرعی در جدول تعریف فرمول برای واحد اصلی کالا ) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblprd2
		end	
	end 
--------'prd-3'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=50003
	begin
		
		select f.* into #tblprd3  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				inner join inv.tblGoods g on f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID
				inner join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl s on s.GoodsID=g.GoodsID and s.SubUnitID=f.UnitID and MainUnitValue<>UnitValue
				where f.GoodsQuantity=f.SubUnitQuantity
				and g.UnitID<>f.UnitID
			and 1=0
		if @COUNTP2 >0
			insert into #tblprd3 
			select f.*  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				left join inv.tblGoods g ON SUBSTRING(f.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=g.GoodsID  AND g.PartNumber=@UnitPart AND f.UnitID =g.UnitID
				inner join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl s on s.GoodsID=g.GoodsID and s.SubUnitID=f.UnitID and MainUnitValue<>UnitValue
				where f.GoodsQuantity=f.SubUnitQuantity
				and g.UnitID<>f.UnitID
		else 
			insert into #tblprd3 
			select f.*-- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				inner join inv.tblGoods g ON f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID 
				inner join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl s on s.GoodsID=g.GoodsID and s.SubUnitID=f.UnitID and MainUnitValue<>UnitValue
				where f.GoodsQuantity=f.SubUnitQuantity
				and g.UnitID<>f.UnitID

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblprd3) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 50003 CallType,'prd-3' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblprd3) ErrorCount,' #$ (prd.tblFormulasDtl) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل تعریف مقدار واحد اصلی و فرعی یکسان و با واحد های متفاوت در جدول تعریف فرمول  ) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblprd3
		end	
	end 

--------'pln-1'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=60001
	begin
		select * into #tblpln1  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
		from pln.tblProduceStepDtl
			where (AcceptStoreID <>'' and AcceptStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores)) 
			or (FailedStoreID <>'' and FailedStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores))
			or (LossStoreID <>'' and LossStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores))
			or (UsageStoreID <>'' and UsageStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores))

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln1) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 60001 CallType,'pln-1' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln1) ErrorCount,' #$ (pln.tblProduceStepDtl) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل استفاده کد انبار ناموجود در جدول مراحل تولید) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblpln1
		end
	end 
--------'pln-2'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=60002
	begin
		select * into #tblpln2  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
		from pln.tblTaskOrderHdr
			where (AcceptStoreID <>'' and AcceptStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores)) 
			or (FailedStoreID <>'' and FailedStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores))
			or (ProductStoreID <>'' and ProductStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores))
			or (UsageStoreID <>'' and UsageStoreID  not in (SELECT StoreID FROM inv.tblStores)) 
 
		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln2) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 60002 CallType,'pln-2' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln2)  ErrorCount,' #$ (pln.tblTaskOrderHdr) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل استفاده کد انبار ناموجود در جدول سفارش کار تولید) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblpln2
		end
	end 
--------'pln-3'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------				
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=60003
	begin
			select f.* into #tblpln3  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				left join inv.tblGoods g 
				ON f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID  AND f.UnitID =g.UnitID
				left join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl u on f.GoodsID=u.GoodsID and f.UnitID =u.SubUnitID
			where g.GoodsID is null and  u.GoodsID is null
			and 1=0
		if @COUNTP2 >0
			insert into #tblpln3 
			select f.*  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				left join inv.tblGoods g 
				ON SUBSTRING(f.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=g.GoodsID  AND g.PartNumber=@UnitPart AND f.UnitID =g.UnitID
				left join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl u on SUBSTRING(f.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=u.GoodsID and f.UnitID =u.SubUnitID
			where g.GoodsID is null and  u.GoodsID is null
		else 
			insert into #tblpln3 
			select f.*-- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasDtl f
				inner join inv.tblGoods g ON f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID  AND f.UnitID =g.UnitID
				left join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl u on f.GoodsID=u.GoodsID and f.UnitID =u.SubUnitID
			where g.GoodsID is null and  u.GoodsID is null
 
		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln3) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 60003 CallType,'pln-3' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln3)  ErrorCount,' #$ (prd.tblFormulasDtl ) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل استفاده کد واحد کالای ناموجود در جدول فرومول تولید) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblpln3
		end
	end 
--------'pln-4'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=60004
	begin
		select f.* into #tblpln4  -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasAtm f
				left join inv.tblGoods g ON f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID AND f.SubUnitID =g.UnitID
				left join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl u on f.GoodsID=u.GoodsID and f.SubUnitID =u.SubUnitID
			where g.GoodsID is null and  u.GoodsID is null 
			and 1=0

		if @COUNTP2 >0
			insert into #tblpln4
			select f.*   -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasAtm f
				left join inv.tblGoods g ON SUBSTRING(f.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=g.GoodsID AND g.PartNumber=@UnitPart AND f.SubUnitID =g.UnitID
				left join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl u on SUBSTRING(f.GoodsID,@str_Goods+1,@str_GoodsSum)=u.GoodsID and f.SubUnitID =u.SubUnitID
			where g.GoodsID is null and  u.GoodsID is null
		else
			insert into #tblpln4
			select f.* -- @COUNT =COUNT(*)  
			from prd.tblFormulasAtm f
				left join inv.tblGoods g ON f.GoodsID=g.GoodsID AND f.SubUnitID =g.UnitID
				left join inv.tblSubUnitsDtl u on f.GoodsID=u.GoodsID and f.SubUnitID =u.SubUnitID
			where g.GoodsID is null and  u.GoodsID is null 

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln4) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 60004 CallType,'pln-4' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblpln4)  ErrorCount,' #$ (prd.tblFormulasAtm) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی(مشکل استفاده کد واحد کالای ناموجود در جدول فرومول اتم تولید) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblpln4
		end
	end 
--------'ast-1'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=70001
	begin
		Select a.* into #tblast1  --  @COUNT =COUNT(*)
		from (Select   Case when ProcessID in (450,455,460)  then PurchaseDate else DocDate end DocDate, EventNo,ProcessID, AssetPlaque from ast.tblAssetsDtl) a
		inner join (Select   Case when ProcessID in (450,455,460)  then PurchaseDate else DocDate end DocDate, EventNo,ProcessID, AssetPlaque from ast.tblAssetsDtl) b on a.AssetPlaque=b.AssetPlaque
		where  a.DocDate>b.DocDate and a.EventNo<b.EventNo	 

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblast1) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 70001 CallType,'ast-1' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblast1)  ErrorCount,' #$ ( ast.tblAssetsDtl) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی( مشکل شماره ترتیب در جدول اموال ) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblast1
		end
	end 
--------'ast-2'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=70002
	begin
		Select * into #tblast2  --  @COUNT =COUNT(*) 
		from ast.tblAssetsDtl where DepreciationRate=0 and DepreciationMethod<>3

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblast2) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 70002 CallType,'ast-2' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblast2) ErrorCount,' #$ ( ast.tblAssetsDtl) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی( مشکل خالی بودن نرخ استهلاک برای محاسبه اموال) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblast2
		end
	end 
--------'ast-3'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=70003
	begin
		Select Sum(EnterKind)EnterKinds,AssetPlaque into #tblast3  -- @COUNT =Sum(EnterKind)  
		FROM	ast.tblAssetsDtl  group by AssetPlaque having Sum(EnterKind)<0 or  Sum(EnterKind)>1

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblast3) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 70003 CallType,'ast-3' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblast3) ErrorCount,' #$ ( ast.tblAssetsDtl) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی( گردش مشکل دار اموال ) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblast3
		end
	end 
--------'prs-1'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=80001
	begin
		select Count(*)CNT,PersonnelID into #tblprs1  --   @COUNT =Count(*)   
		from prs.tblPersonnelAccountsDtl 
		where IsDefault=1	 
		group by PersonnelID 
		having Count(*)>1
	 
		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblprs1) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 80001 CallType,'prs-1' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblprs1)  ErrorCount,' #$ ( prs.tblPersonnelAccountsDtl )  پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی( مشکل تعداد شماره حساب پیش فرض پرسنل ) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblprs1
		end
	end 
--------'prs-2'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=80002
	begin
		select Count(*)CNT,SerialNo,FiscalYear into #tblprs2  --   @COUNT =Count(*)   
		from prs.tblLoanInstallmentsDtl		 
		group by SerialNo,FiscalYear 
		having Count(*)>1

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblprs2) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 80002 CallType,'prs-2' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblprs2)  ErrorCount,' #$ ( prs.tblLoanInstallmentsDtl		 ) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی( مشکل تکراری بودن شماره سریال تعاریف وام پرسنلی) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblprs2
		end		
	end 
--------'prs-3'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1 or @CallType=80003
	begin
			select Count(*) CNT,b.SerialNo,b.FiscalYear  into #tblprs3 
			from  prs.tblInstallmentDeductionsDtl a 
			inner join prs.tblLoanInstallmentsDtl b
			on a.PersonnelID=b.PersonnelID
			and a.ReceiptDate=b.ReceiptDate
			and a.LoanTypeID=b.LoanTypeID
			and (a.FiscalYear<>b.FiscalYear or a.SerialNo<>b.SerialNo)
			Group by b.SerialNo,b.FiscalYear

		if (Select COUNT(*) from #tblprs3) >0
		begin
			if @CallType=1
				insert into   #TblError
				select 80003 CallType,'prs-3' CallType,(Select COUNT(*) from #tblprs3)  ErrorCount,' #$ ( prs.tblLoanInstallmentsDtl		 ) پیغام : 150001 $#  پایگاه داده نیاز به سازماندهی( مشکل عدم همخوانی شماره سریال تعاریف وام پرسنلی) دارد  ' ErrorDesc
			else
				Select * from #tblprs3
		end		
	end 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	if @CallType=1
		select 	 CallType  [کد خطا], ErrorType [عنوان],  ErrorCount [تعدا خطا], ErrorDesc [شرح خطا] from  #TblError 

END

storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author        : TakroSystem\Jafari
-- Create date   : 1397/07/01
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : 
-- Description   : 
-- =============================================

Create procedure pub.SpLcWikikiInvoice
 @ExtraParams nvarchar(1000) --COLLATE Arabic_CS_AS--SQL_Latin1_General_CP1254_CI_AS
as
begin

declare @ServerName			nvarchar(50)
declare @DBName				nvarchar(50)
declare @UserName			nvarchar(50)
declare @Pass				nvarchar(50)
declare @StoreCode			varchar(20)
declare @ItemID				varchar(20)
declare @VATRate			float
declare @PriceWithVAT		float
declare @AmountWithVAT		float
declare @ProcessID			int
declare @ProcessNo			int
declare @FiscalYear			int
declare @SerialNo			int
declare @TranDate			Char(10)
declare @TranTime			Char(8)
declare @POSCode			varchar(20)
declare @IntervalSeconds	int 
declare @TranHeaderID		bigint
declare @TranItemID			bigint
declare @TranDiscountID		bigint
declare @TranPaymentID		bigint
declare @TranTypeID			int
DECLARE @StrSelect			NVarChar(max)
DECLARE @Quantity			float
DECLARE @DiscountPercentDtl	float
DECLARE @DiscountDtl		float
DECLARE @Amount				float
DECLARE @PayTypeID			int



SET @ServerName	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 1)); 
SET @DBName		    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 2)); 
SET @UserName	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 3)); 
SET @Pass			= LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 4)); 
SET @StoreCode	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 5)); 

-------Create Temp Table ------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN TRY


		select ProcessID , ProcessNo, FiscalYear,SerialNo ,DocDate TranDate,DocTime TranTime,CashID POSCode, Interval IntervalSeconds
		into #Invoice
		from  inv.tblStorageDocsHdr h
		Where ProcessID in(90,100)  
		and SgnSN5=0   --  قبلا ارسال نشده
		and DocStep<90

		--select * from #Invoice

		select b.TechnicalNo ItemID ,GoodsQuantity Quantity,c.SalePrice PriceWithVAT, Coefficient VATRate, c.UserPrice AmountWithVAT,c.UserPrice DiscountPercentDtl,d.DiscountDtl
		into #InvoiceDtl
		from  inv.tblStorageDocsDtl d 
		inner join inv.tblGoods b on d.GoodsID=b.GoodsID
		inner join sal.tblGoodsPricesDtl c on d.GoodsID=c.GoodsID
		where 1=0

		select case when  b.PayTypeID=1 then 1 else 2 end PayTypeID  , case when @TranTypeID=1 then Sum(b.Amount) *-1 else  sum(b.Amount ) end Amount 
		into #InvoicePay
		from  trs.tblPayHdr  a   inner join  trs.tblPayDtl b
		on a.ProcessID=b.ProcessID
		and a.ProcessNo=b.ProcessNo
		and a.FiscalYear=b.FiscalYear
		and a.SerialNo=b.SerialNo
		where 1=0
		Group by PayTypeID


---------Crate #MaxID  Table ----------------------------------------------------------
	select 2017208043 ID
		into #MaxID
		from  inv.tblStorageDocsHdr
		Where 1=0

--------------get max ID TranHeaderID----------------------------------------------------------------

	set @StrSelect = ' insert into #MaxID select isnull(max(TranHeaderID) ,0) ID
		from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionHeaderImport  a '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		select  top 1 @TranHeaderID=ID  from  #MaxID 
--------------get max ID TranItemID----------------------------------------------------------------
	delete from  #MaxID 
		set @StrSelect = ' insert into #MaxID select isnull(max(TranItemID) ,0) ID
		from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionLineImport  a '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		select  top 1 @TranItemID=ID  from  #MaxID 
--------------get max ID TranDiscountID----------------------------------------------------------------
	delete from  #MaxID 
		set @StrSelect = ' insert into #MaxID select isnull(max(TranDiscountID) ,0) ID
		from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionDiscountImport  a '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		select  top 1 @TranDiscountID=ID  from  #MaxID 
--------------get max ID TranPaymentID----------------------------------------------------------------
		delete from  #MaxID 
		set @StrSelect = ' insert into #MaxID select isnull(max(TranPaymentID) ,0) ID
		from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionPaymentImport  a '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		select  top 1 @TranPaymentID=ID  from  #MaxID 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 --select * from #Invoice 
 
Declare	Cursor_Rec CURSOR For 
  select * from #Invoice 

Open  Cursor_Rec; 

Fetch NEXT From Cursor_Rec Into @ProcessID , @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear,@SerialNo ,@TranDate,@TranTime,@POSCode,@IntervalSeconds

While (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
BEGIN
	set @TranHeaderID=@TranHeaderID+1
----------set @TranTypeID --------------------------------
	set @TranTypeID=0 
	
	if @ProcessID=100 	
		set @TranTypeID=1
-------------convert date -----------------------------------
	select @TranDate=[pub].[funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian](@TranDate)
----------------------- Get Time From History
	
 ------insert HDR ----------------------------------------------
	set @StrSelect = ' 
	 insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionHeaderImport 
				( TranHeaderID, StoreCode, TranTypeID, TranDate, TranTime, IntervalSeconds, POSCode, CashierID,ImportReady)
	SELECT '+ str(@TranHeaderID) + ',  '''+ @StoreCode + ''',  '+ str(@TranTypeID) + ',   '''+ @TranDate + ''', 
			'''+ @TranTime + ''', '+ str(@IntervalSeconds) +', '''+ @POSCode + ''',999,0'
	print @StrSelect;
	exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
	
----set @StrSelect = ' 
----	 insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.aaa 
----	( TranHeaderID, StoreCode, TranTypeID, TranDate, TranTime, IntervalSeconds, POSCode, CashierID,ImportReady)
----	SELECT '+ str(@TranHeaderID) + ',  '''+ @StoreCode + ''',  '+ str(@TranTypeID) + ',   '''+ @TranDate + ''', 
----	'''+ @TranTime + ''', 10, '''+ @POSCode + ''',999,0'
----	print @StrSelect;
----	exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

	
----------------insert Dtl--------------------------------------
	Delete From #InvoiceDtl 
		--  Create temp  Table
		insert into #InvoiceDtl 
		select 
			b.TechnicalNo ItemID 
			,GoodsQuantity Quantity
			,d.Price0 * GoodsQuantity AmountWithVAT
			, Coefficient VATRate
			, d.GoodsPrice  * GoodsQuantity PriceWithVAT
			,((d.GoodsPrice -d.Price0 )*100/d.GoodsPrice ) DiscountPercentDtl  
			,  (d.GoodsPrice -d.Price0 ) * d.GoodsQuantity  DiscountDtl  
		from  inv.tblStorageDocsDtl d 
			inner join inv.tblGoods b on d.GoodsID=b.GoodsID and b.IsService=0
			inner join sal.tblGoodsPricesDtl c on d.GoodsID=c.GoodsID
		where ProcessID=@ProcessID
			and ProcessNo=@ProcessNo
			and FiscalYear=@FiscalYear
			and SerialNo=@SerialNo
		  
 ------insert Dtl ----------------------------------------------
	Declare	Cursor_RecDtl CURSOR For 
		   select * from #InvoiceDtl 

		Open  Cursor_RecDtl; 

		Fetch NEXT From Cursor_RecDtl Into  @ItemID ,@Quantity,@AmountWithVAT , @VATRate, @PriceWithVAT,@DiscountPercentDtl,@DiscountDtl

		While (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
		BEGIN
			set @TranItemID=@TranItemID+1
		 ------insert Dtl -----------------------
		set @StrSelect = ' 
		insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionLineImport 
				( TranItemID, TranHeaderID, ItemID, SellerID, Quantity, PriceWithVAT, VATRate, AmountWithVAT, ReturnRef)
		SELECT '+ str(@TranItemID) + ',  '+ str(@TranHeaderID) + ',  '''+ @ItemID + ''',999,  '+ str(@Quantity) + '
				, '+ str(@PriceWithVAT) + ', '+ str(@VATRate) + ', '+ str(@AmountWithVAT) + ',  0 '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect; 

 --set @StrSelect = ' 
	--	insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.bbb 
	--	( TranItemID, TranHeaderID, ItemID, SellerID, Quantity, PriceWithVAT, VATRate, AmountWithVAT, ReturnRef)
	--	SELECT '+ str(@TranItemID) + ',  '+ str(@TranHeaderID) + ',  '''+ @ItemID + ''',999,  '+ str(@Quantity) + '
	--	 , '+ str(@PriceWithVAT) + ', '+ str(@VATRate) + ', '+ str(@AmountWithVAT) + ',  0 '
	--	print @StrSelect;
	--	exec sp_executesql @StrSelect; 

		 ------insert DiscountDtl ----------------------------------------------
		if  @DiscountDtl> 0 or @DiscountPercentDtl>0
		begin
			set @TranDiscountID=@TranDiscountID+1
		set @StrSelect = ' 
			insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionDiscountImport 
					(TranDiscountID, TranItemID, DiscountRate, Amount)
			SELECT '+ str(@TranDiscountID) + ',  '+ str(@TranItemID) + ',  '+ cast(@DiscountPercentDtl  as varchar (10)) + ',  '+ str(@DiscountDtl) 
			print @StrSelect;
			exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;   
 --set @StrSelect = ' 
	--		insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.ddd 
	--		(TranDiscountID, TranItemID, DiscountRate, Amount)
	--		SELECT '+ str(@TranDiscountID) + ',  '+ str(@TranItemID) + ',  '+ cast(@DiscountPercentDtl  as varchar (10)) + ',  '+ str(@DiscountDtl) 
	--		print @StrSelect;
	--		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;   
 
		end
		Fetch NEXT From Cursor_RecDtl Into  @ItemID ,@Quantity,@AmountWithVAT , @VATRate, @PriceWithVAT,@DiscountPercentDtl,@DiscountDtl
			End

		Close Cursor_RecDtl;
		Deallocate Cursor_RecDtl; 

-------- insert pays--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		Delete from  #InvoicePay
		--  Create temp  Table--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		insert into #InvoicePay
		select 
			case when  b.PayTypeID=1 then 1 else 2 end PayTypeID  
			, case when @TranTypeID=1 then Sum(b.Amount) *-1 else  sum(b.Amount ) end Amount 
		from  trs.tblPayHdr  a   
			inner join  trs.tblPayDtl b
		on a.ProcessID=b.ProcessID		 
			and a.ProcessNo=b.ProcessNo
			and a.FiscalYear=b.FiscalYear		 
			and a.SerialNo=b.SerialNo
		where a.BaseProcessID=@ProcessID		 
			and a.BaseProcessNo=@ProcessNo
			and a.BaseFiscalYear=@FiscalYear		 
			and a.BaseSerialNo=@SerialNo
			and  b.PayTypeID  in (1,35,36)
		 Group by PayTypeID

		Declare	Cursor_RecPay CURSOR For 
		   select * from #InvoicePay 

		Open  Cursor_RecPay; 
		Fetch NEXT From Cursor_RecPay Into  @PayTypeID,@Amount
		While (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
		BEGIN
			set @TranPaymentID=@TranPaymentID+1
 ------insert PayDtl -----------------------
		
			set @StrSelect = ' 
			insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.TransactionPaymentImport 
					(TranPaymentID, TranHeaderID, PaymentType, Amount, AmountLCY)
			SELECT '+ str(@TranPaymentID) + ',  '+ str(@TranHeaderID) + ',  '+ str(@PayTypeID) + ',  '+ str(@Amount) + ',  '+ str(@Amount) 
			print @StrSelect;
			exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
	
			--set @StrSelect = ' 
			--insert into ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.ccc 
			--(TranPaymentID, TranHeaderID, PaymentType, Amount, AmountLCY)
			--SELECT '+ str(@TranPaymentID) + ',  '+ str(@TranHeaderID) + ',  '+ str(@PayTypeID) + ',  '+ str(@Amount) + ',  '+ str(@Amount) 
			--print @StrSelect;
			--exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

	
		Fetch NEXT From Cursor_RecPay Into  @PayTypeID,@Amount
		
		End
		Close Cursor_RecPay;
		Deallocate Cursor_RecPay; 

	-------------------------- Set to Transfer end ----------------------------------------------------
		update inv.tblStorageDocsHdr
			set   SgnSN5=@TranHeaderID
		Where ProcessID=@ProcessID
			and ProcessNo=@ProcessNo
			and FiscalYear=@FiscalYear
			and SerialNo=@SerialNo 

Fetch NEXT From Cursor_Rec Into @ProcessID , @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear,@SerialNo ,@TranDate,@TranTime,@POSCode,@IntervalSeconds

End

Close Cursor_Rec;
Deallocate Cursor_Rec; 


END TRY

BEGIN CATCH

END CATCH		

 end

storedProcedures.name: SpLcWikikiItem
storedProcedures.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author        : TakroSystem\Jafari
-- Create date   : 1397/07/01
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : 
-- Description   : 
-- =============================================
-- exec pub.SpLcWikikiItem '172.110.59.3\retailstore@Sync@nab@nab'
Create procedure [pub].[SpLcWikikiItem]
 @ExtraParams nvarchar(1000) --COLLATE Arabic_CS_AS--SQL_Latin1_General_CP1254_CI_AS
 as
begin

declare @ServerName	nvarchar(50)
declare @DBName		nvarchar(50)
declare @UserName	nvarchar(50)
declare @Pass		nvarchar(50)

SET @ServerName	= LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 1)); 
SET @DBName	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 2)); 
SET @UserName	= LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 3)); 
SET @Pass	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 4)); 

	 
DECLARE @StrSelect	NVarChar(max)
--  Create temp  Table-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

declare @GoodsID			varchar(20)
declare @GoodsName			nvarchar(200)
declare @Color				nvarchar(200)
declare @ColorName			nvarchar(200)
declare @Size				nvarchar(200)
declare @Size2				nvarchar(200)
declare @ProductName		nvarchar(200)
declare @SpecialCode		nvarchar(200)
declare @ItemClassCode		varchar(20)
declare @MerchSubGroup		nvarchar(200)
declare @MerchSubGroupName	nvarchar(200)
declare @ItemID				varchar(20)
declare @BarCode			nvarchar(200)
declare @FirstPriceWithVAT	Dec
declare @VATRate			Dec
declare @PriceWithVAT		Dec
declare @IsSaleBlocked		bit
declare @cnt1				bigint
declare @idx1				bigint
declare @ExtraField1		nvarchar(500)
declare @ExtraField2		nvarchar(500)
declare @ExtraField3		nvarchar(500)
declare @ExtraField4		nvarchar(500)
declare @ExtraField5		nvarchar(500)


select 
@GoodsID  GoodsID 
,@Color  Color 
,@ColorName  ColorName
,@Size   Size  
,@Size2  Size2  
,@GoodsName  GoodsName  
,@ProductName  ProductName  
,@SpecialCode SpecialCode 
,@ItemClassCode ItemClassCode 
,@MerchSubGroup MerchSubGroup 
,@MerchSubGroupName MerchSubGroupName 
,@ItemID	ItemID	
,@BarCode BarCode 
,@FirstPriceWithVAT FirstPriceWithVAT 
,@VATRate VATRate 
,@PriceWithVAT	 PriceWithVAT	 
,@IsSaleBlocked IsSaleBlocked
 
into #Items
from  inv.tblGoods a 
	inner join inv.tblGoodsDtl b 
on a.GoodsID=b.GoodsID
Where 1=0
  
    select 555

---  fill temp Table  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set @StrSelect = 'insert into #Items
Select top 1000 ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.SpecialCode, '''')))+ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.Color, '''')))+ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.Size, '''')))+	ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.Size2, '''')	)) GoodsID
	,ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.Color, '''')))Color,ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.ColorName, '''')))ColorName,ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.Size, '''')))Size ,	ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.Size2, '''')	)) Sixe2
	,isnull(a.ItemClass,'''') GoodsName,isnull(a.ProductName,'''')ProductName,isnull(a.SpecialCode,'''')SpecialCode,isnull(a.ItemClassCode,'''')ItemClassCode
	,isnull(a.MerchSubGroup,'''')MerchSubGroup
	,isnull(a.MerchSubGroupName,'''')MerchSubGroupName,isnull(b.ItemID,'''')ItemID,isnull(b.Barcode,'''')BarCode,	isnull(b.FirstPriceWithVAT	,0)FirstPriceWithVAT
	,isnull(b.VATRate	,0)VATRate,isnull(b.PriceWithVAT	,0)PriceWithVAT	,isnull(b.IsSaleBlocked 	,0) IsSaleBlocked
	 
from Product  a 
	inner join Item b 
on a.ProductID=b.ProductID Where b.IsDeleted=0'

print @StrSelect;
exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
-- read from Temp Table and Insert or update inv.tblGoods-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--select * from #Items

set @idx1=0
--    --select * from #Items

Declare	Cursor_Rec CURSOR For 
    select * from #Items 

Open Cursor_Rec; 

Fetch NEXT From Cursor_Rec Into 
  @GoodsID,@Color,@ColorName,@Size,@Size2,@GoodsName, @ProductName, @SpecialCode, @ItemClassCode, @MerchSubGroup, @MerchSubGroupName, @ItemID	
 , @BarCode, @FirstPriceWithVAT, @VATRate, @PriceWithVAT	, @IsSaleBlocked

While (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
BEGIN
--print  @idx1
---if @idx1 %50=0
	
	print  @idx1

if @idx1 %100=0
	select @idx1
	
set @idx1=@idx1+1
		
	 if (select count(*) from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID=@GoodsID)>0
		begin
	--	print '(select count(*) from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID=@GoodsID)>0'
	--print 'Update tblGoods' 
			update inv.tblGoods 
			set BarCode=@BarCode
			,TechnicalNo=@ItemID
			,ExtraField1=@SpecialCode		
			,ExtraField2=@Color
			,ExtraField3=@Size
			,ExtraField4=@Size2
			,ExtraField5=@ProductName
			,ExtraField6=@ItemClassCode
			,ExtraField7=@MerchSubGroup
			,ExtraField8=@MerchSubGroupName
			,ExtraField9=@ColorName
			, UnitID= '01'
			where GoodsID=@GoodsID
	
			select @GoodsName=GoodsName 
			from inv.tblGoodsDtl  
			where GoodsID=@GoodsID
			 and LanguageID=1
		end

	else

		begin
		--print '(select count(*) from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID=@GoodsID)=0'
				
	----------------insert Goods ----------------------------------------------------------------
	--print 'insert into inv.tblGoods ' 
		
			insert into inv.tblGoods (GoodsID,PartNumber,BarCode,TechnicalNo,ExtraField1,ExtraField2,ExtraField3,ExtraField4,ExtraField5,ExtraField6,ExtraField7,ExtraField8,ExtraField9, UnitID)
			select					 @GoodsID,	1,@BarCode,@ItemID,@SpecialCode,@Color,@Size,@Size2,@ProductName,@ItemClassCode,@MerchSubGroup,@MerchSubGroupName, @ColorName,'01'
			
	--print '	insert into inv.tblGoodsDtl' 
			insert into inv.tblGoodsDtl (GoodsID,PartNumber,GoodsName,LanguageID)
			select @GoodsID,1,'N'+@GoodsName,1

		end
			
	----------------insert barcose ----------------------------------------------------------------
	
	if (SELECT     Count(*) FROM         inv.tblGoodsBarcodListHdr where GoodsID=@GoodsID)<1
		begin
			insert into    inv.tblGoodsBarcodListHdr(GoodsID, RecID, SessionNo)
			select @GoodsID,0,0
		end
		
	if (SELECT     Count(*) FROM         inv.tblGoodsBarcodListDtl where GoodsID=@GoodsID and BarCode=@BarCode )<1
	begin
	--print '	insert into inv.tblGoodsBarcodListDtl' 
			
		SELECT @cnt1=isnull( Max(RowNo),0) FROM         inv.tblGoodsBarcodListDtl where GoodsID=@GoodsID
		
		insert into inv.tblGoodsBarcodListDtl( GoodsID, RowNo, BarCode, DocRowNo)
		select  @GoodsID,@cnt1+1,@BarCode,@cnt1+1
	
	end	
	-------------insert Price -------------------------------------------------------------------
	
		Declare @SaleTypeID as Varchar(20)
		
		Select @SaleTypeID=SettingValue from pub.tblSettings Where SettingKey='PosSaleType'
	
		delete FROM   sal.tblGoodsPricesDtl  where GoodsID=@GoodsID-- and SaleTypeID=@SaleTypeID		
	--print '	insert into  sal.tblGoodsPricesDtl' 
		
		insert into  sal.tblGoodsPricesDtl(GoodsID, RowNo, DocRowNo,  SalePrice,UserPrice, SaleTypeID ,Coefficient,DefaultSalePriceTypeID,SalePriceTypeID)
		select @GoodsID,1,1,@FirstPriceWithVAT,@PriceWithVAT,@SaleTypeID,@VATRate,1,1
	
	----------set CodeClosed ----------------------------------------------------------------------

	   if @IsSaleBlocked= 1
	   	   update inv.tblGoods	set CodeClosed=@IsSaleBlocked  where GoodsID=@GoodsID
		--print 'End'
Fetch NEXT From Cursor_Rec Into  @GoodsID,@Color,@ColorName,@Size,@Size2,@GoodsName, @ProductName, @SpecialCode, @ItemClassCode, @MerchSubGroup
, @MerchSubGroupName, @ItemID	, @BarCode, @FirstPriceWithVAT, @VATRate, @PriceWithVAT	, @IsSaleBlocked

End

Close Cursor_Rec;
Deallocate Cursor_Rec; 

select 2
 
-- set @StrSelect = 'select *  from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Item 
--where  ItemID in( select ItemID From #Items )
--'
--print @StrSelect;
--exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

  ----delete  All Date -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set @StrSelect = 'delete  from Item 
where  ItemID in( select ItemID From #Items )
'
print @StrSelect;
exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

set @StrSelect = 'delete  from Product 
where  ProductID not in (select ProductID from  Item  )
'
print @StrSelect;
exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


if (select count(*) from Item )=0
begin

	if not exists (select * from sys.tables where name ='Product')
	begin
		set @StrSelect = ' Select ProductID, ProductName, SpecialCode, ItemClass, ItemClassCode, MerchSubGroup, MerchSubGroupName, IsDeleted  into Product from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Product  where 0=1'
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
	end 
	if not exists (select * from sys.tables where name ='Item')
	begin
		set @StrSelect = 'Select ItemID, ProductID, Barcode, Color, ColorName, Size, Size2, FirstPriceWithVAT, VATRate, 
							PriceWithVAT, IsDeleted, IsSaleBlocked, FirstPriceWithVAT_2, PriceWithVAT_2, ItemSKULevelRef
							into Item from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Item where 0=1'
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
	end 


		set @StrSelect = ' insert into Product (ProductID, ProductName, SpecialCode, ItemClass, ItemClassCode, MerchSubGroup, MerchSubGroupName, IsDeleted)
		 Select ProductID, ProductName, SpecialCode, ItemClass, ItemClassCode, MerchSubGroup, MerchSubGroupName, IsDeleted  from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Product '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		
		
		set @StrSelect = ' insert into Item (ItemID, ProductID, Barcode, Color, ColorName, Size, Size2, FirstPriceWithVAT, VATRate, PriceWithVAT, IsDeleted, IsSaleBlocked, FirstPriceWithVAT_2, PriceWithVAT_2, ItemSKULevelRef)
								Select ItemID, ProductID, Barcode, Color, ColorName, Size, Size2, FirstPriceWithVAT, VATRate, PriceWithVAT, IsDeleted, IsSaleBlocked, FirstPriceWithVAT_2, PriceWithVAT_2, 
									ItemSKULevelRef  from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Item '
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		----------------------------------------------------------
		
		set @StrSelect = ' delete  from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Item '-- where ProductID in ( Select * from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Product)'
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		

		set @StrSelect = ' delete  from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Product '-- where ProductID in ( Select * from Product)'
		print @StrSelect;
		exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;
		
	
end


end

-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================

CREATE procedure pub.SpLcWikikiProduct
 @ExtraParams nvarchar(1000) --COLLATE Arabic_CS_AS--SQL_Latin1_General_CP1254_CI_AS
as
begin

declare @ServerName		nvarchar(50)
declare @DBName			nvarchar(50)
declare @UserName		nvarchar(50)
declare @Pass			nvarchar(50)
declare @GoodsID		varchar(20)
declare @ExtraField1	nvarchar(200)
declare @ExtraField2	nvarchar(200)
declare @GoodsName		nvarchar(200)

 SET @ServerName	= LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 1)); 
 SET @DBName	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 2)); 
 SET @UserName	    = LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 3)); 
 SET @Pass			= LTrim(pub.funSplitString(@ExtraParams, '@', 4)); 


DECLARE @StrSelect	NVarChar(max)
return
--  Create temp  Table----------------------------------------------------
	select a.GoodsID,a.ExtraField1,a.ExtraField2 ,b.GoodsName
		into #Prods
	from  inv.tblGoods a 
	inner join inv.tblGoodsDtl b 
	on a.GoodsID=b.GoodsID
	where 1=0
---  fill temp Table----------------------------------------------------

	set @StrSelect = 'insert into #Prods select SpecialCode,ItemClass, MerchSubGroup,  ProductName from ['+@ServerName+'].['+@DBName+'].dbo.Product where IsDeleted=0'
	print @StrSelect;
	exec sp_executesql @StrSelect;

-- read from Temp Table and Insert or update inv.tblGoods----------------------------------------------------
	--select * from #Prods 

Declare	Cursor_Rec CURSOR For 
    select * from #Prods 

Open  Cursor_Rec; 

Fetch NEXT From Cursor_Rec Into @GoodsID,@ExtraField1,@ExtraField2,@GoodsName

While (@@Fetch_Status = 0)
BEGIN

	set @GoodsID=ltrim(rtrim(@GoodsID))
	set @GoodsID=pub.funPadLeft(@GoodsID,'0',5)

	if (select count(*) from inv.tblGoods where GoodsID=@GoodsID)>0
	begin
		update inv.tblGoods 
			set ExtraField1='N'+@ExtraField1,ExtraField2='N'+@ExtraField2
		where GoodsID=@GoodsID
		
		update inv.tblGoodsDtl 
			set GoodsName='N'+@GoodsName
		where GoodsID=@GoodsID		 and LanguageID=1
	end
	else
	begin
		insert into inv.tblGoods (GoodsID,PartNumber,ExtraField1,ExtraField2,UnitID)
		select @GoodsID,1,'N'+@ExtraField1,'N'+@ExtraField2,'01'

		insert into inv.tblGoodsDtl (GoodsID,PartNumber,GoodsName,LanguageID)
		select @GoodsID,1,'N'+@GoodsName,1

	end

Fetch NEXT From Cursor_Rec Into  @GoodsID,@ExtraField1,@ExtraField2,@GoodsName

End

Close Cursor_Rec;
Deallocate Cursor_Rec; 


 end

functions.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Ahmadnejad
-- Create Date   : 1387/10/31
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : 
-- Description	 : Returns ProcessName from ProcessID given
-- ==============================================
 
Create FUNCTION pub.funGetProcessName
(
	@ProcessID	Int,
	@ProcessNo	Int,
	@LanguageID	TinyInt
)
RETURNS NVarChar(100)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @StrResult NVarChar(100)
	SET @StrResult = ''

	select top 1  @StrResult= isnull(ProcessName, '') from pub.tblProcess where ProcessID =@ProcessID and ProcessNo =@ProcessNo 

	--SELECT @StrResult = 
	--	CASE @ProcessID
	--		WHEN    0  THEN  'بدون مرجع'
	--		WHEN    1  THEN  'دريافت صندوق'
	--		WHEN    2  THEN  'پرداخت صندوق'
	--		WHEN    3  THEN  'دريافت متفرقه'
	--		WHEN    4  THEN  'پرداخت متفرقه'
	--		WHEN    5  THEN  'تنخواه'
	--		WHEN    6  THEN  'هزينه بانکي'
	--		WHEN    7  THEN  'دريافت وام'
	--		WHEN    8  THEN  'پرداخت اقساط وام'
	--		WHEN   10  THEN  'دريافت چک (اول دوره)'
	--		WHEN   12  THEN  'وصول چک'
	--		WHEN   13  THEN  'برگشت چک'
	--		WHEN   17  THEN  'برگشت چک واگذاري به اشخاص  به  صندوق '
	--		WHEN   17  THEN  'برگشت چک واگذاري به اشخاص  به  صندوق Not Used'
	--		WHEN   18  THEN  'برگشت چک واگذاري به اشخاص به صاحب چک'
	--		WHEN   20  THEN  'واگذاري به بانکها (اول دوره)'
	--		WHEN   21  THEN  'واگذاري به بانکها'
	--		WHEN   22  THEN  'وصول چک واگذاري به بانکها'
	--		WHEN   23  THEN  'برگشت چک واگذاري به بانکها  به  صندوق'
	--		WHEN   24  THEN  'برگشت چک واگذاري به بانکها به صاحب چک'
	--		WHEN   25  THEN  'پرداخت اسناد پرداختني (اول دوره)'
	--		WHEN   27  THEN  'وصول اسناد پرداختني'
	--		WHEN   28  THEN  'برگشت اسناد پرداختني'
	--		WHEN   31  THEN  'چکهاي اماني ديگران نزد ما'
	--		WHEN   32  THEN  'استرداد چکهاي اماني ديگران نزد ما'
	--		WHEN   33  THEN  'چکهاي اماني ما نزد ديگران'

Create FUNCTION pub.funGetProcessNameWithProcessNo
(
	@ProcessID	Int,
	@ProcessNo	Int
)
RETURNS NVarChar(100)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @StrResult NVarChar(100)
	SET @StrResult = ''

	select top 1  @StrResult= isnull(ProcessName, '') from pub.tblProcess where ProcessID =@ProcessID  and ProcessNo =@ProcessNo 

	RETURN @StrResult
END

functions.name: funChangeDate_GergorianToPersian
functions.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\M.Jafari
-- Creation date : 1393/10/04
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Last Modifier : 
-- Description	 : 
-- =======================================
Create FUNCTION [pub].[funChangeDate_GergorianToPersian]

(
	@MDate DateTime
)  

RETURNS Varchar(10)
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE

	@Year Integer,

	@Month Integer,

	@Day Integer,

	@F_Year Integer,

	@F_Month Integer,

	@F_Day Integer,

	@F_Day_Name Varchar(10),

	@F_Month_Name Varchar(10),

	@LastDay Integer,

	@Plus Integer,

	@Minus Integer,

	@Intercalary Integer,

	@S_Year Varchar(5),

	@S_Month Varchar(5),

	@S_Day Varchar(5),

	@E_Date Varchar(20),

	@Ret int,

	@FarsiFormattedDate Varchar(20)

	Set @Plus = 0

	Set @Year = Year(@MDate)

	Set @Month = Month(@MDate)

	Set @Day = Day(@MDate)

	-----

	Set @S_Year = Cast(@Year AS VarChar(5))

	Set @S_Month = Cast(@Month AS VarChar(5))

	Set @S_Day = Cast(@Day AS VarChar(5))

	IF Len(@S_Month) < 2

	Set @S_Month = '0'+@S_Month

	IF Len(@S_Day) < 2

	Set @S_Day = '0'+@S_Day

	Set @E_Date = @S_Year + @S_Month + @S_Day

	-----

	-----

	Set @F_Day_Name = Case DATEPART(dw, Getdate())

	When 1 Then ''

	When 2 Then ''

	When 3 Then ' '

	When 4 Then ''

	When 5 Then ''

	When 6 Then ''

	When 7 Then ''

	End

	-----

	IF ((@Month = 1) or (@Month = 5) or (@Month = 6))

	Set @Plus = 10

	IF ((@Month = 2) or (@Month = 4))

	Set @Plus = 11

	IF ((@Month = 3) or (@Month = 7) or (@Month = 8) or

	(@Month = 9) or (@Month = 11) or (@Month = 12))

	Set @Plus = 9

	IF (@Month = 10)

	Set @Plus = 8

	Set @Year = @Year % 100

	Set @Intercalary = @Year

	IF (@Intercalary % 4 = 0)

	IF (@Month > 2)

	Set @Plus = @Plus + 1

	IF ((@Intercalary - 1) % 4 = 0)

	begin

	Set @LastDay = 30

	IF (@Month <= 3)

	Set @Plus = @Plus + 1

	end

	Else

	Set @LastDay = 29

	Set @F_Year = @Year - 22

	IF (@F_Year < 0) AND CONVERT(varchar,@MDate,23)<='2021-03-20'

	Set @F_Year = @F_Year + 100
	
	Set @F_Month = @Month + 9

	IF (@F_Month > 12)

	begin

	Set @F_Month = @F_Month - 12

	Set @F_Year = @F_Year + 1

	end

	Set @F_Day = @Day + @Plus

	IF (@F_Month <= 6)

	Set @Minus = 31

	Else

	IF ((@F_Month > 6) and (@F_Month<12))

	Set @Minus = 30

	Else

	Set @Minus = @LastDay

	IF (@F_Day > @Minus)

	begin

	Set @F_Day = @F_Day - @Minus;

	Set @F_Month = @F_Month + 1

	end

	IF (@F_Month > 12)

	begin

	Set @F_Month = @F_Month - 12;

	Set @F_Year = @F_Year + 1

	end;

	Set @Ret = @F_Year

	IF CONVERT(varchar,@MDate,23)>'2021-03-20'
		Set @FarsiFormattedDate =1400 + @Ret
	ELSE
		Set @FarsiFormattedDate =1300 + @Ret

	IF @F_Month >= 10

	begin

	Set @Ret = @Ret + Cast(@F_Month As Varchar(4))

	Set @FarsiFormattedDate =@FarsiFormattedDate+'/'+Cast(@F_Month As Varchar(4))

	end

	Else

	begin

	Set @FarsiFormattedDate =@FarsiFormattedDate+'/0'+ Cast(@F_Month As Varchar(4))

	Set @Ret = @Ret +'0'+ Cast(@F_Month As Varchar(4))

	end

	-----

	Set @F_Month_Name = Case @F_Month

	When 1 Then ''

	When 2 Then ''

	When 3 Then ''

	When 4 Then ''

	When 5 Then ''

	When 6 Then ''

	When 7 Then ''

	When 8 Then ''

	When 9 Then ''

	When 10 Then ''

	When 11 Then ''

	When 12 Then ''

	End

	-----

	IF @F_Day >= 10

	begin

	set @FarsiFormattedDate=@FarsiFormattedDate+'/'+Cast(@F_Day As Varchar(4))

	Set @Ret = @Ret + Cast(@F_Day As Varchar(4))

	end

	Else

	begin

	Set @Ret = @Ret + '0'+ Cast(@F_Day As Varchar(4))

	set @FarsiFormattedDate=@FarsiFormattedDate+'/0'+ Cast(@F_Day As Varchar(4))

	end

RETURN @FarsiFormattedDate 

END

functions.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\M.Jafari
-- Creation date : 1393/10/04

-- Description	 : 
-- =======================================
CREATE FUNCTION [pub].[funChangeDate_PersianToGergorian]

(
	@DateStr VarChar(10)
)

RETURNS VarChar(10)
AS  
BEGIN 
   declare @YYear int
   declare @MMonth int
   declare @DDay int
   declare @epbase int
   declare @epyear int
   declare @mdays int
   declare @persian_jdn int
   declare @i int
   declare @j int
   declare @l int
   declare @n int
   declare @TMPRESULT varchar(10)
   declare @IsValideDate int
   declare @TempStr varchar(20)
   DECLARE @TmpDateStr varchar(10)
   Declare @StrMonth Varchar(2)
   Declare @StrDay Varchar(2)
   
   Set @StrMonth = ''
   Set @StrDay = ''
   
   SET @i=charindex('/',@DateStr)

   IF LEN(@DateStr) - CHARINDEX('/', @DateStr,CHARINDEX('/', @DateStr,1)+1) = 4
   BEGIN
     SET @TmpDateStr = dbo.ReversDate(@DateStr)
     IF ( ISDATE(@TmpDateStr) =1 )  
       RETURN @TmpDateStr
     ELSE
        RETURN NULL
   END
   ELSE
     SET @TmpDateStr = @DateStr

   IF ((@i<>0) and
       
        (ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(@TmpDateStr,'/',''))=1) and 
        (charindex('.',@TmpDateStr)=0)
       )
   BEGIN
	   SET @YYear=CAST(SUBSTRING(@TmpDateStr,1,@i-1) AS INT)
                IF ( @YYear< 1300 )
                      SET @YYear =@YYear + 1300
                IF @YYear > 9999
                  RETURN NULL
	
	   SET @TempStr= SUBSTRING(@TmpDateStr,@i+1,Len(@TmpDateStr))
	
	   SET @i=charindex('/',@TempStr)
	   SET @MMonth=CAST(SUBSTRING(@TempStr,1,@i-1) AS INT)
	   SET @MMonth=@MMonth-- -1
	   
	   SET @TempStr= SUBSTRING(@TempStr,@i+1,Len(@TempStr))   
	
	   SET @DDay=CAST(@TempStr AS INT)
	   SET @DDay=@DDay-- - 1
	       
                 IF ( @YYear >= 0 )
                     SET @epbase = @YYear - 474
                 Else
                     SET @epbase = @YYear - 473
                 SET @epyear = 474 + (@epbase % 2820)

	    IF (@MMonth <= 7 )
                       SET @mdays = ((@MMonth) - 1) * 31
	    Else
	        SET @mdays = ((@MMonth) - 1) * 30 + 6

	    SET @persian_jdn =(@DDay)  + @mdays + CAST((((@epyear * 682) - 110) / 2816) as int)  + (@epyear - 1) * 365  +  CAST((@epbase / 2820)  as int ) * 1029983  + (1948321 - 1)



	    IF (@persian_jdn > 2299160) 
                 BEGIN
	        SET @l = @persian_jdn + 68569
	        SET @n = CAST(((4 * @l) / 146097) as int)
	        SET @l = @l -  CAST(((146097 * @n + 3) / 4) as int)
	        SET @i =  CAST(((4000 * (@l + 1)) / 1461001) as int)
	        SET @l = @l - CAST( ((1461 * @i) / 4) as int) + 31
	        SET @j =  CAST(((80 * @l) / 2447) as int)
	        SET @DDay = @l - CAST( ((2447 * @j) / 80) as int)
	         SET @l =  CAST((@j / 11) as int)
	        SET @MMonth = @j + 2 - 12 * @l
	        SET @YYear = 100 * (@n - 49) + @i + @l
                 END
		   
		   IF Len(Cast(@MMonth as Varchar(2))) = 1
			  Set @StrMonth = '0' + Cast(@MMonth as Varchar(2))
		   Else
			  Set @StrMonth = Cast(@MMonth as Varchar(2))
			  
		   IF Len(Cast(@DDay as Varchar(2))) = 1
			  Set @StrDay = '0' + Cast(@DDay as Varchar(2))		
		   Else
			  Set @StrDay = Cast(@DDay as Varchar(2))
			  
           SET @TMPRESULT = Cast(@YYear as Varchar(4)) + '/' + @StrMonth + '/' + @StrDay
           
           --SET @TMPRESULT=Cast(@YYear as Varchar(4)) + '/' + Cast(@MMonth as Varchar(2)) + '/' + Cast(@DDay as Varchar(2))
           
           RETURN @TMPRESULT

    END
    RETURN NULL      

END

Create FUNCTION pub.funMonthName
(
	@month varchar(2)
)

RETURNS NVarChar(10)
AS  
BEGIN 

	DECLARE @MonthName NVarChar(10)
	SELECT @MonthName=case 
							when @month='1' OR @month='01' then 'فروردین'
							when @month='2' OR @month='02' then 'اردیبهشت' 
							when @month='3' OR @month='03'  then 'خرداد'
							when @month='4' OR @month='04'  then 'تیر'
							when @month='5' OR @month='05'  then 'مرداد'
							when @month='6' OR @month='06'  then 'شهریور'
							when @month='7' OR @month='07'  then 'مهر'
							when @month='8' OR @month='08'  then 'آبان'
							when @month='9' OR @month='09'  then 'آذر'
							when @month='10'				then 'دی'
							when @month='11'				then 'بهمن'
							when @month='12'				then 'اسفند'
							ELSE ''
						  END
	RETURN @MonthName
END

views.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================
-- Author		 : TakroSystem\Zia

-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 1390/03/02
-- Last Modifier : TakroSystem\Zia
-- Description	 : 
-- ==============================================
Create VIEW [sal].[vwPreSaleHdr_Currency]
AS

SELECT M.* ,0-[Discount]-[Discount2]-[TotalLineDiscount]-[OtherCost]-[TransportationCost]+[OtherIncome]+[TransportationIncome]+[PackingCost]+[TaxCost]+[TaxOverWorthCost]+[TollOverWorthCost] AS SidePriceSum
FROM
(
	SELECT H.ProcessID, 
		   H.ProcessNo, 
		   H.FiscalYear, 
		   H.SerialNo, 
		   H.DocStep, 
		   H.DocDate, 
		   H.StoreID, 
		   H.AcntCode, 
		   H.VisitorAcntCode, 
		   H.VisitorAcntCode2, 
		   CurrencyTypeID, 
		   CurrencyRate, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * (SUM(D.MainAmount * GoodsQuantity) - H.TransportationCost + H.TransportationIncome - 
																		 H.OtherCost + H.OtherIncome + H.PackingCost + H.TaxCost +
																		 H.TaxOverWorthCost + H.TollOverWorthCost - H.Discount - 
																		 H.Discount2 - (SUM(D.Discount) + SUM(D.Discount2))) Amount, 
		   H.DiscountPercent,
		   H.DiscountPercent2, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * H.Discount Discount, 
		   pub.GetCodeName(H.AcntCode, 1) AS AcntName,
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * H.Discount2 Discount2, 
		   H.IsSubUnit, 
		   H.DocTime,
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * (SUM(D.Discount) + SUM(D.Discount2)) TotalLineDiscount, 
		   H.VchNo, 
		   H.DocDesc,
		   H.DocDesc2,
		   H.AgreeNo, 
		   H.RecID, 
		   H.SessionNo,
		   H.SessionNo2, 
		   H.SaleTypeID, 
		   H.TransporterID,
		   H.LocationID, 
		   H.ConfirmState,
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * TransportationCost TransportationCost, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * PackingCost PackingCost, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * TaxCost TaxCost, 
		   H.VisitorPercent, 
		   H.VisitorPercent2, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * VisitorCost VisitorCost,
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * VisitorCost2 VisitorCost2,
		   TransportationCostAcntCode, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * (SUM(D.MainAmount*GoodsQuantity)) Price, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * TaxOverWorthCost TaxOverWorthCost, 
		   H.TransportationIncomeAcntCode, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * TransportationIncome TransportationIncome, 
		   OtherCostAcntCode, 
		   OtherIncomeAcntCode,
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * OtherCost OtherCost, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * OtherIncome OtherIncome, 
		   H.OldSerialNo, 
		   CASE WHEN (CurrencyRate=0) THEN 0 ELSE (1/CurrencyRate) END * TollOverWorthCost TollOverWorthCost,
		   Cast(Null As Image) GoodsDocHdr, 
		   Cast(Null As Image) DocHdr,
		   H.SgnSN1,
		   H.SgnSN2,
		   H.SgnSN3,
		   H.SgnSN4,
		   H.SgnSN5,
		   EarnestMoney,
		   EarnestMoneyPercent,
		   EarnestMoneyAcntCode,
		   H.DescRetSaleID,
		   VchDate,
		   TransportationKindID,
		   GoodsReciverID,
		   CurrencyDiscount,
		   H.CurrencyTransportationCost,
		   H.CurrencyTransportationIncome,
		   H.PreSaleExpireDate
	FROM inv.tblPreSaleHdr H
	INNER JOIN inv.tblPreSaleDtl D ON H.ProcessID = D.ProcessID 
								  AND H.ProcessNo = D.ProcessNo 
								  AND H.FiscalYear = D.FiscalYear 
								  AND H.SerialNo = D.SerialNo
	GROUP BY H.ProcessID, H.ProcessNo, H.FiscalYear, H.SerialNo, H.DocStep, H.DocDate, H.StoreID, H.AcntCode, H.VisitorAcntCode, H.VisitorAcntCode2,
			 H.CurrencyTypeID,H.CurrencyRate,H.TransportationCost,H.TransportationIncome,H.OtherCost,H.OtherIncome,H.PackingCost,H.TaxCost,
			 H.TaxOverWorthCost,H.TollOverWorthCost,H.Discount,H.Discount2,H.DiscountPercent,H.DiscountPercent2,H.VchNo,H.DocDesc,H.DocDesc2,H.AgreeNo,H.RecID,H.SessionNo,H.SessionNo2,H.SaleTypeID,
			 H.TransporterID,H.LocationID,H.VisitorPercent,H.VisitorPercent2,H.VisitorCost,H.VisitorCost2,H.TransportationCostAcntCode,
			 H.TransportationIncomeAcntCode,H.OtherCostAcntCode,H.OtherIncomeAcntCode,H.OldSerialNo, H.IsSubUnit, H.DocTime, H.ConfirmState,
			 H.SgnSN1,H.SgnSN2,H.SgnSN3,H.SgnSN4,H.SgnSN5,EarnestMoney,EarnestMoneyPercent,EarnestMoneyAcntCode,H.DescRetSaleID,VchDate,TransportationKindID,GoodsReciverID,CurrencyDiscount,
		     H.CurrencyTransportationCost, H.CurrencyTransportationIncome, H.PreSaleExpireDate
) M

-- =============================================
-- Author        : h.ahmadnejad
-- Create date   : 1402/03/16
-- Viewed By	 : 
-- Last Modified : 
-- Description   : 
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE sal.sp_api_CreateSaleOrderDtl
	@ProcessNo				int, 
	@FiscalYear				int, 
	@SerialNo				int, 
	@DocStep				int, 
	@DocDate				nvarchar(20),
	@DescDtl				nvarchar(2000),
	@StoreID				nvarchar(20),
	@AcntCode				nvarchar(20),
	@GoodsID				nvarchar(20),
	@GoodsQuantity			float,
	@GoodsPrice				float,
	@DiscountPercent		float,
	@Discount				float,	
	@TaxOverWorthCostDtl	float,
	@TollOverWorthCostDtl	float,	
	@SaleTypeID				nvarchar(20)

-- WITH ENCRYPTION
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @AcntCodePart1	nvarchar(20)
	DECLARE @UnitID			nvarchar(20)
	DECLARE @MaxRowNo		int
	DECLARE @StrErrorMessage nvarchar(1024)
BEGIN TRY
	-- check sale type ==============================================================================================================

	if (@SaleTypeID is null) or (@SaleTypeID = '')
	begin
		select @SaleTypeID = SettingValue
		from pub.tblSettings
		where SettingKey='OnlineSaleType'
	end
	
	IF (@SaleTypeID is null) or (@SaleTypeID = '')
	BEGIN
		Set @StrErrorMessage = N'در تنظیمات برنامه تکروسیستم در بخش فروشگاه آنلاین، نوع فروش را مقداردهی کنید'
		raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)
	END

	IF (SELECT Count(*) FROM sal.tblSaleTypes where SaleTypeID=@SaleTypeID) = 0
	BEGIN
		Set @StrErrorMessage = N'در تنظیمات برنامه تکروسیستم در بخش فروشگاه آنلاین، مقدار نوع فروش صحیح نیست'
		raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)
	END	

	-- check goods id ==============================================================================================================

	IF (SELECT Count(*) FROM inv.tblGoods where GoodsID = @GoodsID) <> 1
	BEGIN
		Set @StrErrorMessage = N'کد کالا صحیح نیست'
		raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)
	END	

	-- check store id ==============================================================================================================

	if (@StoreID is null) or (@StoreID = '')
	begin
		select @StoreID = SettingValue
		from pub.tblSettings
		where SettingKey='OnlineStoreID'
	end	

	IF (@StoreID is null) or (@StoreID = '')
	BEGIN
		Set @StrErrorMessage = N'در تنظیمات برنامه تکروسیستم در بخش فروشگاه آنلاین، انبار را مقداردهی کنید'
		raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)
	END
	
	IF (SELECT Count(*) FROM inv.tblStores where StoreID=@StoreID) = 0
	BEGIN
		Set @StrErrorMessage = N'در تنظیمات برنامه تکروسیستم در بخش فروشگاه آنلاین، مقدار انبار صحیح نیست'
		raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)
	END	

	-- check acnt code ==============================================================================================================
	
	SELECT @AcntCodePart1 = LTrim(RTrim(SettingValue))
	FROM pub.tblSettings 
	WHERE SettingKey = 'OnlineCustomer'

	IF (@AcntCodePart1 is null) or (@AcntCodePart1 = '')
	BEGIN
		Set @StrErrorMessage = N'در تنظیمات برنامه تکروسیستم در بخش فروشگاه آنلاین، کد حسابداری مشتری (فقط معین) را مقداردهی کنید'
		raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)
	END

	-- init ==============================================================================================================
	if @AcntCodePart1  <> substring( @AcntCode ,1,len(@AcntCodePart1))
		SET @AcntCode = @AcntCodePart1 + ' ' + @AcntCode

	SELECT @UnitID = UnitID FROM inv.tblGoods WHERE GoodsID=@GoodsID

	SELECT @MaxRowNo = isnull(MAX(RowNo), 0)
	FROM sal.tblSaleOrderDtl
	WHERE ProcessID=180
	  AND ProcessNo=@ProcessNo
	  AND FiscalYear=@FiscalYear
	  AND SerialNo=@SerialNo
			 
	SET @MaxRowNo = @MaxRowNo + 1

	-- save ==============================================================================================================

	INSERT INTO sal.tblSaleOrderDtl(
			ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo, RowNo, DocRowNo, DocDate, DocStep, InOutWithServiceType,
			StoreID, AcntCode, GoodsID, GoodsQuantity, SubUnitQuantity, ConfirmQuantity, GoodsPrice, SubUnitPrice, GoodsPriceWithTax, SubUnitID,
			DiscountPercentDtl, DiscountDtl, DescDtl, SaleTypeID, TaxOverWorthCostDtl, TollOverWorthCostDtl)
	SELECT	180 ProcessID, @ProcessNo, @FiscalYear, @SerialNo, @MaxRowNo, @MaxRowNo, @DocDate, @DocStep, 1 InOutWithServiceType,
			@StoreID, @AcntCode, @GoodsID, @GoodsQuantity, @GoodsQuantity, @GoodsQuantity, @GoodsPrice, @GoodsPrice, @GoodsPrice, @UnitID,
			@DiscountPercent, @Discount, @DescDtl, @SaleTypeID, @TaxOverWorthCostDtl, @TollOverWorthCostDtl

	select 180 ProcessID, @ProcessNo ProcessNo, @FiscalYear FiscalYear, @SerialNo SerialNo, @MaxRowNo RowNo
    
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH

	Set @StrErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() 
	raiserror (@StrErrorMessage, 16, 1)

END CATCH

END	

-- Go

-------------------تعداد فاکتور    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 select @Price=isnull(count(*),0) from #STDH d
 where  d.ProcessID=90
 and d.DocStep<90

  -------------------تعداد اقلام    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 select @Price=isnull(Sum(d.GoodsQuantity),0) 
 from #STDH h
 inner join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl d
 on  d.ProcessID=h.ProcessID 
	 and d.ProcessNo=h.ProcessNo
	 and d.FiscalYear=h.FiscalYear
	 and d.SerialNo=h.SerialNo
 where  d.ProcessID=90
 and h.DocStep<90

 Update #SaleRetLcW  Set P2=@Price

-------------------مبلغ فاکتور    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Declare @Tax float 
Declare @Toll float 
select @Tax=SettingValue from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey ='TaxOverWorthPercentInSale'
select @Toll=SettingValue from pub.tblSettings where SettingKey ='TollOverWorthPercentInSale'
 
select @Price2=isnull(Sum(Price -(Discount+ Discount2+ Discount3+ TotalLineDiscount) ),0) 
from #STDH 
where  ProcessID=90
 and DocStep<90
 
 declare @Dis float
 select @Dis=isnull(Sum((Discount+ Discount2+ Discount3+ TotalLineDiscount) ),0) 
from #STDH 
where  ProcessID=90
 and DocStep<90
 
 set @Price=(@Price2*100/(100+@Tax+@Toll)) + @Dis

 Update #SaleRetLcW  Set P3=@Price

if @PayType=1  
begin
	
	DECLARE cur1 CURSOR FOR 

	select Distinct  BankTypeID from  trs.tblOurBanks
	where BankState=3 and AcntCode1<>''

	set @Price2=31

	open cur1 
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @AcntCode

	while @@Fetch_Status = 0
		BEGIN
			select  top 1 @BankName=BankTypeName 
			from     trs.tblBankTypesDtl
			where LanguageID=1 and  BankTypeID =@AcntCode
 
			select @Price= isnull(Sum(b.Amount),0) --, o.AcntCode1
			from trs.tblPayHdr a 
			inner join  trs.tblPayDtl b
			on  a.ProcessID=b.ProcessID 
				and a.ProcessNo=b.ProcessNo
				and a.FiscalYear=b.FiscalYear
				and a.SerialNo=b.SerialNo
				and a.ProcessID=1
			inner join  #STDH S
				on  a.BaseProcessID=S.ProcessID 
				and a.BaseProcessNo=S.ProcessNo
				and a.BaseFiscalYear=S.FiscalYear
				and a.BaseSerialNo=S.SerialNo
				and S.DocStep<90
				And b.PayTypeID=35
			 inner join  trs.tblOurBanks  o
			 on o.BankCode=b.DebitCode
			where    o.BankTypeID =@AcntCode

			if @Price>0
			begin
				SET @StrSelect1 = 'Update #SaleRetLcW Set  K'+ltrim(rtrim(str(@Price2)))+'= '''+ @BankName+ ''',P'+ltrim(rtrim(str(@Price2)))+'='+ ltrim(rtrim(str(@Price,20)))
				PRINT @StrSelect1
				Exec sp_executesql @StrSelect1;	
				set @Price2=@Price2+1
			end 
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @AcntCode
		end 
		CLOSE cur1
		DEALLOCATE cur1
end

				And b.PayTypeID=35

			if @Price>0

		set @Serials2=@Serials2+ ',' + ltrim(rtrim( str(@SerialNo)))

	FETCH NEXT FROM cur1 INTO @SerialNo,@DocStep
	end 
	
	CLOSE cur1
	DEALLOCATE cur1

	if len(@Serials1)>1
		set @Serials1=substring (@Serials1,2, len(@Serials1)-1)
	if len(@Serials2)>1
		set @Serials2=substring (@Serials2,2, len(@Serials2)-1)

  -------------------هزینه حمل    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 select @Price=isnull(Sum(TransportationIncome ),0) 
from #STDH 
where  ProcessID=90
 and DocStep<90
 Update #SaleRetLcW  Set TransportationIncome=@Price
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
  select * from #SaleRetLcW
 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
end

CREATE PROCEDURE sal.GetSaleOrderSummary
(
      @FromDate NVARCHAR(10)
    , @ToDate   NVARCHAR(10)
    , @Customer NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
    , @GoodsID  INT = NULL
    , @OnlyOpen BIT = 0
    , @OrderNo  INT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

        SELECT
              hdr.SerialNo AS OrderNo
            , hdr.AcntCode AS CustomerCode
            , hdr.DocDate  AS OrderDate
            , g.GoodsName

            , dtl.GoodsQuantity AS OrderQty
            , dtl.GoodsPrice    AS OrderAmount
            , dtl.GoodsQuantity * dtl.GoodsPrice AS OrderGrossAmount

            , ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0) AS SellQty
            , ISNULL(s.GoodsPrice, 0) AS SellAmount
            , ISNULL(s.SellGrossAmount, 0) AS SellGrossAmount
            , ISNULL(s.CurrencyAmount, 0) AS SellCurrencyAmount
            , ISNULL(s.CurrencyAmount, 0) * ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0) AS SellCurrencyGrossAmount

            , (ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0) - dtl.GoodsQuantity) AS RemainQty
            , (ISNULL(s.CurrencyAmount, 0) * ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0))
              - (dtl.GoodsQuantity * dtl.GoodsPrice) AS RemainAmount

        FROM sal.tblSaleOrderHdr hdr
        JOIN sal.tblSaleOrderDtl dtl
              ON hdr.ProcessID  = dtl.ProcessID
             AND hdr.ProcessNo  = dtl.ProcessNo
             AND hdr.FiscalYear = dtl.FiscalYear
             AND hdr.SerialNo   = dtl.SerialNo

        LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl g
             ON g.GoodsID = dtl.GoodsID

        OUTER APPLY (
            SELECT 
                  SUM(sd.GoodsQuantity) AS SellQty
                , SUM(sd.GoodsPrice)    AS GoodsPrice
                , SUM(sd.CurrencyAmount) AS CurrencyAmount
                , SUM(sd.GoodsPrice * sd.GoodsQuantity) AS SellGrossAmount
            FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr sh
            JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl sd
                  ON sd.ProcessID   = sh.ProcessID
                 AND sd.ProcessNo   = sh.ProcessNo
                 AND sd.FiscalYear  = sh.FiscalYear
                 AND sd.SerialNo    = sh.SerialNo
                 AND sd.BaseDocRowNo = dtl.RowNo
            WHERE sh.BaseProcessID  = hdr.ProcessID
              AND sh.BaseProcessNo  = hdr.ProcessNo
              AND sh.BaseFiscalYear = hdr.FiscalYear
              AND sh.BaseSerialNo   = hdr.SerialNo
        ) s

        WHERE hdr.ProcessID = 180
          AND hdr.FiscalYear = 1404
          AND hdr.DocDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate

          AND (@Customer IS NULL OR hdr.AcntCode = @Customer)
          AND (@GoodsID  IS NULL OR dtl.GoodsID = @GoodsID)
          AND (@OrderNo  IS NULL OR hdr.SerialNo = @OrderNo)

          AND (@OnlyOpen = 0 OR (dtl.GoodsQuantity - ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0)) > 0);

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                @ErrLine INT = ERROR_LINE();

        RAISERROR('Error at line %d: %s', 16, 1, @ErrLine, @ErrMsg);
        RETURN;
    END CATCH

END

-- =============================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE sal.Rpt_Sale_Order_Analysis
(
      @StartDate NVARCHAR(10)    -- تاریخ شروع فیلتر سفارشات
    , @EndDate   NVARCHAR(10)    -- تاریخ پایان فیلتر سفارشات
    , @Customer NVARCHAR(50) = NULL   -- کد مشتری (اختیاری)
    , @GoodsID  INT = NULL      -- شناسه کالا (اختیاری)
    , @OnlyOpen BIT = 0         -- اگر 1 باشد فقط سفارشات باز نمایش داده می‌شود
    , @OrderNo  INT = NULL      -- شماره سفارش خاص (اختیاری)
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

        /***********************************************
            بخش اصلی انتخاب اطلاعات سفارش
        ***********************************************/
        SELECT
              hdr.SerialNo AS OrderNo           -- شماره سفارش
            , hdr.AcntCode AS CustomerCode      -- کد مشتری
            , acc.funGetAcntName(SubString(hdr.AcntCode, 7, 20), 2, 1) CustomerName
            , hdr.DocDate  AS OrderDate         -- تاریخ سفارش
            , g.GoodsName                       -- نام کالا
            , dtl.GoodsID
            , inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, hdr.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, dtl.GoodsID, Null, @EndDate, 0) AS Product_Remain
            , inv.funGetGoodsRemain(Null, Null, hdr.FiscalYear, Null, Null, Null, dtl.GoodsID, Null, @EndDate, 0) AS Selphon_Remain
            -- اطلاعات مقدار و مبلغ سفارش
            , dtl.GoodsQuantity AS OrderQty
            , dtl.GoodsPrice    AS OrderAmount
            , dtl.GoodsQuantity * dtl.GoodsPrice AS OrderGrossAmount

            -- اطلاعات فروش انجام شده
            , ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0) AS SellQty                   -- مقدار فروخته شده
            , ISNULL(s.GoodsPrice, 0) AS SellAmount             -- مبلغ فروش
            , ISNULL(s.SellGrossAmount, 0) AS SellGrossAmount   -- مبلغ فروش کل
            , ISNULL(s.CurrencyAmount, 0) AS SellCurrencyAmount -- مبلغ ارزی
            , ISNULL(s.CurrencyAmount, 0) * ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0) AS SellCurrencyGrossAmount  -- مبلغ فروش کل ارزی

            -- مانده سفارش
            , (ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0) - dtl.GoodsQuantity) AS RemainQty
            , (ISNULL(s.CurrencyAmount, 0) * ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0))
              - (dtl.GoodsQuantity * dtl.GoodsPrice) AS RemainAmount

        FROM sal.tblSaleOrderHdr hdr
        -- اتصال هدر سفارش به جزئیات سفارش
        JOIN sal.tblSaleOrderDtl dtl
              ON hdr.ProcessID  = dtl.ProcessID
             AND hdr.ProcessNo  = dtl.ProcessNo
             AND hdr.FiscalYear = dtl.FiscalYear
             AND hdr.SerialNo   = dtl.SerialNo

        -- اتصال به جدول کالا
        LEFT JOIN inv.tblGoodsDtl g
             ON g.GoodsID = dtl.GoodsID

        /**************************************************************
            OUTER APPLY:
            جمع مقدار تحویل شده و مبالغ فروش از اسناد انبار
            (StorageDocs) که به سفارش فعلی لینک شده‌اند.
        **************************************************************/
        OUTER APPLY (
            SELECT 
                  SUM(sd.GoodsQuantity) AS SellQty           -- مجموع مقدار فروش
                , SUM(sd.GoodsPrice)    AS GoodsPrice        -- قیمت فروش
                , SUM(sd.CurrencyAmount) AS CurrencyAmount    -- مبلغ ارزی
                , SUM(sd.GoodsPrice * sd.GoodsQuantity) AS SellGrossAmount -- مبلغ کل فروش
            FROM inv.tblStorageDocsHdr sh
            JOIN inv.tblStorageDocsDtl sd
                  ON sd.ProcessID   = sh.ProcessID
                 AND sd.ProcessNo   = sh.ProcessNo
                 AND sd.FiscalYear  = sh.FiscalYear
                 AND sd.SerialNo    = sh.SerialNo
                 AND sd.BaseDocRowNo = dtl.RowNo   -- اتصال رکورد جزئیات سفارش به رکورد فروش
            WHERE sh.BaseProcessID  = hdr.ProcessID
              AND sh.BaseProcessNo  = hdr.ProcessNo
              AND sh.BaseFiscalYear = hdr.FiscalYear
              AND sh.BaseSerialNo   = hdr.SerialNo
        ) s

        /***********************************************
            فیلترهای گزارش
        ***********************************************/
        WHERE hdr.ProcessID = 180            -- کد فرآیند سفارش فروش
          AND hdr.FiscalYear = 1404          -- سال مالی
          AND hdr.DocDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate   -- فیلتر بازه تاریخی

          -- فیلترهای اختیاری
          AND (@Customer IS NULL OR hdr.AcntCode = @Customer)
          AND (@GoodsID  IS NULL OR dtl.GoodsID = @GoodsID)
          AND (@OrderNo  IS NULL OR hdr.SerialNo = @OrderNo)

          -- فقط سفارشات باز اگر OnlyOpen = 1 باشد
          AND (@OnlyOpen = 0 OR (dtl.GoodsQuantity - ISNULL(s.SellQty, 0)) > 0);

    END TRY

    /***********************************************
        مدیریت خطا
    ***********************************************/
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                @ErrLine INT = ERROR_LINE();

        RAISERROR('Error at line %d: %s', 16, 1, @ErrLine, @ErrMsg);
        RETURN;
    END CATCH

END

-- =========== TS-QC:NOTOK =====================
-- Author        : Hadi Sadeghi
-- Create date   : 90/03/05 
-- Viewed By	 :

-- =============================================
Create PROCEDURE [sms].[RptSMS_SaleDocs]
	@AcntPartNo		int = 2,
	@AcntPartStart	int = 8,
	@AcntPartLen	int = 4,
	@SelectedAcnt1	Int = 0, -- بستانکار
	@SelectedAcnt2	Int = 0,
	@SelectedAcnt3	Int = 0,
	@SelectedAcnt4	Int = 0,
	@SerialFr		int = Null, 
	@SerialTo		int = Null, 
	@UsanceDateFr	Char(10) = Null, -- تاریخ سررسید از
	@UsanceDateTo	Char(10) = Null, --تاریخ سررسید تا
	@DocDateFr		Char(10) = Null, 
	@DocDateTo		Char(10) = Null, 
	@RepOptions		varchar(20)= '0',
	@RepInfo		NVarChar(100) = '1@1@1'
AS

DECLARE @StrWhere	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @StrWhereA	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @StrWhereT	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @Activator	VarChar(50);
DECLARE @StrSelect	NVarChar(max);
DECLARE @NotSent	bit;
DECLARE @MobileReq	bit;

DECLARE @LangID		Char(1)
DECLARE @SessionNo	VarChar(10)
DECLARE @ReportID	VarChar(10)
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- Init Variables -----------------------------------------------
	If (@RepInfo	Is Null)	SET @RepInfo    = '1@1@1'

	IF (@SelectedAcnt1 Is Null)	SET @SelectedAcnt1 = 0;
	IF (@SelectedAcnt2 Is Null)	SET @SelectedAcnt2 = 0;
	IF (@SelectedAcnt3 Is Null)	SET @SelectedAcnt3 = 0;
	IF (@SelectedAcnt4 Is Null)	SET @SelectedAcnt4 = 0;
	
	SET @NotSent	= Substring(@RepOptions, 1, 1);
	SET	@MobileReq	= Substring(@RepOptions, 3, 1);

	SET	@LangID		= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 1);
	SET @SessionNo	= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 2);
	SET @ReportID	= pub.funSplitString(@RepInfo, '@', 3);
	-----------------------------------------------------------------
	SELECT @StrWhere = '(H.ProcessID = 90)'
	SELECT @StrWhereA = '(1 = 1)'
	SELECT @StrWhereT = '(1 = 1)'
	
	--SELECT @StrWhere = '(D.ProcessID=90)'
	
	IF	(@SelectedAcnt1 > 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt1, 'H.AcntCode') 
	IF	(@SelectedAcnt2 > 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt2, 'H.AcntCode') 
	IF	(@SelectedAcnt3 > 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt3, 'H.AcntCode') 
	IF	(@SelectedAcnt4 > 0)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt4, 'H.AcntCode') 

	--Update rpt.tblFilters
	--Set CodeStart = 1
	--Where SessionNo = @SessionNo and ReportID = @ReportID and ObjectID in (@SelectedAcnt1, @SelectedAcnt2, @SelectedAcnt3, @SelectedAcnt4)
	
	If (@SelectedAcnt1 > 0)
		SET @StrWhereA = @StrWhereA + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt1, 'V.AcntCode')
	If (@SelectedAcnt2 > 0)
		SET @StrWhereA = @StrWhereA + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt2, 'V.AcntCode')
	If (@SelectedAcnt3 > 0)
		SET @StrWhereA = @StrWhereA + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt3, 'V.AcntCode')
	If (@SelectedAcnt4 > 0)
		SET @StrWhereA = @StrWhereA + ' AND ' + pub.funGetFilterString(@SessionNo, @ReportID, @SelectedAcnt4, 'V.AcntCode')
	
	IF (@DocDateFr Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (H.DocDate>=''' + @DocDateFr + ''')'
	IF (@DocDateTo Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (H.DocDate<=''' + @DocDateTo + ''')'

	IF (@UsanceDateFr Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (H.SettlementDate>=''' + @UsanceDateFr + ''')'
	IF (@UsanceDateTo Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (H.SettlementDate<=''' + @UsanceDateTo + ''')'

	IF (@SerialFr Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (H.SerialNo>=''' + STR(@SerialFr) + ''')'
	IF (@SerialTo Is Not Null)
		SET @StrWhere = @StrWhere + ' AND (H.SerialNo<=''' + STR(@SerialTo) + ''')'
		
	if (@NotSent = 1)
		set @Activator = '(1 = 1)'
	else
		set @Activator = '(1 = 0)'

	set @StrWhereT = @StrWhereT + ' And (AH.CodeClosed = 0)'		
	
	if (@MobileReq = 1)
		set @StrWhereT = @StrWhereT + ' And (AH.SMSMobile <> '''')'
	
	IF	(@SelectedAcnt1 > 0) OR (@SelectedAcnt2 > 0) OR (@SelectedAcnt3 > 0) OR (@SelectedAcnt4 > 0)
		Set @StrWhereT = @StrWhereT + ' And AH.AcntCode = Substring(H.AcntCode,' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartStart)) + ',' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartLen)) + ') and AH.PartNumber =  ' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartNo))
	
	--=============================================== Select
	SET @StrSelect = '
	select	T.*, H.SidePriceSum, H.DocDate, H.DocDesc, H.SaleTypeID, H.AcntCode, H.SettlementDate
	,isnull((select DistributDate  from sal.tblDistributionsHdr a
			inner join  sal.tblDistributionsDtl b
			On a.ProcessID=b.ProcessID
				and  a.SerialNo=b.SerialNo
			where BaseSaleProcessID=H.ProcessID
			and BaseSaleProcessNo=H.ProcessNo
			and BaseSaleFiscalYear=H.FiscalYear
			and BaseSaleSerialNo=H.SerialNo
	),'''') DistributDate 
	into	#tbl_SMS_SaleDocs_H
	from
	(
		select	ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo
		from	inv.tblStorageDocsHdr H
		where	' + @StrWhere + '
		group by ProcessID, ProcessNo, FiscalYear, SerialNo
		except
		select  BaseProcessID, BaseProcessNo, BaseFiscalYear, BaseSerialNo
		from	TS.sms.tblSmsDocsDtl
		where	' + @Activator + ' and DBID = (select DBID from TS.pub.tblDatabases where (DBName = ''' +  DB_NAME() + '''))
	) T inner join inv.vwStorageDocsHdr H on H.ProcessID=T.ProcessID AND H.ProcessNo=T.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=T.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=T.SerialNo 
	
	select	Substring(V.AcntCode,' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartStart)) + ',' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartLen)) + ') AcntCode, 
			isnull(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) Remain
	into	#tbl_SMS_SaleDocs_V
	from	acc.tblVoucherDtl V
	where  ' + @StrWhereA + '
	group BY Substring(V.AcntCode,' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartStart)) + ',' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartLen)) + ')

	select	H.*, isnull(V.Remain, 0) Remain, AH.SMSMobile, ST.SaleTypeName,
			AD.AcntCode PartCode, AD.AcntName PartName, 
			D.SumPriceDtl + H.SidePriceSum PayableAmount
	from
	(
		select	D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo, 
				SUM(D.GoodsQuantity * D.GoodsPrice) SumPriceDtl,
				SUM(D.DiscountDtl) SumDiscountDtl
		from	#tbl_SMS_SaleDocs_H H
					inner join inv.tblStorageDocsDtl D on H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID AND H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
		group by D.ProcessID, D.ProcessNo, D.FiscalYear, D.SerialNo
	) D inner join #tbl_SMS_SaleDocs_H H on H.ProcessID=D.ProcessID AND H.ProcessNo=D.ProcessNo AND H.FiscalYear=D.FiscalYear AND H.SerialNo=D.SerialNo
		left  join acc.tblAcnt AH on AH.AcntCode = Substring(H.AcntCode,' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartStart)) + ',' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartLen)) + ') and AH.PartNumber =  ' + ltrim(str(@AcntPartNo)) + ' 
		left  join acc.tblAcntDtl AD on AD.AcntCode = AH.AcntCode and AD.PartNumber=AH.PartNumber
		left  join #tbl_SMS_SaleDocs_V V ON V.AcntCode=AH.AcntCode 
		left  join sal.tblSaleTypesDtl ST on ST.SaleTypeID = H.SaleTypeID 
	where ' + @StrWhereT + '
	order by H.FiscalYear, H.SerialNo '

	PRINT @StrSelect
	EXEC sp_executesql @StrSelect;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [trs].[SpGetDuplicateCheques]
	@ProcessID		int,
	@ProcessNo		int,
	@FiscalYear		int,
	@SerialNo		int
AS 
Begin
	select FiscalYear, SerialNo, DocRowNo, ChequeNo, 1 AS ChqStatus
	from trs.tblPayDtl
	where (ProcessID in (2,25))
		and (ProcessNo=@ProcessNo)
		and (FiscalYear=@FiscalYear)
		and (SerialNo<>@SerialNo)
		and (ChequeNo <> '')
		and (ChequeNo in (select ChequeNo from trs.tblPayDtl where ProcessID=@ProcessID and ProcessNo=@ProcessNo and FiscalYear=@FiscalYear and SerialNo=@SerialNo and ChequeNo<>''))
		
	union all	

	select FiscalYear, SerialNo, 0 DocRowNo, ChequeNo, 2 AS ChqStatus
	from trs.tblPayDtl
	where (ProcessID = @ProcessID)
		and (ProcessNo=@ProcessNo)
		and (FiscalYear=@FiscalYear)
		and (SerialNo=@SerialNo)
		and (ChequeNo <> '')
	group by FiscalYear, SerialNo, ChequeNo
	having COUNT(*) > 1
	
End

functions.name: funReceivableDocs_PaidReceipt_Sum
functions.definition:
-- =========== TS-QC:UPDATED ====================

-- Last ModifieR :
