CREATE FUNCTION [trs].[funReceivableDocs_PaidReceipt_Sum]
(
	@AcntFullCode	VarChar(20),
	@ProcessNo		Int = 1,
	@DateApplied	Char(10)
)
RETURNS BigInt
--WITH ENCRYPTION
As
Begin 

	-- اسناد دریافتنی موجود در صندوق و موجود در بانک
	DECLARE @iSumVal AS	BigInt
	SET		@iSumVal = 0.0

	SELECT	@iSumVal = IsNull(Sum(PD.Amount), 0)
	FROM	[trs].tblPayDtl AS PD
			INNER JOIN 
			(
				SELECT A.*, 
					(
						SELECT Top 1 CreditCode
						FROM	trs.tblPayDtl X
						WHERE	X.ProcessID IN (1,10) 
							AND X.EventNo=1
							and X.PayTypeID IN (6,26) 
							and X.VolumeFiscalYear=A.VolumeFiscalYear
							and X.VolumeRowNo=A.VolumeRowNo
					) FirstCreditCode
				FROM 
				(
					SELECT	VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo, Max(EventNo) AS EventNo
					FROM	[trs].tblPayDtl AS PD2
					WHERE	PD2.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) AND PD2.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo
					GROUP BY VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo
				) A
			) VOL ON PD.VolumeFiscalYear = VOL.VolumeFiscalYear 
				 AND PD.VolumeRowNo = VOL.VolumeRowNo 
				 AND PD.EventNo = VOL.EventNo
	WHERE	PD.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) AND 
			PD.ProcessID IN (1, 10, 17, 20, 21, 23, 40) AND 
			PD.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo AND
			VOL.FirstCreditCode = @AcntFullCode

	-- اسناد دریافتنی واگذار شده به اشخاص
	
	SELECT	@iSumVal = @iSumVal + ISNull(Sum(PD.Amount), 0)
	FROM	trs.tblPayDtl PD
			INNER JOIN 
			(
				SELECT A.*,
					(
						SELECT Top 1 CreditCode
						FROM	trs.tblPayDtl X
						WHERE	X.ProcessID IN (1,10) 
							AND X.EventNo=1
							and X.PayTypeID IN (6,26) 
							and X.VolumeFiscalYear=A.VolumeFiscalYear
							and X.VolumeRowNo=A.VolumeRowNo
					) FirstCreditCode
				FROM 
					(
						SELECT	VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo, Max(EventNo) AS EventNo
						FROM	trs.tblPayDtl PD2
						WHERE	PD2.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) 
							AND PD2.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo
						GROUP BY VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo
					) A
			) VOL ON 
				PD.VolumeFiscalYear = VOL.VolumeFiscalYear AND 
				PD.VolumeRowNo = VOL.VolumeRowNo AND 
				PD.EventNo = VOL.EventNo
	WHERE	PD.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) AND
			PD.ProcessID = 2 AND
			PD.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo AND
			PD.ChequeDate <= @DateApplied AND
			VOL.FirstCreditCode = @AcntFullCode 

	--------------------------------------------------------
	Return @iSumVal;
End

Create FUNCTION [trs].[funReceivableDocs_UnReceipt_Sum_Modified]
(
	@AcntCode	 VARCHAR(20),
	@ProcessNo	 INT = 1,
	@DateApplied CHAR(10),
	@Start		 INT,
	@Len		 INT
)
RETURNS BigInt
--WITH ENCRYPTION
AS
BEGIN 

	-- اسناد دریافتنی موجود در صندوق و موجود در بانک
	DECLARE @iSumVal AS	BigInt
	SET		@iSumVal = 0.0

	SELECT @iSumVal = IsNull(Sum(PD.Amount), 0)
	FROM [trs].tblPayDtl AS PD
	INNER JOIN (SELECT A.*, 
				(SELECT DISTINCT Top 1 CreditCode
				 FROM trs.tblPayDtl X
				 WHERE X.ProcessID IN (1,10) 
				   AND X.EventNo = 1
				   AND X.PayTypeID IN (6,26) 
				   AND X.VolumeFiscalYear = A.VolumeFiscalYear
				   AND X.VolumeRowNo = A.VolumeRowNo) FirstCreditCode
				FROM (SELECT VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo, Max(EventNo) AS EventNo
					  FROM [trs].tblPayDtl AS PD2
					  WHERE PD2.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) 
					    AND PD2.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo 
				GROUP BY VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo) A ) VOL ON PD.VolumeFiscalYear = VOL.VolumeFiscalYear 
															   AND PD.VolumeRowNo = VOL.VolumeRowNo 
															   AND PD.EventNo = VOL.EventNo
	WHERE PD.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) 
	  AND PD.ProcessID IN (1, 10, 17, 20, 21, 23, 40) 
	  AND PD.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo 
	  AND SubString(VOL.FirstCreditCode,@Start,@Len) = @AcntCode

	-- اسناد دریافتنی واگذار شده به اشخاص
	
	SELECT @iSumVal = @iSumVal + ISNull(Sum(PD.Amount), 0)
	FROM trs.tblPayDtl PD
	INNER JOIN (SELECT A.*,
				(SELECT TOP 1 CreditCode
				 FROM trs.tblPayDtl X
				 WHERE X.ProcessID IN (1,10) 
				  AND X.EventNo=1
				  AND X.PayTypeID IN (6,26) 
				  AND X.VolumeFiscalYear=A.VolumeFiscalYear
				  AND X.VolumeRowNo=A.VolumeRowNo) FirstCreditCode
				FROM (SELECT VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo, Max(EventNo) AS EventNo
					  FROM trs.tblPayDtl PD2
					  WHERE	PD2.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) 
					    AND PD2.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo
				GROUP BY VolumeFiscalYear, VolumeRowNo) A ) VOL ON PD.VolumeFiscalYear = VOL.VolumeFiscalYear 
															   AND PD.VolumeRowNo = VOL.VolumeRowNo 
															   AND PD.EventNo = VOL.EventNo 
	WHERE PD.PayTypeID IN (6, 26) 
	  AND PD.ProcessID = 2 
	  AND PD.ProcessNo = @ProcessNo 
	  AND PD.ChequeDate > @DateApplied 
	  AND SubString(VOL.FirstCreditCode,@Start,@Len) = @AcntCode

	--------------------------------------------------------
	Return @iSumVal;
END
